title: Regulatory Reporting Analyst
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive.   We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
 As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.
  
 We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
 
 We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
 
 
 
 Job Description Key Responsibilities 
 
 Regulatory Reporting Production & Review 
 Assist the preparation, review and submission of regulatory returns across U.S. Bank Europe DAC and associated European entities.

 Ensure submissions are completed accurately and within regulatory deadlines.

 Perform detailed reconciliations and analytical reviews between regulatory returns, general ledger balances, risk systems and management information.

 Investigate and resolve reporting discrepancies, data quality issues and validation exceptions.

 
 Regulatory Interpretation & Change Management ​ 
 Support the interpretation and implementation of new regulatory requirements issued by:
 

 European Banking Authority (EBA)

 European Central Bank (ECB)

 Central Bank of Ireland (CBI)

 Local European regulators

 Assess the impact of regulatory changes on existing reporting processes and systems.

 Participate in regulatory reporting projects including CRR/CRD developments, taxonomy upgrades, system enhancements and business change initiatives.

 Contribute to regulatory reporting framework enhancements and control improvements.

 
 
 Governance & Controls 
 Maintain a strong control environment supporting all reporting activities.

 Ensure procedures, methodologies and control evidence are properly documented.

 Support internal audits, external audits and regulatory reviews.

 Prepare evidence and documentation required for governance committees and regulatory examinations.

 Escalate material issues and risks in accordance with established governance processes.

 
 Data Management & Analysis 
 Analyse large data sets to identify trends, anomalies and reporting impacts.

 Partner with Data Governance, Finance, Risk and Technology teams to improve data quality.

 Support implementation of data lineage, data controls and data governance initiatives.

 Develop management information and reporting metrics to enhance oversight of regulatory processes.

 Utilise technology and automation tools to improve reporting efficiency and reduce operational risk.

 
 Qualifications & Experience Essential 
 3+ years' experience within:

 Regulatory Reporting

 Financial Reporting

 Treasury Reporting

 Risk Reporting

 Banking Finance

 Strong understanding of prudential banking regulations and reporting requirements.

 Advanced Excel skills / Data Management Skills.

 Experience performing reconciliations, control reviews and analytical assessments.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 Strong organisational skills and ability to manage competing deadlines.

 Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent work experience

 
 Skills & Experience 
 Experience with COREP, FINREP, LCR, NSFR or statistical reporting.

 Experience with regulatory reporting systems and data warehouses.

 Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, Python or other analytical tools.

 Experience working with European banking regulators.

 Knowledge of CRR, CRD, EBA reporting frameworks and ECB supervisory expectations.

 
 This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. 
 
 Accessibility 
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support. 
 
 Total Rewards 
 U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.
  
 We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:
 Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

 Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

 Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

 Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

 Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

  
 We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.
 
 We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon .
   
 Closing Date 
 Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.
  
 We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

In  Risk Analytics , we develop   and support the deployment of risk models, strategies and decision tools for regulatory capital, internal capital and business decision making.
Risk Analytics is part of the Risk Function, this is an independent, second line of defence function that monitors, controls, and supports risk-taking activities across AIB. Our dynamic and diverse team collaborates seamlessly to provide a wide range of services, including finance, IT, human resources, marketing, and more. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
 Dentons Business Services EMEA serves as the operational backbone of Dentons, supporting the world’s largest law firm in delivering exceptional service to clients across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 As a crucial component of Dentons' global network, our EMEA business services team plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 Dentons Business Services EMEA is seeking a proactive and results-oriented Resourcing Administrator to join our UKIME Resourcing Operations team. In this role, you will be part of the wider HR Operations Services team but will provide dedicated operational support to the UKIME Resourcing team. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with at least one year’s experience in a law firm, recruitment agency, or professional services environment who is eager to advance their career in HR or Recruitment Operations.
 - As this role supports UK region please note that it requires operating within UK time-zone therefore working hours are from 10 am – 6 pm 
 - This role operates in Hybrid working model requiring DBSE Warsaw office presence 1-2 times a week
  
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Vacancy Management: Create and manage vacancies on the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring effective coordination of internal and external job postings and advertisements.
 Interview Coordination: Schedule and coordinate high volumes of interviews for candidates, recruitment agencies, hiring managers, and interviewers, ensuring all stakeholders are fully briefed and demonstrating sensitivity to differing time zones.
 Offer and Contract Production: Prepare and issue offer letters and employment contracts for permanent and fixed-term roles.
 Assessment Administration: Arrange online psychometric assessments and behavioural preference questionnaires, track candidate progress, and deliver timely reports to relevant stakeholders.
 Job Description Administration: Maintain all job descriptions, ensuring documents are current, accurately formatted, and consistent with Dentons’ house style.
 Data Integrity: Originate and maintain accurate data within the ATS and other HR systems, supporting robust reporting and metrics.
 Stakeholder Liaison: Act as a point of contact for recruitment agencies and direct applicants regarding interview logistics and process updates.
 Status Reporting: Provide regular updates to Resourcing Advisors, the Resourcing Manager, and the Head of Recruitment on interview scheduling and candidate progress.
 Invoice Processing: Accurately process HR invoices, ensuring correct coding, tracking, and timely completion in line with company procedures.
 Service Level Adherence: Ensure all assigned tasks are completed within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
  
 REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
 Experience 
 Experience of working in an HR department.
 Experience in managing high volumes of administrative tasks.
 Experience working with a law firm, corporate environment, recruitment agency, or professional services organization would be an asset. 
 Experience working with a ticketing system would be preferable.
 Technical Skills 
 English C1
 Working knowledge of MS Office, e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Outlook
 Recruitment systems knowledge (ATS, CRM HRIS), ability to implement best practices in system usage
 Ability to maintain clear record-keeping systems including databases
 Personal Skills / Attributes 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
 Methodical approach to work with a strong focus on accuracy, attention to detail, consistency, and quality.
 A flexible approach to adapt to differing demands, prioritizing tasks where appropriate, and ensuring completion of tasks.
 Understands the need for well-defined procedures and keeps process documentation updated.
 Demonstrates excellent customer/client-facing skills.
  
 BENEFITS
 Private medical healthcare.
 Multisport card.
 Worksmile Cafeteria system. 
 Workation, up to 90 days a year.
 A private insurance plan.
 An additional day off for your birthday. 
 Volunteering days, up to 2 a year.
 Hybrid work model with a modern office in Warsaw city center.

About the Role
To efficiently and cost effectively handle; negotiate and settle claims within designated authority and agreed services standards.
Handling all claims from notification through to closure within agreed authority limits and service standards, in order to obtain optimum settlement for the company and customer;
Assist Management team where required, to monitor workflow, (to include telephony, electronic correspondence, mail) outstanding caseloads, processes, tasks and distribution of new claims;
Be a point of contact and support for colleagues;
Handling all incoming telephone and written communication from customers / policyholders, their representatives and all other interested parties in a pro-active manner and within SLA’s;

Ensuring that critical detail is captured at all stages of the claim, as comprehensively and accurately as possible, to ensure that;
All claims are handled appropriately; and that
The data captured in respect of fraud indicators is directed to the Team Fraud Coordinator and/or Claims Investigation Team, to ensure maximum detection of fraudulent or exaggerated claims.

Dealing with all issues in terms of Policy indemnity and liability in the appropriate manner and manage each claim to a satisfactory conclusion, maximising customer satisfaction and minimising cost to FBD. Fair to the customer, fair to FBD;
Establish and maintain adequate claims reserves (ensuring prudent reserving policy is adhered to);
Ensure best practice handling behaviour that supports attention to detail, challenge to service provider views, independent decision making, a proactive philosophy to information gathering, investigation and evaluation and availing of every opportunity to settle in the most cost effective settlement channel, with particular focus on the development and improvement in the FNOL process to deliver a premium customer and employee experience in line with strategic goals;

title: Treasury ALM Portfolio Analyst
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive.   We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
 As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.
  
 We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
 
 We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
 
 
 
 Job Description The successful candidate will be an integral part of a Treasury team responsible for all Treasury functions within the bank. This role will have a key focus on the management, analysis and reporting of the bank’s investment securities portfolio – including fixed income bonds, High-Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA) and Collateralised Loan Obligations (CLOs) – while continuing to support core Asset and Liability Management activities and day-to-day risk management and reporting.
 
 Key Accountabilities: 
 
 Portfolio Management 
 Support the day-to-day management, monitoring and reporting of the bank’s investment securities portfolio, including composition, performance, and adherence to approved limits.

 Assist in the analysis and reporting of fixed income bond holdings, including valuation, yield, duration, and credit quality.

 Support the build-out and ongoing monitoring of the HQLA securities portfolio.

 Support CLO investment onboarding, monitoring and reporting – including tranche performance, collateral quality and exposure limits.

 Contribute to portfolio construction and investment decision support through data-driven analysis.

 
 Asset & Liability Management / Treasury 
 Provide support and back up to all treasury Asset and Liability Management activities.

 Balance Sheet FX management including the execution of FX trades.

 Support ad-hoc regulatory requests pertaining to treasury and portfolio activity.

 Process improvement with development and review of procedures in a control related environment.

 Contribute to the preparation of content for the monthly Asset Liability Management Committee pack.

 
 Knowledge and Experience: 
 
 Experience/Qualifications 
 Minimum three years treasury, investment or portfolio management experience.

 Experience across fixed income / bond portfolios and an understanding of structured credit (e.g. CLOs).

 Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

 
 Skills/Disposition 
 Strong (internal) customer focus.

 Strong MS Excel skills required.

 Strong MS PowerPoint skills, with attention to detail over final output.

 Ability to effectively manage and prioritize multiple activities with competing deadlines.

 Ability to deal effectively and tactfully with customers, other banks.

 
 Beneficial Skills 
 Knowledge of CLO structures and structured credit instruments.

 Data analytics and financial modelling capability (e.g. Python, advanced Excel, VBA) .

 Interest Rate Swap (IRS) and broader derivative experience.

 Familiarity with portfolio analytics / risk systems (e.g. Intex, Bloomberg).

 
 Additional information: 
 
 The role offers a hybrid / flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.
  
 This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. 
 
 
 Accessibility 
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support. 
 
 Total Rewards 
 U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.
  
 We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:
 Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

 Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

 Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

 Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

 Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

  
 We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.
 
 We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon .
   
 Closing Date 
 Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.
  
 We aim to provide timely updates throughout the process and encourage early applications to ensure consideration.

title: Experienced Motor Claims Handler
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Experienced Motor Claims Handler 
 
 Job Location: Ireland – Home working Job Type: Permanent Remuneration : Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications  
 We are looking for experienced Motor Claim Handlers to join our expanding Motor Division. 
 We are growing, and we need your support in both maintaining this momentum and building on our experience levels across the division.
 
 We are looking for Claim Handlers capable of managing a portfolio of motor damage claims with little supervision and are looking to personally develop and take advantage of opportunities that arise as the division continues its period of growth.
 
 As an experienced Claim Handler, you will be expected to support your less experienced colleagues, providing mentorship and training as and when required. You will be well versed in the management of all motor damage claims, both first and third party. Technically, you will be able to demonstrate a strong knowledge of the assessment of both quantum and liability processes, as well as an ability to determine coverage. You will be able to demonstrate that you are familiar with the CPC requirements, and that the customer is at the centre of all that you do. 
 
 You'll bring strong decision-making skills, sound numeric ability, excellent attention to detail and the confidence to negotiate, influence and solve problems in a fast-paced, environment with deadlines.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 Claims Portfolio Management – Essential experience managing motor claims, ideally including a portfolio of 150+ files with specific closure and quality targets.
 Insurance Qualifications – APA qualification is the minimum requirement; the expectation is that CIP would have been achieved and you are moving onto MDI and more.
 Technical Claims Knowledge – Good knowledge of motor claims classifications, motor policies, liability, indemnity, quantum, market agreements, claims processes and relevant industry developments.
 Investigation & Decision Making – Confident carrying out desktop liability investigations, reviewing evidence, determining liability and making accurate, well-reasoned decisions.
 Customer, Client & Complaint Handling – Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused approach, confidence liaising with clients and colleagues, and complaint handling experience considered advantageous.
 Negotiation & Claims Resolution – Strong negotiating, influencing and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and settle claims in a timely, compliant and commercially aware manner.
 Attention to Detail & Accuracy – High levels of accuracy and attention to detail when reviewing documentation, assessing claims and maintaining records.
 Adaptability & Resilience – Able to thrive in a dynamic, pressurised and target-driven environment, managing deadlines, changing priorities and business needs with a positive and flexible approach.
 
 What we’ll give you for this role: 
 Bonus/incentive scheme
 20 days' annual leave entitlement
 Bike to Work Scheme
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme 
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4)
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4)
 EAP – Employee Assistance Programme
 Life Cover
 PHI – Permanent Health Insurance
 Exams & Professional Membership Fees
 Professional and personal development opportunities
 
 This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry 
 At Sedgwick, you'll help people and businesses recover when the unexpected happens, working alongside some of the most trusted names in insurance.
 From day one, you'll have access to learning and development opportunities, including professional qualifications through our partnership with the Insurance Institute, helping you grow your skills and build a rewarding long-term career.
 You'll join a team that's passionate about making a difference, where every role contributes to our shared purpose of caring for people and helping businesses recover.
 
 Next steps for you: 
 Think we'd be a great match? We'd love to hear from you – apply today. 
 
 If you're unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Sedgwick is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and does not tolerate discrimination of any kind. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. Following the closing date, applications will be reviewed and shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, either virtually or in person.

description:
Graduate Programme 2027 – Audit 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.
 About Grant Thornton 
 Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. 
 Audit 
 About the Team 
 Grant Thornton's Audit practice provides independent assurance services to organisations across a wide range of industries, helping stakeholders make informed business decisions with confidence. Our professionals combine technical expertise, commercial understanding and industry knowledge to deliver high-quality audits that go beyond compliance.
 The Audit practice comprises Corporate Audit, Financial Services (FS) Audit and Global Statutory Audit teams, providing graduates with exposure to a diverse range of industries, organisations and audit environments.
 Corporate Audit works with clients ranging from large multinational corporations and listed entities to privately owned businesses and rapidly growing entrepreneurial companies.
 Financial Services (FS) Audit supports a broad range of regulated entities, including investment funds, asset managers, aircraft leasing companies, banking institutions and insurance businesses.
 Global Statutory Audit works with multinational organisations to coordinate statutory audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions, collaborating with Grant Thornton member firms around the world to deliver seamless and consistent audit services.
 Our professionals support clients across a variety of sectors, including:
 Technology
 Financial Services
 Aviation and Leasing
 Manufacturing
 Healthcare and Life Sciences
 Retail and Consumer Business
 Real Estate and Construction
 Energy and Infrastructure
 As an Audit Graduate, you'll gain hands-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing a deep understanding of how businesses operate. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical accounting and auditing knowledge while gaining valuable insight into the financial and operational drivers behind business performance.
 Whether working with large multinational organisations, indigenous Irish businesses, high-growth companies or public interest entities, you'll contribute to engagements that help build trust and confidence in financial reporting.
 What You Will Do 
 As a Graduate Trainee within Audit, you'll work closely with experienced auditors and client teams on a variety of audit and assurance engagements across Corporate Audit, FS Audit and Global Statutory Audit.
 You may have the opportunity to:
 Assist in planning and executing financial statement audits.
 Review financial records, business processes and internal controls.
 Analyse financial data and assess audit risks.
 Prepare audit working papers and supporting documentation.
 Perform substantive testing across key financial statement areas.
 Participate in stock counts and other audit procedures.
 Support the identification and assessment of control weaknesses and business risks.
 Work directly with clients to gather information and understand their operations.
 Prepare reports, presentations and client deliverables.
 Collaborate with colleagues across Audit, Tax and Advisory teams.
 The Experience You Will Gain 
  
 You'll gain practical experience working with businesses of varying sizes and complexities while developing a strong understanding of accounting standards, regulatory requirements and audit methodology.
 How We Will Support Your Development 
 At Grant Thornton, we are committed to helping our people realise their potential.
 As an Audit Graduate, you'll benefit from:
 Structured learning and development programmes.
 Professional qualification support through ACA training.
 Dedicated mentoring and coaching.
 Technical accounting and audit training.
 Study leave and exam support.
 Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders and client management teams.
 Access to The Academy training programme.
 Clear pathways for long-term career progression and leadership development.
 Our culture encourages curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement, giving graduates the support and opportunities needed to build successful careers in professional services.
 Who We're Looking For 
 We welcome applications from graduates across a broad range of disciplines who are interested in business, finance and professional services.
 Successful candidates will demonstrate:
 Strong IT, analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
 Curiosity about how businesses operate.
 A proactive and collaborative mindset.
 Strong organisational and time management skills.
 The ability to analyse information critically and think commercially.
 A minimum 2.1 degree, or expected equivalent, in any discipline. 
  
 It would also be helpful if you have 
 Experience gained through an internship, part-time role, volunteering, university society or team-based project. 
 An interest in how organisations change, improve services or make better use of technology 
  
 Join Us 
 Join Grant Thornton's Audit team and gain exposure to some of Ireland's most dynamic organisations across Corporate Audit, Financial Services Audit and Global Statutory Audit. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial insight and professional skills while helping businesses maintain transparency, accountability and trust.
 Location and working arrangement:  Cork office, primarily office-based. 
 Application and selection process:  Apply through link - complete our application form and upload your current CV. Closing date Thursday 22 October 2026. Selection process early November 2026. Start date Autumn 2027.

title: Graduate Programme 2027 | BDO Ireland LLP Limerick
description:
The BDO Ireland LLP Limerick Graduate Programme 2027 is seeking applications across our Audit, Tax and Corporate Finance Departments. 

 AUDIT JOB DESCRIPTION
 

 The BDO Audit Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are eager to build a career in accountancy and gain hands-on experience working with a broad range of clients. 

 As part of the Audit team, you will work alongside experienced professionals while supporting our clients. You will be involved in assisting in the preparation of financial statements, analysing financial information, and helping clients meet their reporting and compliance obligations. The role will give you exposure to different clients, business models, and financial challenges, allowing you to develop both your technical knowledge and commercial awareness. 

 From the outset, you will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities while receiving the training, mentoring, and support needed to help you grow professionally. As you progress, you will develop strong client relationship skills, gain practical experience in financial reporting and assurance, and work towards your recognised professional qualification (ACA or ACCA). 

 This programme offers an excellent foundation for graduates looking to develop a long-term career in audit and professional services or later move into industry. As part of the programme, graduates will be assigned to one of BDO's specialist audit teams, providing the opportunity to develop sector-specific expertise and build strong client relationships.  

 Our audit teams serve a diverse range of industries, including Financial Services, Manufacturing and Distribution, Telecommunications, Media and Technology; Charities, Non-Profit Organisations; Construction and Real Estate.  

 Working within a dedicated team, graduates will gain valuable hands-on experience, develop strong technical and commercial skills, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality audit and assurance services to clients. 
 
TAX JOB DESCRIPTION 
 

 The BDO Tax Graduate Programme offers graduates the opportunity to develop a career in a fast-paced and dynamic area of professional services. Working as part of our Tax Department, you will help clients meet their compliance obligations while supporting them in understanding and managing the tax implications of their business and personal affairs. 

 Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to a broad range of tax matters, work with clients across different industries, and develop a practical understanding of Irish tax legislation. You will be involved in both compliance and advisory work, giving you the opportunity to build strong technical skills while developing commercial awareness and client relationship experience. 
 
With support from experienced colleagues, structured training, and assistance towards completing a professional qualification, including the Irish Tax Institute (ITI) Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA) programme, this graduate programme provides an excellent foundation for graduates looking to build a long-term career in tax. 

 CORPORATE FINANCE & RECOVERY JOB DESCRIPTION 
 

 BDO Ireland LLP Limerick is seeking a Graduate to join our successful and expanding Corporate Finance and Recovery team in Limerick city. 

BDO Ireland LLP Limerick has an ambitious strategy which envisages significant future business growth across existing and new services. This growth will be underpinned by a people strategy which will establish BDO as a home for top talent and create an environment where our people can develop and grow. 

 We are looking for an ambitious, forward thinking high achiever seeking a new challenge in a progressive and forward-thinking firm. At BDO you can be yourself - we value you as an individual and want you to realise your aspirations. We will give you the challenge and support you need, and you can shape your own career according to your strengths, skills and personality. 

 As part of the fifth largest global professional services firm, BDO is one of Ireland’s leading accountancy, tax, advisory and consulting organisations. Working at BDO enhances your professional development at all stages of your career. Few firms offer the same breadth and quality of work, responsibility and experience. We recognise and reward your high performance and you have the opportunity to excel, progress and share in our success. We are clear on what we expect from you and what you can expect in return.

Tirlán Graduate Programme
We’re looking for new talent.
We’re connecting the work of Irish farming families with the global market, producing pure nutrition, while safeguarding the land for future generations.
We care about life in perfect balance, and want your help.
Do you want a career where you can truly make a difference?
View graduate opportunities
We’re looking for ambitious graduates across a range of disciplines to join us, as we work to create a global community celebrating wholesome nutrition from the land we live and love. Recruitment for our Tirlán Graduate Programme takes place each year in autumn with the graduates starting in September
Our Programme is designed to take you through a series of real-world learning experiences, helping you build confidence in your abilities, and to flourish in your careers.
We’re recruiting across a range of disciplines, including Agribusiness, Commercial, Corporate Affairs, Engineering & Operations, HR, IT (Business Analysis & MES), Marketing, Quality & Compliance, R&D and Strategy/Project Management, Accounting & Finance.
If you’re currently completing your bachelor’s or master’s degree with an expected 2.2 and above in a related field, now is the time to apply.

Alexander Nulty – Agribusiness Associate
I’ve learnt so much since I’ve started - in everything from customer service to farm advice, to animal nutrition. The opportunities are endless and they are there to be grasped. You get to meet people here who will help you throughout your life.
Kyeesha Glenn-Davi - Research and Development – Associate
What stood out most for me was how kind and supportive everyone is at Tirlán. They’re happy to share their knowledge. The collaborative culture here means you get broad business exposure. While I now work on the Advanced Analytical Team within R&D, we also work very closely with Quality and Commercial and have had interactions with customers, the Executive Leadership team and farmer representatives. It all gives you a wider view of the business, you can see where you fit in and add value.
Ciara Ryan – Agribusiness Associate
There are lots of opportunities to develop and I’ve found the work-life balance great. Tirlán is a vibrant and exciting place to work.
Why Tirlán?
Our approach is different. We give you the opportunity to do real work. We want you to take control.
You’ll be a valued member of the team
On this programme, you will not be a spectator. You’ll be exposed to significant learning opportunities and will get to know the many aspects of our business.
Tirlán is bigger than the sum of its parts, yet small enough to allow for agility and cross functional collaboration.
You’ll enjoy structured development
We hire graduates for their potential, and do not expect you to know everything. Structured learning is a huge aspect of our programme.
We love to see you develop and strive to provide endless opportunities, through bespoke programmes, on demand learning, summits, mentors, and projects.
We’ll give you a personalised career plan
We provide all the structure you need to grow fast, with a minimum of two job rotations, brand and business exposure, personalised development planning and access to career coaching.
We will support you to achieve the success you want, satisfying your appetite for a meaningful career experience.
You will make a real difference
As Tirlán, we’re setting out to tackle some ambitious new goals. Your impact will truly be felt from the very beginning and will help us shape the future of our business.
This is a new phase for our ambitious cooperative, building on our roots in the past and reaching ambitiously into the future. You will be working with an organisation that invests in farming families all across Ireland and brings world-class nutrition to the global market.
You’ll find a truly human environment
There’s something very different about working at Tirlán. We are community focused and caring. Many say it’s like joining a very large family.
We humbly believe that we are like no other organisation. We care about creating a space where you can be your true self at work, and strive to include everyone.
You will enjoy a real sense of balance
Our new hybrid workplace is designed to encourage work in a way that suits your professional, personal, and social life.
These state-of-the-art facilities support better wellbeing and better outcomes for everyone. We want you to have fun and build connections that last a lifetime; creating social moments as well as working opportunities.
Training & development
We take great pride in our training programmes. By providing personalised training, we empower our graduates to develop the confidence, skills and expertise to excel in their careers.
All grads receive the following training:
Two different rotations during your tenure to deliver different learning and exposure opportunities
Brand exposure experience to develop important business and customer understanding
Ongoing, structured coaching by manager
Career coaching and development planning
Comprehensive development programmes
Individual wellness planning
Reverse mentoring – we want to learn from you too!
We follow the 70:20:10 development model. This includes 70% on-the-job training, 20% networking, coaching and mentoring opportunities and 10% formal training. We have built this model to ensure you develop your potential and thrive at Tirlán. Learn more about our development model in our brochure.
Rewards & benefits
In addition to a competitive starting salary, you will get the following benefits package:
Hybrid working
Structured social events, team building and away days
Spotlighting events with senior leadership
Annual Tirlán Graduate Summit

title: Trainee Accountant
description:
At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple-to-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but.

About the role

You’ll join the Finance team at Flipdish, supporting a fast-moving, multi-entity environment where accurate financial information, strong controls, and clear reporting help the business make better decisions. This is a hands-on trainee role with exposure across accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end support, audit preparation, and reporting.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, building the foundations for a successful ACA / ACCA / CIMA training path while taking on more responsibility as you develop. This role follows our hub model, with a healthy blend of hub and home working: 2 days per week from our Sandyford office.

What you’ll own

  • Support core AP and AR processes, including invoice processing, supplier and customer queries, payment support, reconciliations, and maintaining accurate finance records across multiple entities.
  • Assist with month-end close, audit, tax, and statutory reporting requests by preparing journals, schedules, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and clear supporting documentation.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciling items, unusual balances, and transaction queries; work with Finance and wider business stakeholders to improve financial information and recurring processes.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility — prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

What success looks like

  • You understand Flipdish’s finance processes, systems, month-end timetable, and key stakeholders.
  • You are confidently supporting core AP and AR tasks with good accuracy, attention to detail, and clear supporting documentation.
  • You are preparing basic reconciliations and month-end schedules with improving independence.
  • You are asking good questions, learning quickly, and escalating issues early when something does not look right.
  • You are identifying small process improvements or ways to make recurring tasks more efficient.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong academic record, ideally with a degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, or a related discipline.
  • Are eager to commence, or have recently commenced, ACA / ACCA / CIMA.
  • Have strong numerical ability, attention to detail, and pride in producing accurate, well-supported work.
  • Are highly organised, dependable, and able to follow through on tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and are willing to ask questions.
  • Have good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets, with a willingness to keep improving quickly.
  • Take ownership of your work: you do not wait to be told what to do when you can spot the next useful step.

The following would help you stand out:

  • Some finance, accounting, bookkeeping, internship, or office experience.
  • Exposure to accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end, or financial reporting.
  • Experience working with finance systems, spreadsheets, or structured data.

What you get

We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!

  • Hub model (hybrid): a healthy blend of hub + home working (2 days per week from our Sandyford office)
  • Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays + company days (e.g. Summer Fridays, seasonal)
  • Private healthcare: IE cover (provided through Laya Healthcare)
  • Pension: Retirement savings support (IE)
  • Equity (ESOP): share options, so you can share in Flipdish’s long-term success
  • Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events
  • Commuter supports: TaxSaver / travel schemes (where available)

Here’s what you can expect throughout the interview process.

  1. Recruiter screening call (15 minutes)
  2. Hiring manager interview (60 minutes)
  3. Competency / technical stage (60 minutes)
  4. Reference checks

Our Culture

At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.

Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.

Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout). We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.

If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

title: Regulatory Reporting Officer
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
 
 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
 
 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
 
 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.
 
 For our business, for clients, and for you
 
 
 Role:   Regulatory Reporting Officer   

 Department:   Regulatory Reporting   

 Reports to:   Regulatory   & Investor Reporting Manager   

 Apex Risk Technologies (ART) is a leading fintech firm and a critical part of the Apex Group, a global financial services provider. ART clients include alternative investment funds, banks, and fund management companies (ManCo’s).   At ART, we have a passion for finance and technology with a strong commitment to research and development to continuously innovate and improve client solutions within an open and collegiate environment. ART’s core solution is RiskMonitor®, which provides an independent appraisal of investment risk compliance and financial risk exposures. RiskMonitor® produces customisable risk reporting suitable for boards, risk committees and investors as well as risk data required for regulatory submissions.     

 
 ART is a fast-growing business and we are looking for a   Regulatory Reporting Officer   to join our team in   Limerick, Ireland . In this role, you will liaise with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers and Investment Analysts to onboard their funds in RiskMonitor®,   produce regulatory reports in accordance with UCITS and AIFMD directives   and be involved in the daily maintenance of their accounts. In addition, you will closely work with the quantitative development team in Barcelona and Apex technology management colleagues globally to ensure the successful evolution of the ART business unit within Apex. Lastly, you will collaborate with business partners, technology vendors, client counterparties, and colleagues within the Apex Group. This role would suit someone who’s seeking a career in finance and technology with a keen and demonstrable interest in   regulatory reporting .     

 In this role, you will be responsible for:   

 Draft , c oordinate   and review of   UCITS   and PRIIP   Key Investor Information documentation , including risk indicator, monthly performance scenarios.   

 
 Prepare, r eview   of   quarterly/annual AIF,   AIFMD   returns   under ESMA /FCA   requirements . (Annex IV reporting)   

 
   

 Set up and p repare   investor   M onthly   F actsheets for   I nvestment   F unds.   

 
 Prepare, coordinate and review of European PRIIP (EPT) and European MIFID Templates (EMT)   

 
 Prepare, coordinate and review of European ESG templates (EET) in accordance with SFDR and SFDR 2.0   requirements.   

 
 Prepare/review other re porting   required by   the regulators in Luxembourg (CSSF) ,   Ireland (CBI) and United Kingdom (FCA).   

 
 Follow-up with clients and service providers regarding any issues raised until resolution .   

 
 Collaborate with Promoters of each   ART   client to ensure compliance with UCITS V I,   MIFID, KIID , AIFMD   2.0   and overall corporate governance .   

 
 Keep up to date with new regulations.   Support in inter pretation of new regulations on   how the fund/investors will be affected .   

 
 Actively participate in quarterly, monthly service review meetings   

 
 Assist with any ad hoc queries received from clients .   

 
 Ensure supporting procedures are accurate and kept up to date .   

 

 The ideal candidate will possess:   

 Strong academic background including a MSC in   Accounting /Finance/Economics /IT   or related field;   

 
 Proven in-depth knowledge   of European Regulated In vestment Products, UCITS, AIFMD and Fund regulatory requirements .   

 
 Proven experience in   Regulator y   Reporting, Financial Reporting   or Audit   environment   

 
 Excellent communication, analytic al and critical thinking skills   

 
 Ability to work under own initiative   

 
 Ability multi-task and work under pressure   and to deadlines   

 
 Fluent English (written and spoken).   

 
   

 
 Disclaimer : Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

title: 2027 Tax Graduate Programme - Cork
description:
Graduate Programme 2027 – Tax 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme. 
 About Grant Thornton 
 Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. 
 About the Team 
 Grant Thornton's Tax team works across the entire spectrum of tax services, providing innovative and practical solutions to clients operating locally and globally. Our professionals combine technical expertise with commercial insight to help clients manage tax risk, remain compliant and achieve their strategic objectives. 
 Our Tax team supports organisations of all sizes across a wide range of industries including technology, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, aviation, real estate and the public sector. 
 Our team advises clients across several specialist areas, including: 
 Corporate Tax 

 Financial Services 

 International Tax 

 VAT & Indirect Tax 

 Private Client & Wealth Management 

 Employer Solutions and Payroll 

 This breadth of expertise provides graduates with exposure to a diverse range of tax matters, industries and client challenges. 
 As a Tax Graduate, you'll gain hands-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing solutions to complex tax challenges. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical knowledge while understanding the wider business and commercial considerations that influence client decision-making. 
 Whether advising on corporate tax matters, supporting international businesses or helping individuals plan for the future, you'll contribute to projects that have a real impact on our clients. 
 What You Will Do 
 As a Graduate Trainee within Tax, you'll work closely with experienced professionals on a variety of client engagements. 
 You may have the opportunity to: 
 Support clients with tax compliance and reporting obligations. 

 Assist in the preparation of tax returns and related filings. 

 Research tax legislation and analyse technical tax matters. 

 Support advisory projects across a range of tax disciplines. 

 Work with multinational organisations on international tax matters. 

 Assist with transaction and restructuring-related tax projects. 

 Participate in client meetings and technical discussions. 

 Analyse financial information and identify tax implications. 

 Prepare reports, presentations and client deliverables. 

 Collaborate with colleagues across Tax, Audit and Advisory teams. 

 The Experience You Will Gain 
 You'll gain exposure to both compliance and advisory work, allowing you to build a strong foundation across multiple areas of tax. 
 How We Will Support Your Development 
 At Grant Thornton, we are committed to helping our people realise their potential. 
 As a Tax Graduate, you'll benefit from: 
 Structured learning and development programmes. 

 Professional qualification support. 

 Dedicated mentoring and coaching. 

 Technical tax and legislative training. 

 Study leave and exam support. 

 Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders. 

 Access to The Academy training programme. 

 Clear pathways for long-term career development. Our culture encourages curiosity, collaboration and continuous learning, providing graduates with the support needed to succeed. 

 Who We're Looking For 
 We welcome applications from graduates across a broad range of disciplines who are interested in business, problem-solving and advisory services. 
 Successful candidates will demonstrate: 
 · Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

 Attention to detail and a commitment to quality. 

 Curiosity for tax and business. 

 A proactive and collaborative mindset. 

 Strong organisational and time management skills. 

 The ability to solve complex problems and think commercially. 

 A minimum 2.1 degree, or expected equivalent, in any discipline. 

 It would also be helpful if you have 
 Experience gained through an internship, part-time role, volunteering, university society or team-based project. 

 An interest in how organisations change, improve services or make better use of technology. 

 Join Us 
 Join Grant Thornton's Tax team and help clients navigate an increasingly complex tax landscape. You’ll gain practical experience, develop specialist expertise and build the skills needed to become a trusted advisor while supporting organisations across Ireland and beyond. 
 Location and working arrangement: Cork office, primarily office-based. 
 Application and selection process: Apply through link - complete our application form and upload your current CV. Closing date Thursday 22 October 2026. Selection process early November 2026. Start date Autumn 2027. 
 Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.

Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded lead

 Job Description:  The Role and Impact: 
Become an integral part of Intel's manufacturing operations, where innovation meets precision. As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a pivotal role in crafting high-quality products that drive the future of technology. Working alongside a dynamic, high-performing team, you will ensure the seamless operation of production processes, helping Intel maintain its position as an industry leader. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge equipment, optimize production efficiencies, and see the tangible impact of your contributions on the world around you.
 
 This role is a shift based role. Candidates must have ability to work on a monthly rotating shift pattern. Exact shift details are shared during interview stage. 

 Key Responsibilities :
 Operate and monitor production equipment to ensure adherence to manufacturing standards and procedures.

 Conduct routine maintenance, diagnostics, and troubleshooting of manufacturing equipment to resolve production challenges effectively.

 Perform functions associated with wafer production, including equipment handling, process training, and defect reduction.

 Implement adjustments to machinery and equipment settings to optimize production efficiency and output quality.

 Collaborate with peers and management to meet production targets and escalate issues promptly when output schedules are at risk.

 Maintain production logs and required documentation following Standard Operating Procedures.

 Drive quality improvements and cost optimization efforts in partnership with engineering teams.

 Conduct quality control evaluations, including inspections of raw materials and finished products, to ensure compliance with established standards.

 Utilize technical manuals, schematics, and diagnostic tools to perform tasks with precision.

 Support the installation, qualification, maintenance, and training activities for new or reused production equipment.

 NFQ Certificate (Level 6) or Diploma/Ord Bachelors/Higher Certificate (Level 7) or (Level 8) in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical/Electronic, Aircraft Systems, Process Technology, Physics, Instrumentation, Advanced Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Maths, or Chemical Process, or completion of a Trades Apprenticeship.

title: Associate Trading Operations Executive - Racing
description:
Are you ready to ignite your career with the World’s largest sports betting and iGaming company? Flutter UKI are on the hunt for passionate individuals to join our dynamic team as Trading Operations Execs! We are seeking an individual who is eager to join and contribute to our high-performing team. If you have a passion for excellence and a collaborative approach to work, then we would love to hear from you! 
 We are the Flutter UK & Ireland Trading Team - we power performance, we think differently, and we drive the best customer experiences to keep our Paddy Power, Betfair and Sky Betting & Gaming brands at number one. Trading Operations is an excellent place to advance your career, offering exposure to all parts of the Sportsbook and wider UKI division. You’ll receive all the support you need to enhance and develop your skills in analytics, product management, people leadership, and beyond! If this sounds like the amazing opportunity you are looking for then please read on… 
 The Role 
   As an Exec in the Racing Operations Team, you will be part of a dynamic team that provides an industry leading product across both the sportsbook and the Betfair Exchange. You will ensure continuous improvement of the UKI Racing product for our 3 UKI brands across the full product lifecycle, from market creation and live management right through to issue resolution, making quality real-time decisions to enhance customer satisfaction and business performance. You will play a key role in driving operational excellence while fostering a customer-obsessed culture. You’ll work closely with teams across the business to continuously improve our product offering and internal processes. 
 What you’ll do 
 Form part of a team that takes responsibility for the UKI Racing products across both Sportsbook and Exchange, spanning market creation, settlement, post-settlement, issue resolution and retrospective reporting & analysis. 
 Customer First Always – The customer is at the heart of everything you do. You’ll make decisions with the customer in mind and deliver amazing experiences. 
 
 Innovate - Actively seek new ideas and collaborate with colleagues to improve internal processes  and offer an innovative and exciting betting experiences. 
 
 Problem Solving - The role demands a critical and solution-oriented problem solver, focused on continuously improving the experience of our customers refusing to accept the status quo. 
 
 Collaborating across various departments, including Tech, Global Trading, Commercial, Customer Service, Product, Premium & Liquidity teams to drive operational improvements. 
 
 The role demands a critical and solution-oriented problem solver, focused on continuously improving the experience of our customers. 
 
 Actively seek new ideas and collaborate with colleagues to offer an innovative and exciting betting experience to over 1 million customers. 
 
 Opportunity to specialise or work across a range of trading operations facets. You don’t need to be an expert. We value curiosity and a desire to learn above all else. 
 
 Constantly seek value add opportunities for our business whilst also looking to deliver more efficient operations for our customers. 
 
   
 What we’re looking for 
 Strong understanding of the Flutter Brands and sportsbook/exchange products or a willingness to rapidly develop expertise. 
 Customer focused, always. Proactive and methodical approach to identifying and resolving issues both for our customers and our business and delivering experiences that delights Betfair customers. 
 
 Analytical. The ability to think critically, solve problems creatively, and understand complex data. You know how to dissect problems and devise effective solutions using technical tooling in the process. 
 
 Outstanding attention to detail, ensuring all aspects of trading operations are meticulously handled. 
 
 Exceptional decision maker. Particularly in fast paced, high-pressure situations. 
 
 Strong organisational skills. Demonstrated ability to balance multiple tasks simultaneously which is crucial in delivering projects on time and to a high standard. 
 
 Excellent communicator who actively seeks out and shares knowledge with colleagues across the team and wider department. 
 
 An individual who understands brand & department strategies to allow them to make meaningful contributions as a Trading Operations Executive. 
 
 Solution orientated. Someone who has experience in identifying pain points in current processes and proposes solutions to address these. 
 
 Individual who interacts in an inclusive way with the rest of the team, demonstrating respect for different opinions or viewpoints. 
 
 Growth mindset. A keen interest in personal and professional development. You are committed to expanding your skills within and beyond your current role, demonstrating a dedication to lifelong learning and growth. 
 
 Availability during peak Racing hours, including Evenings & Weekends 
 
 Who we are 
 We are Flutter UK & Ireland. Leaders in betting, gaming, and entertainment. We are the home of big-hitting brands including Sky Betting & Gaming, Paddy Power, Betfair and tombola. We are thousands of colleagues. Across 6 locations. In 5 countries. We play as one trailblazing team. 
 Creating trusted entertainment for millions every week. Sharing ideas, expertise, and technology. Innovating in one of the most Competitive and most regulated markets in the world. 
 As a division of Flutter Entertainment, we all work together to win. 
 What we’ll offer you 
 Flexible ways of working – Hybrid work arrangement that supports your wellbeing. 
 £/€1,000 learning fund Twice-yearly bonus (with part of it guaranteed!) 
 
 Pension contribution scheme 
 
 Private healthcare 
 
 Access to thousands of Udemy courses 
 
 Invest via the Company Sharesave Scheme 
 
 16 hours paid volunteering time per year. 
 
 Unlimited holiday 
 
 About Flutter   
 
 Flutter is the world’s leading online sports betting and iGaming operator, with a market leading position in the US and across the world. Our ambition is to change our industry for the better, making use of our significant scale and challenger mentality.  
 
 By Changing the Game, we believe we can deliver long-term growth while promoting a positive, sustainable future for the industry. We are well-placed to do so through the distinctive, global advantages of the Flutter Edge, which gives our brands access to group-wide benefits to stay ahead of the competition, as well as our clear vision for sustainability through our Positive Impact Plan.  
 
 Flutter operates a diverse portfolio of leading online sports betting and iGaming brands including FanDuel, Sky Betting & Gaming, Sportsbet, PokerStars, Paddy Power, Sisal, tombola, Betfair, MaxBet, Junglee Games and Adjarabet.  
 
 About Flutter UK & Ireland   
 
 The UK & Ireland region of Flutter unites some of the biggest brands in the betting and gaming industry; Betfair, Paddy Power, PokerStars, Sky Betting & Gaming and tombola.  
 
 At Flutter UK & Ireland, we strive for the next level and drive innovation to set the pace as leaders, putting our  customers first, always . We  win together  through team spirit and unparalleled dedication. When we’re  free to be ourselves , we thrive and unleash our unique talents —creating a culture that empowers our people to  change the game.  We see opportunity everywhere and there is always more to discover...  
 
 We’re working to be an inclusive employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking and working to apply. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don't have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role.  
 
 If you need any adjustments to make this role work for you let us know, and we’ll see how we can accommodate them.

description:
About Us 
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game. 
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries. 
 But we don’t stop there. 
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.  
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind. 
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together. 
 Requirements 
 Requirements 
 Applicants are required to have completed a Degree, Diploma, or equivalent qualification within the 24 months prior to September 2026.
 
 Our Promise To You   
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our clients needs.   
 
 What we value is at the CORE of how we succeed:  
 C ollaboration: Working together to achieve our best 
 O utcomes: Drive Success in every engagement  
 R espect: A collective feeling of inclusion and belonging 
 E xcellence: Continuously raising the bar 
 Benefits 
 What’s In It For You? 
 Healthcare cover through the VHI
 Company pension contribution
 Life assurance/ Income protection
 23 days annual leave
 3 company days
 Annual bonus opportunity
 Work From Home set-up allowance
 Opportunity to work with clients and colleagues on a global scale for a world leader in Client Lifecycle Management
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work from home policy, bike to work scheme, sports and social committee, weekly fitness and sports classes and much more
 Buddy system for all new starters
 Collaborative working environment
 Extensive training programs, classroom and online, through ‘Fenergo University’
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest of tools and technologies
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you see and assess your own career development and progress.
 Active sports and social club
 State of the art offices in the heart of Dublin’s Docklands with great facilities, canteen and games area
  
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity  
 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Role Overview: The role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining backend data pipelines and analytical datasets that support large‑scale business operations. The position focuses on advanced SQL development, ETL processes, and data modelling , along with analytical insights and dashboard creation using Google’s data ecosystem.
The role works closely with stakeholders, handling structured data at scale and enabling data‑driven decision‑making through reliable, well‑governed datasets and dashboards.
It is a core backend data engineering and analytics role .
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Data Engineering & ETL
Design, develop, and maintain robust SQL‑based data pipelines supporting ETL workflows.
Work extensively on advanced SQL (Google SQL / BigQuery‑style SQL) for data extraction, transformation, and aggregation.
Develop and optimize PLX scripts for backend data processing and automation.
Data Analysis & Analytics Enablement
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights relevant to business and operational needs.
Translate analytical requirements into optimized datasets and data models .
Partner with cross‑functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Build and maintain PLX dashboards and analytical views for stakeholders.
Develop dashboards using Looker Studio (preferred) for insights and performance monitoring.
Ensure dashboards are accurate, scalable, and aligned to defined metrics and business logic.
Education
Any Graduate (Engineering / Computer Science / Mathematics / Statistics preferred)
Experience
Must Have
4–6 years of hands‑on experience in backend data engineering or analytics roles
Strong experience working with advanced SQL in large‑scale data environments
Proven experience with ETL processes and data pipeline development
Experience working in structured, process‑driven environments supporting enterprise clients
Technical Skills
Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning)
Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data modeling, and data transformations
Hands‑on experience with PLX scripts and PLX dashboards
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
Good to Have
Experience with Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
Google Apps Script for automation
Looker Studio for dashboarding and analytics
Programming/scripting experience in Python, JavaScript, or VBA

The Finance Division is responsible for all financial and management reporting processes across Bank of Ireland Group. This three-year programme, structured around three rotations, is designed to equip graduates with the critical skills needed to accelerate their professional development and career growth.

 Programme overview 
 As a graduate, you'll develop strong management, interpersonal, and technical skills while working on business-critical projects in a fast-paced environment. You'll be encouraged to seek new experiences, collaborate across teams, and contribute to meaningful transformation initiatives that support our Group strategy.

 The opportunity 
 
 Involvement in internal management reporting and external financial reporting, including interim and annual statutory accounts, pre-close statements, published accounts, and investor briefings.

 Development of expertise in management information (MI), data analytics, and deep product knowledge in areas such as treasury and financial instruments, risk management, balance sheet strategy, and capital requirements.

 Opportunities to work with colleagues across various levels and divisions, helping you build a strong professional network.

 Regular engagement with senior leadership, including the CEO and Executive Committee.

 Access to our Digital Academy and Mentorship Programme, offering guidance and insight into future career paths.

 A potential pathway into Bank of Ireland's talent programmes, designed to fast-track high-potential individuals.

 
 What you'll gain 
 
 A deep understanding of financial reporting in a large, publicly listed company, with a focus on internal controls and SOX compliance.
Significant support in pursing a professional accountancy qualification (a requirement for programme applicants).

 A tailored Graduate Development Programme combining virtual and in-person training, covering topics such as relationship management, business promotion, presentation skills, and financial well-being.

 A flexible hybrid working model that gives you the best of both worlds, combining home working with access to our network of offices and agile hubs across the country. Most hybrid roles require a minimum of 8 in-office days per month, with specific arrangements confirmed during the recruitment stage.
