Role Overview
The Bid Operations Executive plays a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of the Cpl Group Bids & Tenders function. The role owns the operational coordination and infrastructure that enables the business to identify, manage, and submit high-quality tender responses in a structured and efficient manner. Acting as the central coordination point across the full bid lifecycle, the Bid Operations Executive ensures tender opportunities are identified, logged, and progressed through the pipeline, while maintaining oversight of timelines, documentation, compliance requirements, and submission processes. This role requires excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent processes while coordinating input from a wide range of internal stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Tender Opportunity Management
Monitor relevant tender portals and procurement platforms to identify new public and private sector opportunities.
Review tender notices and determine applicability in collaboration with the Bids & Tenders team.
Log all relevant opportunities in Salesforce and internal tracking tools such as Monday.com.
Own and maintain the central bid pipeline tracker, ensuring all opportunities are accurately recorded and kept up to date.
Central Mailbox Management
Manage the central Bids & Tenders mailbox(s), ensuring all incoming communications, tender alerts, documentation requests, and queries are reviewed and actioned promptly.
Prioritise and distribute items to bid owners or appropriate stakeholders.
Ensure no opportunities, deadlines, or key communications are missed.
Bid Process Coordination
Schedule and coordinate bid planning meetings, progress reviews, and submission sign-off meetings.
Attend meetings, capture notes, actions, and timelines, and circulate these to relevant stakeholders.
Monitor tender timelines and proactively track progress across active bids.
Follow up with relevant teams to ensure deadlines are met and required inputs are delivered on time.
Stakeholder Coordination
Support the bid writer in coordinating the gathering of content, messaging, and supporting materials to ensure responses are clear, accurate, and aligned with company positioning.
Track outstanding content contributions and follow up proactively where required.
Identify and flag risks where timelines or submission quality may be impacted, escalating to the Senior Manager where necessary.
Compliance & Documentation Management
Maintain the organisation’s mandatory tender documentation library, including insurance certificates, company policies, accreditations and certifications, and standard company information and responses.
Track renewal dates and ensure documentation remains current and readily available.
Conduct bid compliance checks prior to submission to ensure all required sections are completed, mandatory documentation is included, files are correctly formatted, and portal submission requirements are met.
Tender Submission Coordination
Coordinate the final submission of tender responses across procurement portals and client systems.
Ensure documents are correctly formatted, labelled, and uploaded in accordance with tender instructions.
Maintain organised records of submitted tenders and supporting documentation.
Bid Intelligence & Reporting
Maintain accurate bid data across systems to support pipeline visibility and reporting.
Support the preparation of bid activity and performance reports.
Track bid outcomes, submission activity, and win/loss data to support future bidding strategy.
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
Contribute ideas and practical solutions to improve bid workflows, documentation management, and cross-team collaboration.
Support initiatives aimed at building a world-class Bids & Tenders function through improved processes, systems, and governance.
Assist with file organisation, documentation structures, and operational improvements to enhance efficiency.
Skills & Experience
Experience in quality, operations, project management, marketing, or commercial support role within a fast-paced business environment.
Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail and strong document management capabilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
Ability to track progress independently and escalate risks when

title: Early Careers FAQ
description:
Skip to main content Early Careers FAQ
We are sure you might have some questions or need further information and we’re happy to help. Below are some commonly asked questions to give you further support.
We understand that this may be one of the first jobs you’ll be applying for, and that can be a very nerve-wracking experience! We’ve collated the most frequently asked questions to help with the application process and eligibility.
Am I eligible to apply?
I am currently on a Tier 4 Student Visa and will be entitled to a 2 or 3 year Post Study Working Visa (PSWV). Am I eligible to apply?
At the moment, Azets do not sponsor students after their Post Study Work Visa expires. Therefore, we are unable to consider applicants that hold this type of visa.
I finished university 4 years ago and am looking for a change in career. Can I apply to a graduate programme?
Yes absolutely! We do not have a set time frame post-graduation, so you can apply to us in your final year of university, or any time after you have graduated.
Do I need to have studied accounting & finance or maths to be eligible?
No, we encourage students from all walks of life. Some of our trainees have studied music, optometry, geography and languages. All you need is a passion for a career in your chosen field.
I didn’t achieve the educational requirements, but I believe this was due to extenuating circumstances. Can I still apply?
Of course, we are happy to consider any extenuating circumstances when considering your application. Just ensure you complete the relevant section on your application form. This will then be reviewed by a recruiter, who may call you for further information. A decision will be made on a case-by-case basis as to whether to allow you to continue with your application.
Rules and process of applying
I require adjustments during the recruitment process, how do I communicate this?
We have a section dedicated to this on our application form. Please be reassured that disclosing any personal information will not impact your likelihood of success in any way. This information will only be used to make reasonable adjustments, such as extra time for assessments. Please fill in the form honestly and provide us with details of adjustments that have been helpful to you previously.
What is the difference between a “School or College leaver” and a “graduate” job?
The difference is the type of person we are looking for. A school or college leaver is someone who does  not  hold an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. There is no age limit on who constitutes as a school leaver, you just cannot have a degree. We often hire school leavers who are seeking a career change, +10 years after leaving school.
A graduate job requires you to have at least an undergraduate degree, either BSc or BA. Please note, we do not accept “equivalents” to degrees. Most of our positions require you to have achieved a 2:1 in your undergraduate degree.
What is the recruitment/assessment process?
What tasks will I be asked to do? Check out our Recruitment Application process page here for a full break down of what to expect as well as some top tips for success!
I was unsuccessful in my application, when can I reapply?
You can apply to Azets once per Campus Calendar year. This runs from 1st September to the 31st August. For example, if you apply on the 27th September 2025, you can reapply on the 1st September 2026.
Can I apply for more than 1 position at once?
No, we ask that you pick your preferred position and apply to only this one. If you apply to multiple vacancies, your application may be rejected.
Learn more about our careers
Current Opportunities
We offer trainee routes across our service lines including Audit, Accounting, Tax and more.
Our Application Process
We aim to make your career start at Azets as smooth as possible. That's why we've created a guide to help you understand our Talent Acquisition process.
Read more
Professional Pathways
We are an AAT Accredited Employer, ICAS/ICAEW approved training provider and an ACA/ACCA platinum level accredited firm. Explore our variety of professional pathways.
Our latest news
Find a specialist
Join our team
"Our team is incredibly supportive, which has allowed me to balance my work and chartered accounting (ACA) studies to develop as a young professional. I work in an environment which welcomes continuous learning and allows for employees to develop and shape their career to align with their personal goals.”
Tom Morgan
Associate, Audit

Job Description:
Role Purpose
The purpose of this role is to conduct audits to ensure quality compliance within the account.
Essential skills:
College graduate
2 to 4 Years of banking contact Center experince
Basic Understanding of Quality methodologies like Six Sigma, Lean, kaizen etc.
Excellent Communication & feedback/ coaching Skills
Proficient at MS office Applications like PowerPoint, Excel etc.
Willingness to work in shifts
Excellent oral and written communication and listening skills
Exposure to UK Banking / other vertical Collections
Responsibilities:
Audit the number of cases / calls as mandated by the client and track performance
Review calls/completed cases for adherence to internal/regulatory guidelines
Record feedback on Agents & his/her areas of improvements
Bring in necessary changes to the process and constant updation of core process
Attend calibrations sessions both internal and with the clients
Collaborate with supervisors to share quality performance issues and provide regular reports on overall performance and trends
Identify and support other opportunities for quality improvement across the team
Develop materials and process documentation to support training as and when required
Documenting quality issues, performance measures and quality improvements for management reviews
Create quality score cards to track performance level
Sharing feedback and briefings to associates to improve their quality
Coordinating and facilitate calibrations
Able to identify the Root cause and share observations with Operations
Should have knowledge on 7 QC tools
Must have a good knowledge on ExcelTNA/TNI/TTQRAG analysis and BQM to identify bottom performers and support management

Experience: 1-3 Years .

title: Data, Technology and Change Graduate Programme 2027
description:
Transforming the Bank is a key strategic priority for Bank of Ireland. At the heart of this transformation are our technology platforms, data capabilities, and the digital interfaces our customers use to interact with and purchase our products.

 As Ireland's largest bank, we're responding to the growing demand for digital-first financial services by expanding and evolving our technological foundation. We're building a world-class, diverse technology team to deliver meaningful improvements in the banking experience for millions of customers - and we're looking for talented individuals to help us drive that momentum.

 Programme overview 
 Our graduate programme offers a rotational experience across different areas of the Bank. Each of the three rotations is built to help you develop the critical skills needed to accelerate your growth and career progression.

 Throughout the programme, you'll strengthen your management, interpersonal, and technical capabilities while contributing to business-critical projects in a fast-paced environment. You'll be empowered to explore new experiences, collaborate across teams, and support transformation initiatives aligned with our Group strategy.

 The opportunity 
 
 You'll gain practical experience across key disciplines, including Data Science, Data Visualisation, Data Engineering, Project Management and Business Analysis.

 Opportunities to work with colleagues across various levels and divisions, helping you build a strong professional network.

 Access to our Digital Academy and Mentorship Programme, offering guidance and insight into future career paths.

 Regular engagement with senior leadership, including the CEO and Executive Committee.

 A potential pathway into Bank of Ireland's talent programmes, developed to fast-track high-potential individuals.

 
 What you'll gain 
 
 A tailored Graduate Development Programme combining virtual and in-person training, covering topics such as relationship management, business promotion, presentation skills, and financial well-being.

 A flexible hybrid working model that gives you the best of both worlds, combining home working with access to our network of offices and agile hubs across the country. Most hybrid roles require a minimum of 8 in-office days per month, with specific arrangements confirmed during the recruitment stage. 

 
 Who We're Looking For 
 We welcome applicants from all academic disciplines and backgrounds. What matters most is your curiosity, drive, and potential to grow with us.

 Minimum Requirements: 

 
 Undergraduate or Master's degree (achieved or expected) in any subject area.

 
 

 #LI-DNI 

 

 We're on a continuous journey to build an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, lived experience, abilities and perspectives. We provide reasonable accommodations at every stage of our recruitment process for disabilities, neurodivergence or medical conditions. If you require an accommodation please complete this form and one of our recruitment team members will be in touch via email.

Any information provided will be treated as confidential within the recruitment team and used only for the purpose of determining and providing appropriate accommodations for the application and recruitment process.

 Where Agency assistance is required Bank of Ireland Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to Bank of Ireland by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role.

title: Reinsurance Finance Analyst
description:
The Allianz Group is a global financial services provider with services predominantly in the insurance and asset management business. Allianz SE, the parent company, is headquartered in Munich, Germany. Allianz has established a specialist subsidiary company for Reinsurance P&C business in Dublin, Allianz Re Dublin Dac (‘the Company') . The Company's premises are at Allianz House, Elmpark, Merrion Road, Dublin 4.

The Opportunity 

Allianz Reinsurance is seeking a Reinsurance Finance Analyst (P&C) to join their finance team. The roles requires a finance professional (reinsurance/insurance) with a structured, analytical mindset and the ambition to help shape how finance processes work, not simply operate them. The role sits at the intersection of reinsurance accounting, business understanding, and process improvement, with a strong focus on challenging existing ways of working and building better, more scalable solutions. 

The role holder will collaborate and contribute as part of a global team, working closely with internal and external stakeholders including cedents, retrocessionaries, vendors, banks and local authorities. A key part of the role is to understand the underlying reinsurance transactions, connect commercial substance with accounting, tax and reporting requirements, and translate this into robust, efficient and well-controlled processes. 

This position is suited to someone who enjoys change, takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and is motivated by making things better. The role is within a continuously growing reinsurance company and provides strong opportunities to develop across finance, reinsurance and transformation

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Support the delivery of accurate, well-controlled accounting and reporting outputs for reinsurance business under different accounting and regulatory regimes, including IFRS 17 and Solvency II. 

  • Understand how the commercial and technical characteristics of reinsurance transactions are reflected in accounting, tax, regulatory and reporting treatments across different regimes. 

  • Analyse reinsurance structures, data flows and operational processes to ensure that accounting and reporting processes reflect the economic substance of the underlying business. 

  • Challenge existing processes, identify weaknesses or inefficiencies, and drive practical improvements that increase quality, transparency, control and scalability. 

  • Take ownership of complex topics from problem definition through to implementation, working independently while keeping colleagues and stakeholders appropriately involved. 

  • Contribute to finance transformation initiatives, including process documentation, data analytics, automation and the sensible use of AI or digital tools where they support better outcomes. 

  • Collaborate and contribute in a global team, managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders including Allianz Group, Allianz Re SE, cedents, retrocessionaries and local authorities. 

  • Support management reporting for local committees and Board meetings, translating complex technical matters into clear, decision-useful information. 

  • Support day to day activities as part of a reinsurance finance team. 

Key Requirements / Skills & Experience 

Essential: 

  • Relevant experience in reinsurance/ non life insurance finance is essential, preferably gained in accounting, while strong candidates from actuarial, controlling or financial reporting will also be considered. 

  • Experience with IFRS 17, Solvency II,  and reinsurance accounting  is strongly preferred. 

  • Strong technical and quantitative background, with the ability to understand complex reinsurance structures, data flows and financial impacts. 

  • Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to question existing processes, identify root causes and develop practical solutions. 

  • Comfortable working with data and tools (including AI) such as Excel; experience with Power BI, automation or workflow tools would be an advantage. 

  • Highly motivated, self-organised and comfortable taking responsibility in an environment where priorities, processes and requirements continue to evolve. 

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly and work constructively across teams, functions and locations. 

Desirable: 

  • At Allianz Reinsurance, we are committed to embracing innovation and the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and business success. We are seeking candidates who demonstrate curiosity, adaptability and have a proactive approach to learning and development. An awareness of AI-powered tools, data-driven decision making and data analysis will be highly valued. 

 

 

Regulatory Notice: 

Appointment to this role will be subject to the requirements provided for by the Central Bank of Ireland. Please refer to the Central Bank of Ireland’s Guidance on Minimum Competency Code: Minimum Competency | Central Bank of Ireland as well as F&P Standards and the Corporate Governance Requirements: Fitness & Probity | Central Bank of Ireland. This includes the requirements provided for by the Central Bank Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. The successful candidate will be provided with the relevant Conduct Standards (including Additional Conduct Standards) training, where required. Full details are available via the Central Bank website: Individual Accountability Framework  | Central Bank of Ireland. 

Allianz Re Dublin Dac. is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland.

SAP S/4 HANA Senior Finance Business Analyst
An opportunity has arisen for a  S/4 HANA Senior Finance Business Analyst  within Glanbia Enterprise Solutions. This role will be based in  Kilkenny, Ireland or CityWest, Dublin, with a hybrid working arrangement available through our Smart Working model, offering greater flexibility and work-life balance. The successful candidate will report to the  a Product Owner within our Digital Finance Team and will be voice of technical expertise in the team while interacting with the rest of the Glanbia business.
Key Elements of the Role
Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement of SAP FI/CO solutions and related Finance systems.
Own design decisions for one or more core finance processes such as:
Record-to-Report (R2R): GL, journals, allocations, intercompany, close, consolidation integration.
Order-to-Cash (O2C): customer accounting, revenue recognition touchpoints, credit management integration (as applicable).
Procure-to-Pay (P2P): vendor accounting, invoice processing, payments, withholding taxes, approvals integration.
Asset Accounting (AA): capitalization, depreciation, transfers, retirements, integration with procurement
Controlling (CO): Margin analysis, profitability reporting, product costing, allocations optimization.
S/4 HANA transformation: Fiori, simplification items, parallel accounting.
Translate business requirements into scope documents, blueprints, functional specifications and collaborate with programming teams for enhancements, forms, interfaces, workflows, and reports.
What background and experience are we looking for?
At least 10 year’s SAP implementation and configuration experience with multiple lifecycle implementations
Ideally a Qualified Accountant with relevant Finance process knowledge & experience.
Strong expertise across the SAP finance domain: FI (GL/AP/AR/AA) and CO (CCA/PCA/IO/COPA, allocations) in either SAP ECC or S/4 HANA.
Basic ABAP coding knowledge, while not essential would be an advantage.
Core competencies
Experience in addressing key business issues with IT solutions
Ability to display a high degree of professionalism in dealing with business managers and users.
Commercially focused, high levels of enthusiasm and energy.
Flexibility to undertake international travel where required.
The energy, enthusiasm and drive to make it happen.
A team player who has the ability to motivate others, making it fun while getting the job done.
Enjoys working in a fast-paced, innovative environment where the focus is on continuous improvement and the challenge to make it better.
Competence in Training is a plus
Excellent communications skills including listening skills a distinct advantage
Our Purpose & Values
At Glanbia we are dedicated to delivering better nutrition for every step of life’s journey. We differentiate ourselves by doing not only what is right for our business, but also what is good for our people and the communities in which we live and work. So if you’re looking to develop your career, stretch your ambitions and work for a company that has the ability to succeed on the world stage, ours is a journey you’ll want to share.
At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a wide variety of candidates, and we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: Equity Research Analyst
description:
Overview 

 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. 
  
 As an Analyst on Susquehanna’s Research team, you will partner with our senior analysts and traders to identify investment opportunities in the equity or options market. Research analysts provide real-time opinions on breaking news and in-depth analysis of future volatility events. You will be responsible for finding opportunities that other market participants may not be capitalizing on, either by discovering new information or considering existing knowledge from a different perspective. Analysts are embedded in a sector-focused trading desk and the analysis you provide will directly impact trading decisions. 
  
 At Susquehanna we place a high value on education and development. You will experience this dedication to training first hand as you work collaboratively with the research analysts and traders on your desk to gain the practical exposure needed to perform your daily responsibilities. You will also learn about options and the decision-making strategies that our traders employ. This role provides the unique opportunity to combine the quantitative aspects of finance with creative problem solving in order to develop trade ideas in a fast paced proprietary trading environment. 
    
 What you’ll be doing: 
 Identifying and analysing upcoming volatility events 
 Providing real-time opinions on breaking news 
 Forecasting dividends 
 Evaluating special situations such as mergers and acquisitions and other corporate actions 
 Collaborating with derivative traders on investment ideas 
 Traveling to company events and conferences as required 
 Performing stock valuation analysis 
 
 What we're looking for 

 Minimum of a Bachelor's degree 
 3 years’ + experience in financial markets or progress towards CFA qualification an advantage 
 Strong written, analytical, and financial research skills 
 Demonstrable interest in, and some knowledge of, macroeconomic environment and political events 
 Ability to prioritize and complete multiple tasks in a fast paced, dynamic environment 
 Familiarity with a trading environment and derivative products preferred 
 Must be a self-starter, a quick learner, an effective communicator, and resourceful in solving problems 
 Willingness to work additional and flexible hours when necessary

title: Event Driven Research Analyst
description:
Overview 

 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. 
  
 As an analyst on Susquehanna’s Research team, you will partner with our senior analysts and traders to identify investment opportunities in the equity or options market. Research analysts provide real-time opinions on breaking news and in-depth analysis of future events. You will be responsible for finding opportunities that other market participants may not be capitalising on, either by discovering new information or considering existing knowledge from a different perspective. Analysts are embedded in a strategy-focused trading desk and the analysis you provide will directly impact trading decisions. 
   
 At Susquehanna, we place a high value on education and development. You will experience this dedication to training as you work collaboratively with the research analysts and traders on your desk to gain hands-on exposure. You will also learn about options and the decision-making strategies that our traders employ. This role provides the unique opportunity to combine the quantitative aspects of finance with creative problem-solving in order to develop trade ideas in a fast-paced, proprietary trading environment. 
   
 What you’ll be doing 
 Evaluating and tracking special situations such as mergers, acquisitions, and other corporate actions 
 Identifying and analysing upcoming events 
 Providing real-time opinions on breaking news 
 Collaborating with traders on investment ideas 
 Traveling to company events and conferences as required 
 Performing stock valuation analysis

 Minimum of a bachelor's degree 
 Minimum 1 year Experience 
 CFA or part-qualified CFA Candidate preferred 
 Strong written, analytical, and financial research skills 
 Ability to prioritize and complete multiple tasks in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
 Prior exposure to fundamental company research and event driven analysis an advantage 
 Familiarity with a trading environment and derivative products preferred 
 A self-starter, quick learner, effective communicator, and problem solver 
 Willingness to work additional and flexible hours when necessary

About the role
The role will lead on all Tax activities for countries Such as Uruguay, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Costa Rica and supporting Finance activities: monthly and annual closing, review of income, costs, and margin. Processing of Journals.
Co-defines and leads the tax strategy for the Americas , partnering with Regional Sales and Finance leadership to ensure alignment with business objectives while optimizing tax efficiency and compliance across jurisdictions.
Ensures full compliance and governance over all tax matters , maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, integrity, and timeliness in tax reporting, statutory filings, and regulatory obligations across the region.
Acts as a steward of BT Global’s tax position and risk management , safeguarding the organization through proactive identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax risks while supporting sustainable financial outcomes.
Drives collaboration and consistency in tax practices , serving as a key stakeholder across Country Finance teams in the Americas, global tax functions, business units, and shared service centers (GBS/GFSS) to promote standardization, innovation, and best practices.
What you’ll be doing
Supports the delivery of   a range of tax activities that are covered by existing guidelines in accordance with internal and external regulatory requirements, such as preparing and reviewing, supporting tax calculations and annual corporate tax returns, ensuring its accuracy and completeness upon submission and payment
Analyses and researches the complex tax implications of legislative changes or business decisions and activities and reflects these in tax returns and other tax-related documents as required by law and regulations.
Prepares transfer pricing supporting documents to comply with tax requirements
Supports the building of relationships with external tax authorities and advisers and assists independent auditors and the financial control team on tax and financial audits
Supports the identification and management of risk through regular assessment and diligent execution of controls and mitigations, raising any concerns as appropriate
Supports in the implementation of ways to improve working processes within area of responsibility and communication issues and areas for improvement to business unit/area managers such as through supporting resolution of any data issues impacting productivity or compliance
Keeps knowledge up to date on emerging trends and changes in tax principles and practices, sharing with team members
Supporting annual and monthly closing, take care of Revenue-Cost-Margin, Supporting on external audits.
Essential Skills / Experience
Skills & Experience:
A broad background in corporate tax, indirect tax, withholding tax. Local and international tax regulations. Tax compliance and statutory reporting.
Qualified accountant and Audit background with depth knowledge
Identify tax risk and opportunities
Soft Skills:
Leadership
Hight level of precision to ensure accuracy in tax calculations, filings and reports.
Strong ability to interpret complex tax regulations and financials data
Effective managements of multiple deadlines, strong planning and prioritization capabilities, works effectively with cross-functional temas.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Tax & Finance Control Experience
Experience working in a complex, matrix, commercial and international organisation
Setting and executing on tax and financial control strategy
At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running.  With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI.  If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

Job Description:

The purpose of the role is to provide timely, accurate and quality MIS reports, dashboards to the external & internal stakeholders of account(s) as per the defined process and standards of security and compliance
Prepare timely and accurate MIS reports and dashboards as required by the stakeholders
Interact and work closely with management, internal stakeholders & clients to understand the business information needs

Customer Service Representative Dundalk
Location:
Dundalk, IE
Company:
Irish Life Financial Services Limited
•    Full Time Permanent positions available
•    Hybrid role based in our Dundalk office
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here   Benefits (life-careers.com)
At Irish Life, our purpose is to help people build better futures. Our company values shape everything we do and underpin our vision of being the driving force behind Ireland’s financial, physical, and mental well-being.
We believe in doing the right thing —acting with integrity and making fair, responsible decisions. We aim high , setting ambitious goals and find better ways to innovate and improve. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do and we are dedicated to understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.  Achieving this this is only possible when we work best together —in a supportive, collaborative environment where every idea and contribution is valued.
Background
A rewarding career in Irish Life with opportunities to grow and develop. We have a comprehensive training and development, beginning with an intensive induction training course which is completed over a three -month period, on-site in our office in Dundalk.
Some benefits we offer:
A Hybrid Working Model, following the successful completion of the training program, where you can spend 3 days per week working in the office in Dundalk, and two days working from your home.
Full support to achieve the QFA designation, the gold standard designation for finance professionals, as well as financial rewards for exam success.
A competitive remuneration package which includes a quarterly performance-related bonus scheme.
A clear career path structure where you can potentially gain your first promotion within 12 months.
An Annual Leave package with additional leave days when service milestones are reached, when you have specific life events to celebrate, and when you reach a milestone birthday.
Enhanced paid maternity and paternity leave schemes as well as ‘baby care’ days.
Valuable Company Pension, Death in Service and Income Protection Schemes.
Health and wellness initiatives including access to our Employee Assistance Programme, Digital Doctor, and a fully equipped on-site staff gym.
Role Overview
Due to continued growth and success, we are currently recruiting for both Customer Service Representatives, and Senior Customer Service Representatives in our Customer Centre in Dundalk Co Louth.
Customer Service Representatives will have proven customer service experience, a passion to help people, and a desire to learn about financial services.
Senior Customer Service Representatives will have at least 2 years Customer Service experience, ideally in the Financial Services sector, and hold the Accredited Product Adviser (APA) designation in Life Assurance.
If you feel that you have the right experience for either of these roles, we want to hear from you!   We can help you fulfil your ambition and achieve your career goals in Irish Life.
What you will need to be successful in the role
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, as you will engage with our customers through multiple channels (phone, email, webchat).
A good working knowledge of Word, Excel and Outlook, along with an ability to work with multiple systems, and to learn and adapt to new ones.
A strong drive for results, with a focus on consistently meeting and at times exceeding deadlines, targets and SLAs.
A strong team spirit with a passion and drive to help our customers, and to deliver a best in class customer experience.
An ability to work collaboratively with others across the organisation to meet shared objectives.
An innovative approach to your work, looking out for improvements and making suggestions.
A personal growth mindset, willing to maximise learning from each new opportunity.
Minimum Education Requirements
Leaving Certificate to include Grade H5 in two subjects & Grade H6/O6 or higher in English and Maths, or equivalent.
If you have gone on to achieve a higher diploma or degree in a business-related topic, the minimum Leaving Certificate requirements do not apply.
If more than 3 years since completion of your Leaving Certificate, Minimum Education standards are not applicable, relevant customer service or financial services experience will be considered.
Verification of original Leaving Certificate results or Diploma/Degree will be sought if an offer of employment is made.

title: 2027 Graduate Business Excellence Specialist - Orthopedics
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
Supply Chain Manufacturing 
 
 Job Sub Function: 
Manufacturing Deployment 
 
 Job Category: 
Professional 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Ringaskiddy, Cork, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 Role Title:  Graduate Business Excellence Specialist
 Start Date:  September 2027
 Location:  Cork, Ireland
 
 Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes 
 
 DePuy Synthes, Companies of Johnson & Johnson , is the largest, most comprehensive orthopedic and neurological business in the world, built upon the strong legacies of two great companies. 
 
 DePuy Synthes offer an unparalleled breadth and depth of technology, devices, services and programs in the areas of joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine, neurological, cranio-maxillofacial, power tools and biomaterials. 
 
 Our broad array of inspired, innovative and high-quality offerings helps advance the health and well-being of people around the world. 
 DePuy Synthes, who employ over 1000 people in Cork established its manufacturing facility in Cork in 1997 where it manufactures orthopedic knees and hips. In 2014, DePuy Synthes in Cork won the Shingo Prize for Operational Excellence.
 
 
 JOB PURPOSE: 
 The mission of the Graduate Business Excellence Specialist is to support the development & implementation of Johnson & Johnson Production System to deliver Best in Class performance, working cross functionally and playing a leading role in fostering a culture of continuous improvement to achieve sustainable high standards of manufacturing performance.
 
 The main responsibility will be to work as part of the Business Excellence team under the guidance of the Business Excellence Manager while participating in the Ireland Graduate program.
 
 The role is based within the Cork site Business Excellence Team which serves the Knees, Hips and shoulder markets while supporting Continuous Improvement activities across all areas of the business.
 
 What you’re great at: 
 Interest in Manufacturing processes.

 Interested in learning and how to learn.

 Interested and good at problem solving through critical thinking.

 Willing to take direction from other Business Excellence staff.

 Willing to question and learn from other Business Excellence staff.

 Energetic, enthusiastic and self-motivated.

 Hardworking.

 Great communication and interpersonal skills.

 Willing to work as part of a team towards a common goal.

 
 
 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE 
 Essential: 
 Minimum Bachelors degree in Process Excellence/Engineering, Manufacturing or similar engineering/technology bachelors degree.

 Recent Graduate ( 2026  or due to graduate in  2027 )

 Continuous Improvement / Lean Manufacturing systems concept knowledge

 The ability to work well individually and remotely.

 The ability to adapt to change and develop skills to meet these changes.

 High capability with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.)

 Interest in developing skills, abilities, and career.

 Pro-active, can-do attitude. High level of personal initiative, ability to function autonomously and self-confidence.

 Self-starter with ability to create and develop new relationships quickly, and influence/collaborate to get to desired results.

 Results Orientation/Sense of Urgency – ability to drive to tight timelines.

 Data mining / reporting skills.

 Exposure to Project Management Methodology would be an advantage

 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
€34,800.00 - €55,775.00  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. 
  
 *This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

 Apply your academic learning in a real-world environment.

 Contribute to   meaningful projects that help   people live healthier   lives.

 Why Choose Abbott?   

 At Abbott,   you'll   gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and develop skills that will support your future career.   You'll :

title: Insight Analyst
description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.
 Technology at Primark 
 What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking an Insight Analyst to join its Applied Insights & Analytics team, helping transform data into actionable insights that drive better business decisions and commercial value. Working across areas including Trading, Buying & Merchandising, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, Finance, and Customer teams, the role involves analysing data, identifying opportunities, answering key business questions, and delivering clear, data-driven recommendations. As part of Primark’s innovative technology function, the successful candidate will collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to support business growth, leveraging strong analytical skills and commercial awareness to turn complex data into meaningful outcomes.

 What You’ll Get 
 This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.  

 What You’ll Do as Insight Analyst 
 In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:
 Deliver impactful business insights by partnering with stakeholders to understand commercial challenges, frame key business questions, and translate data into actionable recommendations that drive better decision-making.
 Analyse and interpret complex datasets using SQL, insight applications, and reporting tools to uncover trends, identify risks and opportunities, and support decisions across Trading, Customer, Retail Operations and other commercial functions.
 Create compelling data-driven stories by turning complex analytical outputs into clear, concise insights, visualisations, and recommendations that are easily understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Develop and enhance reporting solutions, including dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting packs, ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, user-friendly, and focused on delivering measurable business value.
 Drive continuous improvement by identifying manual processes, recurring business questions, and opportunities to streamline, standardise, and optimise reporting and insight delivery across the organisation.
 Collaborate with cross-functional Data & Analytics teams, including Business Partners, Senior Analysts, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists, while maintaining strong data quality standards and ensuring trusted, insight-led outcomes that support commercial growth and operational performance.
 

 What You’ll Bring   
 Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular: 
 Experience in analytics, insights, reporting, or commercial analysis within retail, apparel, grocery, FMCG, or other fast-paced consumer-focused environments, with strong SQL skills and the ability to confidently query, analyse, and interpret data to support business decisions.
 Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and analytics tools, with experience creating insightful dashboards, scorecards, KPI frameworks, and performance reporting that drive measurable business outcomes.
 Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect data and analysis to sales growth, conversion, margin improvement, markdown optimisation, stock availability, customer performance, and operational effectiveness.
 Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to transform complex analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives, visualisations, recommendations, and decision-support materials for a wide range of stakeholders.
 Proven stakeholder management and commercial partnering experience, working collaboratively to understand business priorities, challenge assumptions constructively, shape analytical requirements, and deliver actionable insights linked to tangible value and benefits realisation.
 A proactive and solution-focused mindset, comfortable working with imperfect data, applying appropriate quality checks, improving reporting processes, simplifying decision-making, and identifying opportunities to enhance productivity, reporting efficiency, and overall business performance.
 

 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

 
 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing. 
 So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day. 
 You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way. 
 

 #LI-Hybrid

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott Undergraduate Internship   Programme   
 

 Unlock Your Potential at Abbott   

 Looking for an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge, gain hands-on experience, and make a real impact? Abbott's Undergraduate Internship   Programme   offers students the chance to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovations that help people live healthier lives.   
 

 As an Abbott intern,   you'll   gain practical experience in a global healthcare   organisation , develop sought-after skills, and build a strong professional network. Whether your interests lie in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, or other STEM disciplines,   you'll   be supported to learn, grow, and reach your potential.   
 

 Many of our interns go on to secure Graduate opportunities, Professional Development   Programme   positions, and long-term careers across Abbott's sites in Ireland and around the world.   
 

 What You Can Expect   

 As an Abbott intern,   you'll   gain hands-on experience while working on meaningful projects that contribute to healthcare innovation. Depending on your area of study and placement, you may support engineering, manufacturing, scientific, quality, supply chain, business, or technology initiatives that make a real impact.    
 

 What's   in it for you?   

 Apply your academic learning in a real-world environment.   

 
 Gain valuable hands-on experience with a global healthcare leader.   

 
 Contribute to   meaningful projects that help   people live healthier   lives.   

 
 Learn from experienced professionals and receive ongoing mentorship.   

 
 Develop technical, professional, and leadership capabilities.   

 
 Build your network across Abbott's Ireland operations.   

 
 Gain exposure to diverse functions, projects, and career paths.   

 
 Benefit from 6, 9, or 12-month internship opportunities aligned to your academic   programme .   

 
 Explore future opportunities through Abbott's Graduate   Programmes   and long-term career pathways.   

 

 Placement length and location will vary depending on business requirements and academic   programme   requirements.   

   

 About Abbott   

 Abbott is a global healthcare   leader   developing life-changing technologies that help people live healthier lives. With more than 122,000 colleagues serving people in over 160 countries, we deliver innovative solutions across diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and medicines.   
 

 In Ireland, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites, providing interns with the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in world-class STEM and business environments while contributing to healthcare innovation.   
 

 Employment offers are subject to the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening.   
 

 Why Choose Abbott?   

 At Abbott,   you'll   gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and develop skills that will support your future career.   You'll :   

 Contribute to healthcare innovations that improve lives.   

 
 Learn from experienced professionals and industry experts.   

 
 Build valuable skills and expand your professional network.

 Explore future career opportunities within Abbott.   

 

 Our internship   Programme   provides real-world experience, broad exposure, and   a strong foundation   for future career growth.   
 

 Area of Opportunity   

 Depending on business needs and your area of study, you may have the opportunity to gain experience in one or more of the following areas:   
 

 Information Technology (IT)   

 Supporting digital transformation, data analytics, cybersecurity, and technology   initiatives that help drive innovation, enhance business performance, and enable Abbott to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions worldwide.   
 

 Specific assignments will be aligned to business requirements, site needs, and individual development opportunitie s   
 

 What You'll Bring   

 At Abbott,   we're   looking for students with   the curiosity , drive, and ambition to make a difference. Successful candidates will:

 B e pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification in   Engineering, Technology or   another   relevant STEM discipline

About Servaada, a Wipro company:
Servaada is Wipro UK entity, authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), the UK financial services regulator,  to undertake regulated activities on behalf of its clients, as an outsourced service provider.
Job Description:
Role Purpose
This new role establishes the Line 1.5 Investment Administration Risk & Controls function, acting as the operational and analytical bridge between Investment Administration (1LOD) and Compliance (2LOD). The role manages market surveillance, daily controls, reconciliations oversight, reporting, and analytics to ensure all relevant controls are executed before escalation.
Line 1, Line 1.5, and 2LOD Responsibilities
Line 1.5 owns the execution, first‑level review, and documentation of IA and surveillance controls; Line 1 owns operational processing; and 2LOD provides independent oversight and challenge.
This role ensures timely analysis, triage, and escalation, providing structured challenge and insight across IA, Trading Support, Technology, Clients, and Risk functions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Market Surveillance, Controls Operation & Daily Oversight
Execute and document the daily market‑surveillance control suite (price moves, DTV anomalies, news adjacency, peer alignment, liquidity shifts).
Perform first‑level analysis of surveillance alerts, investigate exceptions, and escalate issues promptly where thresholds or patterns indicate concern.
Identify behaviours, anomalies, or themes requiring 2LOD or senior‑management escalation.
2. Reconciliation Oversight
• Oversee all 2‑way and 3‑way reconciliations across positions, pricing, market data, and broker/internal feeds, consolidating break analysis into a single oversight process.
Conduct root‑cause analysis for breaks, provide challenge to IA teams, and ensure appropriate escalation and closure.
3. Reporting, Analytics & Monthly Look‑Back Reviews
Produce daily IA control MI, reconciliation oversight MI, and market‑surveillance analytics.
Lead monthly thematic look‑backs across price behaviours, reconciliation trends, liquidity events, or news‑driven patterns.
Maintain dashboards for IA governance, 2LOD reporting, JRCC, COWG, Board Packs, and Quarterly Compliance MI
4. Investment Administration & Market Operations Expertise
Interpret market events affecting IA (corporate actions, liquidity events, price volatility) and support decision‑making with data‑based insights.
Provide analytical challenge to IA and Trading Support to strengthen operational execution and reduce control failures.
5. Risk Management & Governance
Maintain the IA risk register and control inventory, ensuring clarity of ownership and control frequency.
Identify gaps and drive automation or enhancement of IA controls and data quality.
Ensure clear, timely MI and commentary for 2LOD oversight, senior governance, and client reporting.
6. Stakeholder Engagement
Act as the central coordinating point between IA, Compliance, Technology, Clients, Vendors, and Risk.
Communicate issues, insights, and trends clearly and constructively to stakeholders.
Required Skills & Experience
Strong knowledge of IA, market operations, and UK MAR surveillance indicators.
Experience with control operation, reconciliations, and market‑data analysis.
Strong analytical skills (Excel, modelling, market data) and ability to produce clear MI and challenge.
Excellent communication and the ability to constructively challenge internal and external stakeholders.
Qualifications
Degree in Finance, Economics, Risk, or related discipline (preferred).
Professional certifications desirable (CISI IOC, IMC, surveillance/compliance modules).
3–5+ years in IA, surveillance, risk, trading support, or middle office.
Success Measures (First 6–12 Months)
Effective, timely execution and documentation of daily market surveillance controls.
Strong oversight of reconciliations, with improved turnaround and reduced breaks.
Embedded monthly look‑back reporting with actionable insights.
Clear definition of Line 1 vs 1.5 vs 2LOD responsibilities.
Improved control environment, reduced breaches, and strong audit outcomes.
Equal Opportunities:
Servaada is committed to diversity, equality, and inclusion in the workplace. All applicants welcome.

 START DATE: September 2027

 Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes 
 
 DePuy Synthes, Companies of Johnson & Johnson , is the largest, most comprehensive orthopedic and neurological business in the world, built upon the strong legacies of two great companies. 
 
 DePuy Synthes offer an unparalleled breadth and depth of technology, devices, services and programs in the areas of joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine, neurological, cranio-maxillofacial, power tools and biomaterials. 
 
 Our broad array of inspired, innovative and high-quality offerings helps advance the health and well-being of people around the world. 
 DePuy Synthes, who employ over 1000 people in Cork established its manufacturing facility in Cork in 1997 where it manufactures orthopedic knees and hips. In 2014, DePuy Synthes in Cork won the Shingo Prize for Operational Excellence.
 
 
 POSITION SUMMARY: 
 The Graduate Planner within the Instruments Deployment Group is a key supply chain role, we provide a world class service to our Direct and Affiliate Global markets for the Joints Business Group. The team is also responsible for instrument set planning and governance for OUS markets.
 
 
 ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
 Customer Orders/Requests: 
 Receive and respond to customer orders/requests.

 Will enter orders into the relevant ERP system.

 Research, resolve, and follow through with customer issues/complaints, deal with adverse situations, make effective decisions promptly and inform key partners appropriately.

 Will respond to questions relating to delivery information, credit authorization, pricing, and product specific service-related questions.

 Will liaise with supply partners to obtain and communicate delivery information, sharing information on priorities.

 
 Deliver Effective and Efficient Planning: 
 Ensure planned kit requirements and supplemental order processes are completed accurately and in line with global planning 

 Work with warehouse to manage stock queries, expedite outbound/inbound deliveries and coordinate activity between markets 

 Investigate and root-cause critical supply issues and communicate updates on resolution dates 

 Inventory management in line with agreed GSC targets and processes – taking actions to minimize excess inventory, including managing inventory repatriation, and approving in market returns 

 Drive for continuous improvement to enhance service and implement lean process improvements.

 Coordinate the implementation of New Product Introductions/ Rationalization plans with OUS Markets in line with commercial and project teams.

 
 Market Service Review & Performance Analysis: 
 Represent market supply needs and challenges within the Sales & Operations Planning process.

 Will support ongoing improvements to supply chain efficiency by working closely with markets and monitoring market behaviour with a focus to enhance overall “end customer” service. 

 Proactively manage KPI’s, including OTIF, back-order metrics and ad-hoc process improvement metrics.

 Develop and strengthen team relationships with external and internal customers in accordance with our Instrument Deployment Group, GSC, and Depuy goals and objectives. 

 Initiate & maintain reports and support projects as required.

 Will support the development of Team members through training & coaching

 
 
 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 
 Essential: 
 Minimum Bachelors degree in   Business, Supply Chain, Logistics  or similar   degree

 Recent Graduate ( 2026  or due to graduate in  2027 )

 Continuous Improvement / Lean Manufacturing systems concept knowledge

 The ability to work well individually and remotely.

 The ability to adapt to change and develop skills to meet these changes.

 High capability with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.)

 Interest in developing skills, abilities, and career.

 Pro-active, can-do attitude. High level of personal initiative, ability to function autonomously and self-confidence.

 Self-starter with ability to create and develop new relationships quickly, and   influence/collaborate   to get to desired results.

 Results Orientation/Sense of Urgency – ability to drive to tight timelines.

 Data mining / reporting skills.

 Exposure to Project Management Methodology would be an advantage

 Interested in Manufacturing processes.

 
 
 
 
 
  
  
 Required Skills:

title: Supply Planner

 Initial 12 Month FTC 
 
 Supply Planner - Limerick 
 Hybrid or Onsite (3 day onsite requirement)
 
 Who we want 
 • Detail-oriented process improvers . Critical thinkers who naturally see opportunities to develop and optimize work processes – finding ways to simplify, standardize and automate.
 • Collaborative partners. People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, data and insights to drive continuous improvement in functions.
 • Strategic thinkers . People who enjoy analyzing data or trends for the purposes of planning, forecasting, advising, budgeting, reporting, or sales opportunities.
 
 Role Summary 
 The role will interface with production scheduling, procurement, and customer service to ensure an integrated approach to supply planning within the franchise and take the lead in responding to the demand requirements from the business and ensuring that there is supply plan in place to communicate what needs to be produced and purchased to the manufacturing and supply base within the franchise.
 
 Main Duties & Responsibilities 
 Support the creation of a Master Resource Plan based on the latest demand signal to cover what needs to be produced or purchased as a finished product and to ensure that within the process there is sufficient raw materials and components to support the required supply plan up to a 24-month time horizon

 Support the creation of capacity plans based on the latest demand signal to identify where there are potential bottlenecks or risks to supply and to develop and recommend appropriate proposals to mitigate and to ensure that the plant or 3rd party can meet the future demand. Also identify where there is significant underutilization which could impact the costs of supply.

 Responsibility will be initially scoped to limited number of products /segments of the portfolio and during development phase the individual would be closely monitored and coached into supply planning

 Work under the supervision of the Supply Planning manager in Setting of the correct levels of inventory (safety stocks) within the supply plan by understanding the demand volatility and supply chain lead times

 Tracking of the execution of the supply plan with production scheduling and buying ensuring that the plan is fully operationalized and tracked for performance deviation including mitigation on back orders and pro-active communication of future supply risks.

 Ensuring within the supply plan that products are being phased in and planned correctly as well as ensuring communication and timing of exiting products within the plant or 3rd party. Communicating with the business in regard to the status of the product portfolio from a supply planning perspective.

 Support the Supply Planning Manager in providing effective communication and confirmation back from supply planning to the demand plan in confirming capability to meet the requirements via the daily and weekly execution process but also via a robust monthly executive supply process.

 All Supply Planning system core master-data is maintained to enable focus on real supply issues

 KPIs for the role will be Supply Plan Attainment, Safety Stock Health, Capacity Utilization, Back order and Lead time

 Responsible for root causing performance issues and providing recommendation to Supply Planning Manager /leader on how to mitigate and sustain.

 
 Education & Skills Required 
 Level 8 Degree in Business/Engineering/Supply Chain management

 Minimum of 2 years in either a production, supply or demand planning role where knowledge is demonstrated and experience gained in planning 

 Excellent knowledge of MS Excel

 Strong attention to detail, able to analyze and make sense of large amounts of data that can be presented back to operations.

 Experience in a manufacturing environment would be beneficial

 
   
  
 Ireland Pay Ranges: Ireland : €47,000 - €77,000 EUR Annual

title: Transition Year Programme
description:
With fraud cases increasing, it is important to be alert and aware. By staying vigilant you can help protect yourself from being the victim of fraud.
Transition Year Programme
Inspiring Futures: Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland’s Transition Year Programme
Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland’s Transition Year (TY) Work Placement Programme offers students a unique and immersive introduction to the world of finance and professional services. Designed to inspire, educate, and empower, the programme continues to grow in popularity, earning a reputation as one of the most rewarding TY experiences in the country.
Our programme runs once a year in the spring. The session spans one week and is limited in participants, ensuring a focused and personalised experience. Throughout the week, students take part in interactive workshops, collaborate in project teams, and present their final work to an audience of Cantor Fitzgerald employees, teachers, and family members. On completion, participants receive a certificate of achievement—an excellent addition to any CV and a meaningful way to showcase their experience and skills.
What truly sets the Cantor Fitzgerald TY Programme apart is its emphasis on personal connection and tailored support. Students are placed in small groups and assigned dedicated mentors who guide them through the week. This structure provides a practical, behind-the-scenes view of the financial services sector while fostering meaningful relationships and peer learning. As one student reflected, “We came in as strangers, but left as friends.”
In addition to gaining professional insight, students also develop essential life skills such as communication, public speaking, collaboration, and problem-solving. Parents consistently note the boost in confidence and motivation their children display after the programme, often remarking on the positive impact it has on their outlook and ambitions.
At Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland, we are committed to creating a welcoming, inclusive environment where students are encouraged to step outside their comfort zones, explore new possibilities, and realise their potential—whether in finance or any other field.
Dates for 2026/2027 Academic Year : 12 th – 16 th April 2027
Programme full, cancellation list only
With continued evolution and a strong focus on quality, inclusion, and engagement, our TY Programme is designed to offer an experience that goes beyond careers—fostering confidence, curiosity, and lifelong growth.

Aisling Webb
Loreto College
St Stephen’s Green
Dublin 2

We encourage you to share this exciting opportunity with family, friends, and colleagues who have students currently in TY. It’s a fantastic chance for young people to explore the world of finance, gain real- world experience and build valuable skills for the future.
Students who are interested should complete the application form and include a short letter explaining why they’d like to take part in the programme. The TY programme has now reached capacity.

title: Internship Supply Chain
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott Undergraduate Internship Programme 
 
 Unlock Your Potential at Abbott 
 Looking for an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge, gain hands-on experience, and make a real impact? Abbott's Undergraduate Internship Programme offers students the chance to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovations that help people live healthier lives.
 As an Abbott intern, you'll gain practical experience in a global healthcare organisation, develop sought-after skills, and build a strong professional network. Whether your interests lie in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, or other STEM disciplines, you'll be supported to learn, grow, and reach your potential.
 Many of our interns go on to secure Graduate opportunities, Professional Development Programme positions, and long-term careers across Abbott's sites in Ireland and around the world.
 
 What You Can Expect 
 As an Abbott intern, you'll gain hands-on experience while working on meaningful projects that contribute to healthcare innovation. Depending on your area of study and placement, you may support engineering, manufacturing, scientific, quality, supply chain, business, or technology initiatives that make a real impact.
 
 What's in it for you? 
 Apply your academic learning in a real-world environment.
 Gain valuable hands-on experience with a global healthcare leader.
 Contribute to meaningful projects that help people live healthier lives.
 Learn from experienced professionals and receive ongoing mentorship.
 Develop technical, professional, and leadership capabilities.
 Build your network across Abbott's Ireland operations.
 Gain exposure to diverse functions, projects, and career paths.
 Benefit from 6, 9, or 12-month internship opportunities aligned to your academic programme.
 Explore future opportunities through Abbott's Graduate Programmes and long-term career pathways.
 Placement length and location will vary depending on business requirements and academic programme requirements. 
 
 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader developing life-changing technologies that help people live healthier lives. With more than 122,000 colleagues serving people in over 160 countries, we deliver innovative solutions across diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and medicines.
 In Ireland, Abbott employs more than 6,200 people across ten sites, providing interns with the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in world-class STEM and business environments while contributing to healthcare innovation.
 Employment offers are subject to the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening. 
 
 Why Choose Abbott? 
 At Abbott, you'll gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and develop skills that will support your future career. You'll:
 Contribute to healthcare innovations that improve lives.
 Learn from experienced professionals and industry experts.
 Build valuable skills and expand your professional network.
 Gain exposure to opportunities across Abbott's Ireland network, with flexibility to be based at different Abbott locations.
 Explore future career opportunities within Abbott.
 Our internship Programme provides real-world experience, broad exposure, and a strong foundation for future career growth.
 
 Areas of Opportunity 
 Depending on business needs and your area of study, you may have the opportunity to gain experience in one or more of the following areas: <delete as appropriate> 
 Supply Chain 
 Gaining exposure to planning, logistics, procurement, scheduling, and materials management activities that help deliver products to patients worldwide.
 Specific assignments will be aligned to business requirements, site needs, and individual development opportunities 
 
 What You'll Bring 
 At Abbott, we're looking for students with the curiosity, drive, and ambition to make a difference. Successful candidates will:
 Be available for a 6, 9, or 12-month placement aligned with their academic programme.
 Be pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain discipline 
 Be on track to achieve, or have achieved, a minimum 2.1 degree classificatio n.
 Bring strong communication, teamwork, and analytical skills.
 Demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and a desire to learn.
 Have a passion for innovation, STEM, and healthcare.
 Thrive in a collaborative environment and be willing to take ownership of their work.
 Have flexibility to be based at any Abbott Ireland location, providing opportunities for broader exposure, diverse experiences, and professional growth.
 
 Closing Date: 19 September 2026 
 Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will take place before the closing date. As positions may be filled early, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this opportunity.
 
 Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:  Abbott in Ireland | Benefits 
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com and on, Facebook , Instagram , X and YouTube . LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X and YouTube .
 
 Join Abbott and Help Build the Workforce of Tomorrow 
 Become part of the next generation of innovators, engineers, scientists, and future leaders helping shape the future of healthcare.
 
 #EarlyCareers #STEMCareers #LifeAtAbbott #FutureTalent

Role Purpose
Execute required customizations, apply configuration changes across multiple modules within the existing system and support implementation of business processes.
Areas of ResponsibilityÂ Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â
Requirement Gathering-Conduct requirement-gathering discussions and workshops with internal and client stakeholders to understand functional requirements and convert them into technical requirements in line with project goals.
Feasibility Analysis-Assist in feasibility analysis by reviewing functional documents, noting preliminary constraints, and preparing impact summaries for potential changes.
Solution Design-Contribute to solution design by identifying customisation requirements across multiple modules, basis understanding of functional requirements and its linkage to technical requirements.
Configuration and Customisation-Execute required customizations, apply configuration changes across multiple modules within the existing system and support implementation of business processes.
Technology Harmonisation-Participate in integration design for multiple modules and assess the data flow between multiple applications.
