Manage and maintain F5 Load Balancer systems:
Perform regular maintenance, updates, and configurations to ensure optimal performance and reliability of F5 LTM and GTM devices.
Advanced troubleshooting: Identify and resolve complex issues related to load balancing, traffic management, and application delivery using F5 technologies.
Optimize traffic management: Implement and refine load balancing policies to distribute traffic efficiently across servers, ensuring minimal latency and high availability.
Monitor system health: Continuously monitor the health and performance of F5 devices, utilizing tools and dashboards to detect and address potential issues proactively.
Security management: Implement best practices for securing F5 devices, including SSL configuration, DDOS protection, and access control as per NT standards.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of configurations, troubleshooting steps, and best practices for F5 load balancers.
Training and mentorship: Provide guidance and training to junior engineers and support staff in the operation and management of F5 technologies.
Skills:
Experience: working with F5 Load Balancers, including LTM and GTM.

Location:

Company:

Full Time Permanent  position
Hybrid role based in our City Centre offices
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here  Benefits (life-careers.com)
At Irish Life, our purpose is to help people build better futures. Our company values shape everything we do and underpin our vision of being the driving force behind Ireland’s financial, physical, and mental well-being.
We believe in doing the right thing —acting with integrity and making fair, responsible decisions. We aim high , setting ambitious goals and constantly f ind better ways to innovate and improve. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do , and we are dedicated to understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.  We believe that as a team we work best together , in a supportive, collaborative environment where every idea and contribution is valued.
About us
Keyridge Asset Management Limited (formerly Irish Life Investment Managers), the investment management company part of Great-West Lifeco (GWL) Group, manages assets of over €150bn.  Keyridge provides investment products and solutions to both institutional and retail clients, offering a full range of active and indexed funds together with tailored investment solutions meeting specific clients’ objectives.
The Team
We are looking to appoint a Specialist within the Investment Services area.  This area is made up three smaller teams:
The Pricing Team which is responsible for the production, validation and explanation of daily fund valuations.  The team acts as the last line of defence in fund accounting and a critical function within Group Operations.
The Reconciliations team which is responsible for the completion of cash and holdings reconciliations to ensure that internal records match custody / counterparty records.
The External Managers Team which is responsible for the completion of operational reviews for new external manager fund arrangements and the monitoring and reporting of these arrangements.
Working as part of the wider team, this is an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to gain exposure to an array of varied and diverse processes to develop their knowledge and skillset with excellent exposure to various stakeholders within the business.
What you will help us to achieve
Reporting to the Senior Manager – Investment Servicing, this role will work across the Pricing, Reconciliations and External Managers teams to support business change, process improvement and operational resilience. Key responsibilities include:
Working across the Investment Servicing teams to analyse current processes, understand business requirements and support the delivery of practical change.
Partnering with stakeholders to document requirements, map processes, assess impacts and agree clear outcomes for projects, enhancements and smaller change initiatives.
Developing a strong understanding of Investment Servicing processes, systems, controls and products, and using this knowledge to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and risk management.
Taking ownership of assigned changes from initial assessment through to completion, including planning, tracking actions, managing dependencies, escalating issues and supporting implementation.
Supporting incident reporting, root cause analysis and the implementation of preventative actions to strengthen controls and reduce operational risk.
Acting as a subject matter expert for agreed processes, providing guidance to Analysts and supporting training, onboarding and knowledge sharing across the teams.
Representing Investment Servicing in cross-functional forums and helping ensure that team requirements, risks and operational considerations are clearly understood.
Maintaining and improving procedural documentation, process maps and other key materials for core activities.
Assisting teams with production of daily service, as required.
What you will need to be successful in the role
The ideal applicant will bring a blend of analytical capability, operational understanding and strong stakeholder management skills. They will possess the following skills and knowledge:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex processes, identify issues and recommend practical solutions.
A proactive approach to identifying, understanding and mitigating operational risks, with a strong focus on controls, accuracy and attention to detail.

The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes
 
 DePuy Synthes, Companies of Johnson & Johnson , is the largest, most comprehensive orthopedic and neurological business in the world, built upon the strong legacies of two great companies. 
 
 DePuy Synthes offer an unparalleled breadth and depth of technology, devices, services and programs in the areas of joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine, neurological, cranio-maxillofacial, power tools and biomaterials. 
 
 Our broad array of inspired, innovative and high-quality offerings helps advance the health and well-being of people around the world. 
 DePuy Synthes, who employ over 1000 people in Cork established its manufacturing facility in Cork in 1997 where it manufactures orthopedic knees and hips. In 2014, DePuy Synthes in Cork won the Shingo Prize for Operational Excellence.
 
 Job Purpose: 
 We are seeking a motivated Graduate Process Engineer with a strong interest in materials engineering and advanced manufacturing. The successful candidate will join the Process Engineering team and develop technical expertise in Foundry Manufacturing, including investment casting. 
 
 Working alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional partners, you will support day-to-day manufacturing, process improvement, technical investigations, validation activities and the introduction of new materials, equipment and technologies in a regulated medical device environment. 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities Process Support & Continuous Improvement Support day-to-day manufacturing by monitoring process performance, reviewing data and assisting with the resolution of technical issues. 

 Participate in investigations relating to process variation, scrap, yield loss, rework, deviations and non-conformances. 

 Use structured problem-solving methods and hands-on process observation to help identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions. 

 Support Lean, process excellence and continuous improvement projects focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost and process capability. 

 Help create and maintain process documentation, work instructions, technical reports, response plans and training materials. 

 ​ 
 Materials Engineering & Process Development 
 
 Practical experience across the following manufacturing pathways: 
 
 Foundry / Investment Casting 
 Wax pattern manufacture and assembly 

 Ceramic shell preparation and environmental control 

 Metal melting, pouring and solidification 

 Casting finishing and porous coating interfaces 

 Metallurgical defect analysis and non-destructive inspection 

 
 Technical Analysis, Validation & Collaboration 
 Collect, analyse and interpret manufacturing, material and quality data using appropriate statistical tools.

 Support process characterisation, capability studies, control charting and Design of Experiments under guidance.

 Assist with equipment qualification, process validation, material evaluation and implementation of approved process changes.

 Contribute technical evidence to non-conformance investigations, corrective and preventive actions, risk assessments and audit actions.

 Work closely with Operations, Quality, Validation, Asset Reliability, Project Engineering, Manufacturing Innovation and supplier teams.

 Communicate findings clearly through technical reports, presentations and cross-functional project updates.

 
 What We Offer Structured graduate development with mentoring and support from experienced engineers and technical specialists.

 Hands-on experience in advanced metallic manufacturing within a highly regulated, patient-focused environment.

 Exposure to Materials Engineering, Foundry and Additive Manufacturing disciplines.

 Opportunities to contribute to real process improvement, validation and technology development projects.

 Professional development and career progression within a global medical device organisation.

 
 
 Qualifications Essential 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Metallurgical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

 Recent graduate ( 2026   or due to graduate in   2027 )

 Strong academic foundation and interest in materials behaviour, metallurgy, manufacturing processes or advanced manufacturing technologies. 

 Analytical and structured problem-solving capability.

 Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work well in a team.

 Curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn in a hands-on manufacturing environment.

 Desirable 
 Relevant internship, placement, laboratory, research or final-year project experience in engineering or manufacturing.

 Exposure to metallurgy, casting, metal additive manufacturing, heat treatment, materials characterisation or failure analysis.

 Experience with data analysis, statistical software, Design of Experiments or process capability tools.

 Awareness of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement or regulated manufacturing principles.

 Skills & Capabilities 
 Ability to connect engineering fundamentals with practical observations on the manufacturing floor.

 An evidence-based approach to analysing data, identifying trends and supporting decisions.

 Interest in the relationship between material properties, manufacturing parameters and product performance.

 Organised approach to documentation, task management and follow-through.

 Ability to collaborate effectively and seek guidance while progressively building technical independence.

 Commitment to safety, quality, compliance and patient-focused manufacturing.

 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
€34,800.00 - €55,775.00  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. 
  
 *This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

title: Kickstart Your Career Journey with Azets
description:
Skip to main content Kickstart Your Career Journey with Azets
At Azets, we celebrate everyone’s individual story, home lives, hobbies and ambitions and we have a place for them all. We believe that diversity and flexibility is essential to creating a modern, vibrant and successful culture – one where being yourself and doing the best work of your life goes hand in hand.
Kickstart your career journey with Azets
If you're a graduate just starting out, eager to learn, grow, and make an impact, this is the perfect place to begin your journey. We know that launching your career can be both exciting and challenging, but here, you'll be supported every step of the way. You'll gain hands-on experience, develop valuable skills, and be part of a team that values your contributions. You might love numbers, but you will never be just a number.
Hear what our Associates have to say
The Azets Academy
Azets Ireland are excited to announce the launch of our new Azets Academy. As a graduate, the Academy will offer you a state of the art, 3 ½ year training programme to learn, grow and develop. Our graduates have first-hand access to our partners and senior management, backing your ambition on your journey to becoming a fully qualified accountant. The Academy will also offer  international travel , granting you access to develop and network around our different offices across Europe.
Incoming graduates in Azets Ireland work collaboratively in a three and half year programme in our business. Backed by supportive and experienced colleagues, graduates work with our clients from the very beginning, giving them the opportunity to build strong relationships.
For the new graduate, our culture and values permeate through everything we do, ensuring a supportive learning environment as you progress. Our people are key to the firm’s success. We put people first, resulting in a workforce that prides itself on going the extra mile for our clients.
Azets
At Azets people are at the core of what we do, with trainees being the first important building block in our success. We are extremely proud of and value the expertise and technical know-how within our business, but we equally understand the importance of enhancing and sharing this knowledge to continuously develop our future workforce.
With the everchanging economic landscape and advances in technology, there has never been a more exciting time to start a career in accountancy. Whether a school/college leaver, a graduate or simply looking for a career change, why not start your journey here at Azets?
We are committed to offering development opportunities to all of our staff, from Entry Level Trainee through to Senior Partner. As a trainee, all of our roles will provide a professional qualification specific to the business area you will be working in.
The role
As part of your role as an Associate Graduate Trainee, you will be working with as part of a knowledgeable and experienced team to learn everything possible in the world of accounting. You will be supported in your development and will be encouraged to expand your experience as much as possible.
Key Requirements
To get the job that you’ll love you will:
Have the right to work in Ireland from your start date
Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting or related discipline
Be on track to achieve or have already achieved a minimum 2:1 in your undergraduate degree
Azets - Our Development Programme
We have created a first-class training and development programme and, by starting your career at Azets, in addition to the comprehensive on the job training, you will also be given all the support you need to complete a professional qualification, including college and/or study days, mentoring and a designated buddy.
We offer a range of different qualification pathways at Azets which are determined by the role you are applying for.
For us, the personal attributes of each of our employees are what makes us authentic in the marketplace. We look for people who can collaborate with peers and can also bring their own voice to the table. We want people who are dynamic in their approach and respectful of other people’s opinions. We are looking for someone who wants to be more than just a team member, rather someone who wants to join a family of like minded individuals.
Compliance assurance
Reduce risk of errors and penalties with accurate, timely submissions.
Flexible solutions
Whether you are an SME or a large employer, we tailor our services to your workforce and payroll complexity.

description:

 Job Description:  The Role and Impact 
As an AMHS Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will be immersed in hands-on projects that enhance manufacturing processes and support factory operations. You'll contribute to evaluating equipment performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing corrective actions to optimize production efficiency and product quality. This role offers a valuable opportunity to develop skills and gain real-world experience in a collaborative and innovative environment.

 Business group 
You'll join Intel's IFA AMHS engineering and Operations organization, which plays a vital role in ensuring the seamless production of cutting-edge technologies. This group is dedicated to driving operational excellence, advancing AMHS manufacturing capabilities, and ensuring quality and reliability in Intel's products. By joining this team, you'll be contributing to Intel's broader mission of powering the future through innovation.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Evaluate AMHS equipment performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

 Assist in implementing corrective actions for AMHS equipment and process optimization.

 Assist in coordinating equipment installations, upgrades, and commissioning activities. 

 Collaborate with AMHS engineering and AMHS operations teams to enhance production efficiency.

 Collect, analyze, and present operational and engineering data using appropriate tools and software. 

 Support process improvements and contribute to quality assurance initiatives.

 Develop technical documentation to support AMHS manufacturing processes.

 Review engineering drawings, layouts, specifications, and technical documentation. 

 Participate in cross-functional problem-solving activities to address factory challenges.

 
 
 Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications
 Working toward a bachelor's degree in a relevant field ( M echanical-, Electrical- , Mechatronics-, Manufacturing- , Automation Engineering, or a related discipline ) with demonstrated skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.

 Fundamental understanding of manufacturing process control and improvement techniques.

 Familiarity with technical documentation and quality assurance practices.

 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Exposure to PLCs, industrial controls, robotics, or automation systems. 

 Experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar platforms. 

 Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies. 

 Experience with data analysis tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar technologies. 

 Strong communication skills and aptitude for collaborative teamwork. 

 Enthusiasm for learning and applying best practices in manufacturing engineering.

 Interest in exploring future career opportunities through hands-on experience.

 Understanding of equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, and system performance metrics. 

 Interest in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation technologies. 

 
 You will be required to work both in the office and the fab environment . 
 
 We encourage you to bring your passion for innovation and curiosity about manufacturing processes to Intel. Join us in shaping the future of technology through impactful contributions to our engineering teams.

title: Electrical Engineering Co-Op Student
description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite 
 
 Who we want: 
 Dedicated Achievers. Relentless about quality, people who thrive in a fast-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations
 Motivated product launchers. Engineers who bring strategic direction and drive for execution to ensure products are developed and launched with precision
 Goal-oriented developers. Keeping the customer and requirements squarely in focus, people who deliver safe and robust solutions.
 User-focused creators . People who imagine with the user in mind, developing technology that helps change patients’ lives.
 Curious learners . People who seek out cutting-edge research and information to expand and enhance their ability to develop new ideas into reality.
 
 What you will do: 
 
 As an R&D Co-Op Student, you will perform a wide variety of technical work in planning and design of medical devices for Orthopedic Surgeons to allow them to plan and perform their procedures.  This role will support the R&D New Product Development Teams as they bring new medical devices products to market. 
 
 Technical Competencies:   Under supervision, you will assist in the following areas to support the design, development, and verification of electrical components for medical devices: 
 
 Schematic, Netlist, Layout Generation & Review: Assist in developing and reviewing electrical schematics, generating netlists, and performing layout reviews. 

 BOM Management: Support the generation, scrubbing, and review of Bills of Materials (BOM). 

 Prototype Design & Evaluation: Contribute to designing prototypes and evaluating their performance through systematic testing.

 Bench Testing: Perform hands-on bench testing to verify electrical designs and assess device performance.

 Electrical Stack-Ups: Participate in stack-up analysis, including:

 Component de-rating analysis 

 Worst case/Monte Carlo analysis 

 LTspice simulations 

 Design for Excellence (DFX): Assist in Design for Manufacturing (DFMA), Design for Fabrication (DFF), and Design for Testability (DFT) reviews.

 
    Additional Responsibilities :
 Support problem-solving and root cause analysis to identify and evaluate potential solutions against defined requirements.

 Conduct research and studies to support innovative product design..

 
 
   Business Responsibilities: 
 Understand the product’s intended use and clinical procedures. 

 
 Med Device Compliance: 
 Learn fundamental industry standards, design requirements and test strategies which align with regulatory requirements.

 With supervision, create or refine engineering documentation, such as the Design History file per company design control procedures.

 Learn R&D procedures like design controls and risk management, per the Quality Management System.

 
 General Responsibilities: 
 With supervision, work with R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Clinical, Marketing and Project Management to ensure project success.

 Learn procedures, policies, processes, systems, and technology required.

 Work on problems in limited scope; purposefully learn while gaining experience.

 Demonstrate ownership and integrity of work .

 Build stable relationships. 

 Contribute to the project as a team member.

 
 Educational Requirements 
 Studying / completed a Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Electrical, Electronic Engineering, or related discipline. 

 
 Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles, including circuit design and analysis.

 Familiarity with electrical design tools and practices within a structured or regulated environment (e.g., team projects, internships, coursework).

 
 Design Tools: 
 Exposure to eCAD tools for schematic capture and basic layout design (e.g. , Altium Designer or similar tools). 

 Awareness of circuit simulation tools (e.g., LTspice, Multisim) through coursework or personal projects.

 
 Analysis Skills: 
 Ability to perform basic analysis tasks, including:

 Understanding of tolerances and their impact on design. 

 Simple statistical methods for data evaluation. 

 
 Manufacturing & Materials: 
 Introductory knowledge of PCB design and manufacturing processes (e.g., stack-ups, component selection).

 Awareness of Design for Excellence (DFX) concepts (basic understanding is sufficient).

 
 Documentation: 
 Ability to interpret basic electrical drawings and schematics. 

 Exposure to preparing or understanding engineering reports and documentation through class assignments or internships.

 
 Preferred Skills / Engineering Tools: 
 Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for documentation and analysis.

 Familiarity with eCAD tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or similar tools used in coursework).

 Exposure to bench-testing equipment (e.g., multimeters, oscilloscopes) during labs or projects.

 Willingness to learn PCB/PCBA print generation and review processes.

 What we can offer: 
 Attractive salary & vacation entitlement

 Experience our inclusive, people-first culture . You will be paired with mentors and have access to leaders who support your growth, give constructive feedback, and help build confidence. 

 Flexible working hours

 Sports & Social clubs and DE&I Employee Resource Groups and the opportunity to connect with other co-ops 

 The opportunity to contribute to real-world projects that make a difference in improving healthcare and patients’ lives. In Stryker, you will be given responsibilities that truly matter.

 
 Next steps: 
 Once you have applied to one of our co-op opportunities, our dedicated University Recruiting Business Partners will take some time to look through your application and ensure you meet the criteria in relation to the specific position.

 Should all requirements be met, and you are happy to proceed, in September, successful candidates will be invited to a final round business interview with the hiring team.

 If successful through the final round business interview, you will receive your offer shortly after

 Please note, individual recruitment timelines may vary – please keep in contact with your University Recruiting Business Partner and your university placement coordinator for specific timelines and updates.

   
  
 Ireland Pay Ranges: 
 Ireland : €30,000 EUR Annual
 
   
  
 If you’d like to learn more about the compensation associated with this opportunity, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
  
   
Travel Percentage: None

title: Tax Analyst
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Finance 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 Role Description: 
We are looking for a dynamic, proactive Tax Analyst to join our in-house EMEA tax team that is responsible for all
direct tax matters in the EMEA region. The Tax Analyst will report to the Senior EMEA Direct Tax Manager and will
be based in Dublin, Ireland.

 Department Description: 
EMEA Tax team is based in Dublin, Ireland and is led by the VP of EMEA. EMEA Tax team works closely with the
wider tax team based in San Francisco and Hyderabad as well as with internal teams based in EMEA.

 Your Impact: 
The focus of this position is to ensure direct tax compliance across the EMEA territories in which the company
operates, to assist in tax planning initiatives and to work with EMEA business teams in achieving their goals while
managing tax risk for the group.

The Tax Analyst will be specifically responsible for ensuring accurate and timely
submission of tax returns and payments, calculations of periodic tax provisions and assisting in areas such as tax
audits, acquisition integrations and transfer pricing. The individual will drive trust, efficiency and the
communication of information within the EMEA Tax team, as well as to the Controllership organization and
business partners in order to facilitate collaboration.

The successful candidate will have previous experience in tax compliance and business partnership/collaboration.
They will be a self-starter, flexible and able to adapt to a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 Tax compliance / Tax Reporting: 
● Assist the Senior EMEA Tax Manager and broader tax team in meeting tax compliance deadlines for
payments and assisting in preparing and reviewing tax return work-papers and tax returns.
● Assist the EMEA and US tax team in the preparation of quarterly and yearly tax reporting under US-GAAP
(FAS109), including true-ups;
● Review of EMEA quarterly and year-end tax packages and FIN48 positions;
● Develop professional relationships with personnel in the Controllership organization and the global tax
team;
● Liaise with external advisors;

 Transfer Pricing: 
● Assist the Senior EMEA Tax Manager and US based Transfer Pricing group in analyzing transactions and
ensuring appropriate documentation;
● Assist with the preparation and update of transfer pricing documentation (including preparation and
review of intercompany agreements);

title: Supply Planner ( 12 Months Fixed Term Contract )
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Senior Supply Planner role will make an impact:
 
 Based in Dublin reporting directly to Supply Chain Manager, the Senior Supply Planner is responsible for effectively managing demand and supply for commercially critical molecules for Global Markets and Global Supply Sites.  The Senior Supply planner is responsible for the inventory management and product supply from internal suppliers and working within a larger team of supply planners to service markets in the EU, Australia, New Zealand, and Emerging markets.
 The Senior Supply planner will be responsible for firming supply plans based on market requirements and in line with inventory strategies, monitoring system generated supply plans, avoiding, and minimizing any supply disruptions and maintaining service levels.
 Key responsibilities for this role include: 
 Maintain and update master data and planning parameters in Rapid Response and SAP for Rapid Response to produce best supply plan.

 Monitor and maintain reason codes for out of stocks and maintain commentary on actions plans to resolve the out of stock per SKU.

 Firm market requirements based on planning parameters (demand, safety stock, MOQ, etc) to minimize out of stocks.

 Ensure firmed supply plans/ purchase orders are executed on time by supplier.

 Develop and execute supply plans when there are upstream constraints in the supply chain (Materials, site capacities) along with internal guidelines to give each market the best supply plan.

 Manage bulk inventory in both internal and external packaging sites, making sure there is no bulk obsolescence, market requirements are met, and packaging sites meet all commitments.

 Agreeing and monitoring of suppliers’ delivery dates and escalate where issues arise.

 Manage market inventory in line with inventory strategies as agreed with senior supply chain leads.

 Determine mode of transport for shipments in line with business strategy, minimise amount transported by air and to track and monitor reason for air.

 Monitor market demand changes within managed molecules month on month, recognizing the drivers for changes and if required, to be in position to explain changes to different stakeholders.

 Support and deliver company/department goals and objectives as required.

 The minimum qualifications and experience for this role are: 
 
 Proven relevant supply chain/manufacturing experience.

 Qualification in a Business-Related discipline or Supply Chain.

 Previous Rapid Response and/ or SAP experience a distinct advantage

 Good knowledge of Microsoft Office systems essential especially Microsoft Excel.

 Successful candidates must have strong planning & analytical skills, attention to detail and excellent communication skills. They will need to work on planning process development and roll out. Successful candidates need to be change leaders in Viatris.

 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits, and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives, and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.

 Job Description We are currently looking to hire 1 CLO Deal Administrator for our Dublin Office but have 4 new roles pending due to growth.
 
 The CLO division sits within US Bank’s Global Corporate Trust (GCT) division. CLO’s are structured finance vehicles that issue both debt and equity liabilities, with the proceeds being used to buy a portfolio of collateral. Typical types of collateral include syndicated bank loans, corporate bonds & equity.
 
 The CLO Deal Administrator role is a key role within our Corporate Trust Business and offers a good level of individual responsibility and accountability, whilst being part of a dynamic and successful business line with opportunity for future growth and development.
 
 Responsibilities of this role include: oversight and execution of bond/bank loan trade settlements, analysis of Money Market Fund investment requirements, booking cash inflows/outflows to the portfolio, tracking asset attributes such as accrual information, providing cash & asset reporting to the clients on a daily basis, and assisting the Analysts with reporting to the CLO investors. The Deal Administrator ensures 100% accuracy and timeliness of data through the booking and reconciliation of account activity.
 
 Context / Environment for this role 
 
 The role holder will be required to build and maintain effective relationships across the Bank and its parent, as well as with external parties, clients, and stakeholders.
 
 The role holder will be part of a specialist team and will be expected to exhibit teamwork, attention to detail, ability to work to tight deadlines, detailed technical knowledge with the ability to manage a heavy and varied workload.
 
 Principal accountabilities of Position
 Cash & Asset Reconciliation responsibility for a portfolio of CDO/CLO transactions
 Generate accurate Daily Cash Reports that reconcile asset payments and receivables on an Actual vs Expected model basis
 Investigate and resolve any exceptions / discrepancies arising. Ability to resolve transactional and portfolio related issues
 Process Broadly Syndicated Loan trades from trade ticket to settlement/payment request stage
 Analysis and oversight of automated Trade settlement processes
 Daily Review of available cash balances & Money Market Funds to ensure sufficient liquidity to action trade settlements
 Receive Bond/Securities tickets and Loan Trade Documents from Clients, review for accuracy, complete relevant documentation and liaise with internal Operations Team’s to ensure they settle within agreed time scales in the market
 Liaise directly with Clients/Counterparties/Agent Banks and other departments for Bond/Loan & Cash related queries
 Settle Loan and Bond transactions on internal compliance system – CDO Suite
 Reconcile Cash & Asset Balances with our clients to support CDO Analytics in the production of Monthly CDO Investor Report
 
 Experience
 Typically 1-4 years experience within Financial Services with experience of cash recs / settlements / client engagement or in a relatable Operations Analyst role
 Preferably with knowledge of fixed income, debt, loans or derivatives and a passion to enter the CLO market or some previous CLO experience or theoretical knowledge of CLO's be hugely beneficial
 Looking for someone with a good level of numeracy and attention to detail
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a client centric approach
 Ability to work both independently and as a team player

 Relationship building across several internal groups & divisions
 Ability to manage a heavy and varied workload while demonstrating strong attention to detail

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here  Benefits (life-careers.com)
At Irish Life, our purpose is to help people build better futures. Our company values shape everything we do and underpin our vision of being the driving force behind Ireland’s financial, physical, and mental well-being.
We believe in doing the right thing —acting with integrity and making fair, responsible decisions. We aim high , setting ambitious goals and constantly f ind better ways to innovate and improve. About us
Keyridge Asset Management Limited (formerly Irish Life Investment Managers), the investment management company part of Great-West Lifeco (GWL) Group, manages assets of over €150bn.  Keyridge provides investment products and solutions to both institutional and retail clients, offering a full range of active and indexed funds together with tailored investment solutions meeting specific clients’ objectives.
The Team

The Pricing Team which is responsible for the production, validation and explanation of daily fund valuations.  The team acts as the last line of defence in fund accounting and a critical function within Group Operations.
The Reconciliations team which is responsible for the completion of cash and holdings reconciliations to ensure that internal records match custody / counterparty records.
The External Managers Team which is responsible for the completion of operational reviews for new external manager fund arrangements and the monitoring and reporting of these arrangements.
Working as part of the wider team, this is an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to gain exposure to an array of varied and diverse processes to develop their knowledge and skillset with excellent exposure to various stakeholders within the business.
What you will help us to achieve
Reporting to the Senior Manager – Investment Servicing, this role will work across the Pricing, Reconciliations and External Managers teams to support business change, process improvement and operational resilience. Key responsibilities include:
Working across the Investment Servicing teams to analyse current processes, understand business requirements and support the delivery of practical change.
Partnering with stakeholders to document requirements, map processes, assess impacts and agree clear outcomes for projects, enhancements and smaller change initiatives.
Developing a strong understanding of Investment Servicing processes, systems, controls and products, and using this knowledge to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and risk management.
Taking ownership of assigned changes from initial assessment through to completion, including planning, tracking actions, managing dependencies, escalating issues and supporting implementation.
Supporting incident reporting, root cause analysis and the implementation of preventative actions to strengthen controls and reduce operational risk.
Acting as a subject matter expert for agreed processes, providing guidance to Analysts and supporting training, onboarding and knowledge sharing across the teams.
Representing Investment Servicing in cross-functional forums and helping ensure that team requirements, risks and operational considerations are clearly understood.
Maintaining and improving procedural documentation, process maps and other key materials for core activities.
Assisting teams with production of daily service, as required.
What you will need to be successful in the role
The ideal applicant will bring a blend of analytical capability, operational understanding and strong stakeholder management skills. They will possess the following skills and knowledge:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex processes, identify issues and recommend practical solutions.
A proactive approach to identifying, understanding and mitigating operational risks, with a strong focus on controls, accuracy and attention to detail.

Company Description
ORIX Aviation is an aircraft leasing company established in 1991, currently with over 200 aircraft owned, managed, and committed on lease to more than 50 airlines across greater than 30 countries. ORIX Aviation is also a 30% shareholder in Avolon, one of the world’s largest aircraft lessors. ORIX Aviation has offices in Dublin and Dubai and works closely with a team of aviation specialists in ORIX Corporation in Tokyo. The team consists of 100+ aviation professionals across the three locations. ORIX Aviation is an S&P ranked aircraft servicer and has earned a “strong” ranking - the highest possible ranking - with a stable outlook. ORIX Aviation is positioned to grow both its owned book aircraft as well as managed aircraft in the coming years. ORIX Aviation believes in the power of diversity and is an equal opportunities employer.
Position
Lead the Powerplant function across engine maintenance strategy, shop visit oversight, cost validation, maintenance forecasting, technical risk management, and transaction support. The role is responsible for providing senior technical direction on engine-related matters, protecting asset value, and supporting commercial decisions across the aircraft and engine portfolio.
Lead the planning, coordination, and oversight of major engine maintenance events across the managed fleet.
Develop, review, and challenge engine shop visit workscopes, maintenance strategies, and operator or MRO recommendations.
Assess shop visit proposals to ensure technical necessity, lease alignment, cost control, and protection of asset value.
Review and validate shop visit costs, invoices, maintenance reserve claims, and related supporting documentation.
Maintain engine maintenance forecasts and exposure assumptions in coordination with airlines, MROs, OEMs, and internal stakeholders.
Provide senior technical input to aircraft and engine transitions, including due diligence, delivery readiness, redelivery planning, and execution risk management.
Support LOIs, lease agreements, lease amendments, lease placements, sales, and trading transactions, including review and validation of engine-related rates and assumptions.
Identify, assess, and communicate technical risks that may affect asset value, maintenance exposure, lease economics, transition execution, or transaction outcomes.
Develop and agree practical mitigation actions for engine maintenance, technical, commercial, and transition-related risks.
Act as a senior technical interface with Trading, Marketing, Pricing, Asset Management, Risk, Legal, and Technical teams.
Maintain market awareness through engagement with operators, OEMs, MROs, appraisers, and wider industry contacts.
Provide guidance and oversight to more junior Powerplant or technical team members on data, maintenance, records, and transaction-related matters.
Translate complex technical findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for commercial, asset management, and senior leadership stakeholders.
Requirements
5-10 years of relevant powerplant, airline, MRO, OEM, leasing, or technical asset management experience preferred.
Relevant university degree or technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Aircraft Maintenance, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of engine maintenance, shop visit management, lease-related maintenance obligations, and aircraft technical records.
Experience reviewing shop visit workscopes, invoices, reserve claims, engine rates, and maintenance exposure assumptions.
Strong commercial awareness with the ability to assess the impact of technical matters on asset value, lease economics, and transaction execution.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical matters clearly to senior internal stakeholders.
Advanced Microsoft Excel capability and confidence working with technical, utilisation, maintenance, and financial data.
Proactive, well-organised, detail-focused, and able to manage competing priorities across maintenance, transactions, and portfolio management.
Aircraft leasing experience desirable.
Other information
Working with ORIX Aviation
Outside of an attractive and competitive remuneration package, and based in a modern office block situated in a desirable location, other benefits of the ORIX Aviation culture include:
A flexible hybrid working model,
A Social Committee who arrange multiple social events; everything from meals out and pub quizzes to family fun days and social drinks
Participation in company sports teams such as tag rugby, tennis and football
Access to on-site gym and subsidised external gym and sport club memberships
Annual fundraising for charities and community organisations
Opportunity to get involved in ORIX Aviation’s committees which include Wellness, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion, ECO and Sports & Social
Secondment opportunities to Dubai

title: Digital Trust & Privacy Consultant
description: Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging. Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging. We offer a competitive starting salary of €45,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. . Deloitte's Digital Trust & Privacy team is at the forefront of helping the world's leading organisations navigate the complex landscape of data privacy, AI governance, and internet regulations. This is a pivotal moment in the industry—regulators are tightening frameworks, organisations are racing to build trustworthy technology, and the demand for expert advisory has never been higher. In this role, you'll work on high-impact engagements that shape how global enterprises govern data, deploy AI responsibly, and build consumer trust. You'll partner with senior leaders on transformational projects, mentor emerging talent, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders navigating some of the most critical regulatory challenges of our time. Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position Proven client-facing experience in data privacy, AI governance, or internet regulatory advisory within professional services or equivalent industry roles, with demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships and deliver under pressure. Deep expertise in privacy and AI regulation frameworks—particularly GDPR, EU AI Act, DSA, and DMA—combined with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical, implementable solutions. Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand data flows, system architectures, and the technical implications of privacy and AI governance across diverse platforms and technologies; experience with privacy impact assessments (PIAs) or AI impact assessments is highly desirable. Exceptional communication and analytical skills, with proven ability to synthesise complex regulatory concepts into clear, compelling reports and client presentations that drive decision-making at senior levels. What type of work will I be doing? Conduct Privacy and AI Assessments: Perform data protection and AI governance assessments and gap analyses, ensuring robust controls across the personal data lifecycle and AI systems. Design GRC Frameworks: Contribute to the creation and operationalisation of customised privacy policies, AI governance frameworks, and trustworthy technology controls, including second-line-of-defence functions such as Trust & Safety and Integrity Compliance. Regulatory Evaluation & Forecasting: Analyse emerging data privacy, AI, and internet regulations to help clients understand strategic implications and stay ahead of compliance obligations. Develop Training Programs: Design and deliver tailored training and awareness initiatives that empower clients to embed privacy and trustworthy technology best practices across their organisations. Manage Compliance Obligations: Support clients with regulatory requirements including Records of Processing (ROPAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), AI governance reviews, data retention compliance, systemic risk assessments, and regulatory readiness evaluations. Assess Tools and Platforms: Perform compliance reviews of applications, platforms, and systems against privacy laws, AI Act requirements, and Digital Services Act (DSA) standards, including content moderation and transparency policy assessments. Implement Privacy-Enhancing Technologies: Work with alliance partners to deploy tailored privacy solutions, provide technical advisory support, and guide clients on identity and access management concepts aligned with privacy by design principles. Mentor and Lead: Provide guidance and support to junior team members through collaborative problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and task coordination, helping to build capability across the team. Additional Qualifications (Preferred) Professional certifications in data privacy, AI governance, or internet regulations—such as IAPP CIPP/E, AIGP, CIPM, or CIPT—or a privacy engineering background are valued. Experience or certification in project or program management is also preferred, though not essential. Who is the Hiring Manager? The hiring manager is a respected leader within Deloitte's Digital Trust & Privacy practice, recognised for their deep expertise in data governance and AI regulation across global markets. They lead with a collaborative and mentoring approach, prioritising open dialogue, professional development, and creating an environment where team members can take ownership of client outcomes. They combine high expectations with genuine investment in their team's growth, fostering innovation and continuous learning while maintaining unwavering commitment to client service excellence and regulatory integrity. Where is this role based? This role is based in Dublin and operates on a hybrid working model, combining office-based collaboration with client-site engagements. For more information about Deloitte's flexible working arrangements, visit Deloitte Works. If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process. What we offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options. Deloitte is the number one professional services firm in the world, and the leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, sustainability, tax, and related services. We have offices across Ireland in Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Limerick and Galway. Deloitte is proud of the enhanced flexibility that we offer our people through our hybrid working strategy, Deloitte Works. It means we trust our people with the flexibility and control to make the right choices in where, when, and how they work. Deloitte is looking for people that have a leadership mindset, are curious, enjoy solving challenges and are eager to grow their careers.

Do you need a qualification for a specific profession, such as teaching, social work or law?
Would you like to specialise in an area that interests you?
Are you considering a move into a different field?
Do you want to develop skills that will enhance your career prospects?
Would you like the opportunity to study abroad as part of a postgraduate programme?
Types of courses
Taught programmes usually last one year full-time (or part-time equivalent) and include coursework, exams, and often a project or dissertation.
Research programmes include Masters by research (typically 2 years) and PhDs (typically 4–5 years), and focus on a specific research topic with assessment by thesis.
Modes of study
Full-time: more intensive, completed more quickly
Part-time: more flexible but takes longer and may have less funding
Online or blended: flexible but requires strong self-motivation
Micro-credentials and short courses
Things to think about
Do I need this qualification for the role I want?
Will it improve my job prospects, or would some work experience be more valuable right now?
What skills will I gain from this course?
Am I choosing this for the right reasons?
Funding and costs
There are costs associated with further study, including fees, living expenses, and course-related costs.
You may be able to access funding through:
Scholarships, bursaries, and grants (limited SUSI support SUSI Postgraduate support information )
Employer support (in some cases)
Loans or other financial supports
Tuition fee tax rebate scheme, more information at Citizens Information.ie information Tax Relief on Third Level Fees
It is important to explore funding options early.
Studying Abroad
Studying abroad can offer the opportunity to specialise in a subject not available in Ireland, learn from leading academics, experience a new culture, improve your language skills and enhance your global career prospects.
Planning ahead is important. Research course requirements, application deadlines, tuition fees, funding opportunities, visa requirements and any language or admissions tests that may be needed. Most universities require you to apply directly, and applications may open up to a year in advance.
The following websites can be helpful if you are thinking about this option:
Prospects is a UK Careers website: www.prospects.ac.uk/postgraduate-study/study-abroad
Gradireland's study abroad section : gradireland.com/careers-advice/postgraduate-study/studying-abroad-practical-considerations
EUNiCAS is an application service for English-taught undergraduate and postgraduate courses at universities across Europe: eunicas.ie
Other options to consider
Gain experience through work, internships, or volunteering
Apply for graduate roles or programmes
Develop skills alongside work
Next steps
Research courses and entry requirements
Compare programmes and study options
Consider if there are study abroad options and if they interest you
Explore funding and application processes

Job Hunting
Starting your job search can feel both exciting and overwhelming. There are a wide range of opportunities available, but it is important to take a structured approach and use a mix of different strategies.
So, where are some of the places where graduate roles and programmes are advertised?
Careers Connect is our Career Development Jobs Board used by employers to advertise their vacancies to TU Dublin students and graduates. Register today and set up job alerts.
Gradireland - official graduate higher education careers website in Ireland advertising current and annual vacancies with major graduate recruiters. Set up job alerts today.
Graduate Programmes List – list of employers’ graduate programmes with closing dates
Gradireland Official Careers Directory - free publication aimed at final years advertising graduate jobs in Ireland. The directory is available to you every Autumn.
TU Dublin Emails - Keep checking your TU Dublin emails for job and other career notifications from the TU Dublin Career Development Centre.
Summer Internships List – list of employers recruiting for Summer positions
Hidden Jobs Market
The job market for graduates extends far beyond what meets the eye. Unlocking the hidden graduate job market can offer exceptional opportunities to launch a successful career.
Start by leveraging your network; connections with lecturers, alumni, and industry professionals can provide invaluable insights. Additionally, attending career fairs, and industry events, and joining relevant professional organisations can expose you to hidden job opportunities. Proactively researching and targeting companies of interest, utilising online job platforms, and showcasing your skills through internships can also boost your chances.
See our resources for lots of other tips on how to access the advertised and hidden graduate jobs market.

At TU Dublin our Career Coaches are your Careers Advisors. You can book a one-to-one appointment with a Careers Coach through the Career Development Centre. They offer guidance on career planning, CVs, interviews, and job applications. Check the   webpage with booking details.

How do I connect with TU Dublin alumni for networking?
You can connect with TU Dublin alumni through events, networking opportunities, and alumni platforms. Learn more about the  alumni community on the dedicated page .

description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite 
 
 Weekend shift - Friday, Sat and Sun - Stryker Model Farm Road 
 
 What you will do: 
 This position's primary function is that of ensuring that manufacturing processes run consistently and meet performance targets.
 Actively interface with cross-functional team members and 3rd party Vendors, always practicing good team work in support of day to day operating requirements.
 Monitoring and management of production yield performance on assigned lines.
 Liaising with Team Leaders with regard to productivity and efficiency performance issues on your assigned lines.
 Engage in mechanical / electrical / electronic troubleshooting, and in resolving hardware /software interfacing problems on the production floor.
 Diagnose malfunctioning systems to identify hazards, defects and the need for adjustment or repair.
 Communicating regularly with Operators regarding issues, concerns an watch-outs on the lines.
 Test electrical systems, circuits and wiring in processing equipment and fixtures.
 Planning, layout and installation of processing equipment on work-stations.
 Responsibility for product line performance, primarily maximizing productivity of the equipment and minimizing yield loss from the process.
 Co-ordination of preventative maintenance and calibration activities on assigned lines / process.
 Identifying and assisting the business with the implementation of technical improvements.
 Identification of process equipment spares requirements, plus sourcing and replenishment of all such spares from stock in accordance with company policies
 Performing equipment qualification and projects work, as assigned.
 Design, specification, fabrication, testing and documentation of process equipment changes and improvements.
 Adherence to Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) requirements on sites, plus communication of any concerns regarding environmental impact, health or safety issues.
 Building of Quality into all aspects of one’s work by maintaining compliance
with all site and corporate Quality Management System requirements.
 Provision of out-of-hours support to the business as required by management
or as mandated by shutdowns and/or equipment failures.
 All other duties as assigned.

 Certificate/ Diploma in Engineering, Science, related discipline or hold a trade qualification in electrical, mechanical l& toolmaking or related discipline or has 2 years technician experience in a manufacturing environment.
 Good knowledge of electronics and software control systems.
 Entry level experience in a modern manufacturing environment ideally with previous experience in some or all of the following:
 -Low / medium voltage electrical power systems
 -Pneumatics
 -PLCs
 -Instrumentation
 -Hydraulics
 -Calibration
 -AutoCAD
 -Injection moulding
 Experience in the medical device industry is an advantage.
 Business understanding of operations and there impacts essential.
 High level of PC Skills required.
 Flexibility essential.
 Strong communication skills with both Internal and external agents.
 Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
 Green or Black Belt 6 Sigma qualifications an advantage.
 Good problem solver and is analytical.
 Excellent customer service and communicates very well with good interpersonal skills.

This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.

title: Logistics Specialist ( 18 Months Fixed Term )
description:
Generics [U.K.] Ltd. 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Logistics Specialist will make an impact:
 
 Key responsibilities for this role include:
 
 Provide Serve as the first point of contact and subject matter expert for logistics operations, SAP transaction support, inventory accuracy issues, system-interface failures and 3PL operational escalations.

 Monitor daily operational flows across SAP, WMS, TMS and EDI, including interface exceptions, IDoc or message failures, order updates, inventory postings and master-data related issues.

 Work closely with third-party logistics providers and internal teams to ensure service delivery in line with agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality expectations and escalation timelines.

 Support high levels of SAP inventory accuracy through timely issue investigation, stock reconciliation, transaction review, batch or lot integrity checks, and proactive defect prevention.

 Use operational data, Power BI, advanced Excel and other reporting tools to identify trends, exceptions, root causes and improvement opportunities.

 Lead or support structured root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, process mapping, standard work updates and Lean continuous-improvement initiatives.

 Support GDP and quality-compliant distribution processes, including SOP adherence, deviation support, audit-readiness activities and quality escalation where required.

 Act as a functional expert for distribution processes, WMS/TMS workflows, EDI/interface management, SAP logistics execution and end-to-end issue resolution.

 Partner with IT, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance and external partners to resolve cross-functional process gaps and prevent recurring operational failures.

 Support system change, testing, user acceptance testing, process documentation and training for SAP, WMS, TMS, EDI or reporting improvements.

 Apply a digital and continuous-improvement mindset, including appropriate use of automation, analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools to improve visibility, control and decision-making.

 
 The minimum qualifications for this role are:  
 
 Degree Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Science or related qualification is beneficial.

 Power BI, Power Query, advanced Excel, data visualisation or dashboard development experience is strongly preferred.

 Experience with WMS, TMS, EDI, IDoc monitoring, interface troubleshooting or logistics control-tower environments is beneficial.

 Knowledge of Good Distribution Practice, regulated pharmaceutical supply chains, temperature-controlled logistics, serialization or track-and-trace requirements is beneficial.

 Exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP TM or SAP master-data governance is desirable.

 Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, standard work or structured problem-solving experience is beneficial.

 Comfort using digital tools, automation and AI-enabled productivity tools to improve analysis, reporting, documentation and exception management.

 Ability to turn operational data into clear recommendations, actions and stakeholder updates.

 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits, and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives, and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.

Job Description:
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive  Corporate Administrator  to join our Company Secretarial team, based in Shannon, Co. Clare, Ireland.  The successful candidate will provide high-quality administrative support to ensure compliance with statutory obligations and deliver exceptional service to our clients. This hybrid role requires flexibility to travel by car on request to manage client needs, including notarisations and document execution.
Key Responsibilities:
Company Secretarial Support:
Maintain statutory registers and ensure timely filings with the Companies Registration Office (CRO).
Support in assisting in completing filings on statutory platforms such as Companies Registration Office, Register of Beneficial Ownership – full training will be provided.
Assist with incorporations, share transfers, and sealing of documents.
Maintaining and updating of internal trackers and assisting in compliance with KYC/AML support internally.
Client Service:
Act as a primary point of contact for internal client manager queries related to the provision of company registers and copies of corporate records.
Coordinate and manage internal client manager requests for notarisation and document execution.
Ensure all deliverables meet agreed timelines and quality standards.
Travel & On-Site Support:
Travel by car to notary locations as required for notarisation and document signings.
Represent the company professionally during client interactions.
Compliance & Governance:
Monitor changes in Irish company law and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Support internal governance processes and maintain accurate records.
Skills & Qualifications:
Previous experience in a Company Secretarial or corporate administration role (preferably in Ireland) – desirable but not essential as full training in the role will be provided.
Knowledge of Irish company law and Companies Registration Office filing requirements is desirable but not essential.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills for client-facing interactions.
Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel as required.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Outlook, Excel and a working knowledge of PowerPoint.

Company Description:
We are  One Sutherland
— a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.
Sutherland was founded 39 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.
Job Description:
Sutherland is seeking a Business Analyst to play a key role in gathering business requirements, analyzing data, supporting software implementations, and delivering high-quality solutions across enterprise customer environments. This role requires strong analytical skills, customer interaction experience, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with customers, technical teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and customer outcomes.
The Business Analyst performs a wide range of duties including some or all the following:
Gather, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and technical requirements across customer projects and initiatives.
Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to define business processes, application requirements, integrations, reporting needs, dashboards, metrics, and data mapping requirements.
Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and project documentation for technical and non-technical audiences.
