title: Strategic Initiatives Project Specialist
description:
Company: 
 Description: 
 What can you expect: 
 An exciting opportunity to work in Mercer’s largest and most rapidly-growing business area – Investment Solutions. As part of our strategic initiatives Team the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting Mercer’s Investment Solutions strategic change agenda by helping shape plans, coordinating delivery, tracking progress against outcomes, and supporting change adoption. Mercer is one of the fastest growing investment solutions entities globally, and our client base has grown substantially over recent years and we have an ambitious trajectory for future growth.
 
 The candidate will work closely with business sponsors and business owners, internal stakeholders, senior management, external vendors, clients, and wider colleagues to coordinate and deliver on key strategic initiatives including integration activity (including M&A-related workstreams), development of operational solutions for existing and new client segments, and global alignment activities.
 
 The successful candidate will get to work in and experience a dynamic and rapidly growing area of Mercer’s business driven by strong demand across new markets and segments.
 
 We will rely on you to: 
 Support strategic planning for the Investments platform by partnering with senior leadership to translate priorities into clear goals, objectives, and actionable delivery plans.
 Coordinate the execution of strategic projects and initiatives, supporting definition of scope, deliverables, timelines, and interdependencies.
 Organize and coordinate cross-functional teams, working groups, and governance forums to drive alignment and delivery.
 Establish and maintain project plans, dashboards, and RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) to support effective stakeholder communication.
 Monitor and report initiative performance using agreed metrics and KPIs; analyze trends and identify areas for improvement and performance optimization.
 Facilitate effective communication and coordination across the Investments business, ensuring alignment across teams and departments.
 Build and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders (including senior leadership, department heads, functional teams, and external partners where relevant) to secure engagement and timely decisions.
 Support change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption planning to embed new processes and ways of working.
 Identify and help mitigate risks and challenges associated with strategic initiatives; escalate issues appropriately with options and recommendations.
 Ensure delivery documentation is completed to a high standard with messaging tailored to different audiences (for example, steering committee updates, project plans, and status reporting).
 Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize processes, governance, and delivery practices within the strategic initiatives framework.
 
 What you need to have:  
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple parallel workstreams and priorities.
 Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear written updates and facilitate effective working sessions.
 Strong analytical skills to support KPI tracking, performance monitoring, and evidence based decision support.
 A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
 Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify issues early and support practical solutions.
 A strong commitment to delivery discipline and rigor (planning, governance, documentation, and follow-through).
 Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines.
 
 What makes you stand out: 
 Experience supporting strategic initiatives, transformation programs, or PMO delivery in a complex organization.
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to project coordination and reporting.
 Demonstrated ability to build trust and maintain effective stakeholder relationships.
 A proactive mindset with a drive to learn, improve processes, and contribute to meaningful change.
 
 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.
 
 #MercerIS
 
 
Mercer is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Mercer, visit mercer.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Job Title:

62443

Cyber Security

03/09/2026
Posting End Date:
01/10/2026
Division:
Networks

GBR-Birmingham-Three Snowhill
Advertised Salary:
Competitive with Great Benefits
Job Req ID: 62443
Posting Date: 3rd Sep 2026
Closing Date: 1st Oct 2026
Location: Birmingham
About the role
The new Network SIEM is essential to BT’s network security, meeting TSA requirements and improving our CAF level. Your role as a SIEM Application Engineer in Security Engineering is to support the development, implementation, operation and support of BTs Strategic SIEM development.  We are seeking a skilled SIEM Security Engineer with expertise in SIEM and Security logging and monitoring to join our dynamic team. As a SIEM engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining the ingestion of our security information and event management (SIEM) system. Your focus will be on leveraging Elasticsearch and related technologies to enhance threat detection, incident response, and overall security posture.
The role is hybrid (3 days in office) & based in Birmingham
What you’ll be doing
Data Ingestion and Enrichment:
Collaborate with Security analysts and application teams to provide clear design for the security scope of data ingestion.
Support the configuration of Elasticsearch pipelines for data ingestion from various sources, primarily from Kafka
Enhance data enrichment by integrating threat intelligence feeds and contextual information.
Ingest data from various networking equipment, servers, firewalls and security appliances across multiple vendors.
SIEM Solution Development:
Collaborate with security analysts and architects to design and implement SIEM solutions using Elasticsearch.
Continuously improving threat detection capabilities by tuning and optimising existing use cases and retiring use cases no longer providing value.
Query Optimization and Performance Tuning :
Designing, implementing and managing security detection use cases across a range of technologies to ensure timely alerting of security events and incidents to Security Operations staff.
Monitor and manage the performance of the SIEM infrastructure.
Security Engineering:
Contribute to security engineering projects, transitions, and transformations.
Work closely with security operations and associated security incident response systems
Stay informed about emerging threats and security best practices.
Essential Skills / Experience
Proven experience in SIEM Detection Engineering.
Experience using cyber security technologies such as NGFW, SIEM, Proxies, IAM solutions
Experience of tuning security detection use cases. Experience with log source onboarding and normalisation
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate complex security events.
Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and modern cyber threat techniques.
Experience working with Security Operations and engineering stakeholders.
Excellent technical documentation and communication skills.
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or other related fields 5+ years of engineering experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions
Experience in key cyber technologies such as SIEM technologies (Elastic preferred), vulnerability management, access management and other commonly used Enterprise security controls. Ideally from both a development and operational perspective
Desirable Skills / Experience
SIEM implementation and usage Experience of Elastic Stack (ELK) Knowledge of Offensive testing frameworks Knowledge of Linux, Windows and Network Administration
Knowledge and experience of cloud services (public or private), OpenStack and K8S Cyber security qualifications
Knowledge of Git and Devops practices Knowledge of Terraform/Ansible systems
Strong knowledge of security policy/regulatory frameworks including Telecoms Security Act (TSA)
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
10% on target annual bonus
Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
Equalised maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
Holiday purchase scheme
You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready.
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good.  Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate,

title: Insurance Healthcare Trainer
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Insurance Healthcare Trainer 
 
 Job Location: Dublin
 Job Type: Permanent Role
 Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications
 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Health Insurance Trainer in Dublin. 
 Are you passionate about developing people and helping teams perform at their best? We are looking for a dedicated Training and Quality Specialist to drive learning, development and operational excellence across a dynamic, high-performing customer-focused team. This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact by equipping colleagues with the skills, knowledge and confidence they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business objectives.
 
 Demonstrate reliability, focus and commitment in driving the success of the account by providing training and development to a dynamic and high performing customer-centric team. Deliver training to new and existing colleagues, maintain training documents, monitor agent development, and advise on service techniques. Main point of contact for training matters with operations management.
 Working closely with Operations Management, you will design and deliver engaging training programmes for both new and existing colleagues, covering products, systems, processes and customer service skills. You will create and maintain interactive training materials, ensure compliance with quality and ISO standards, and monitor colleague development through coaching, assessments and ongoing support.
 
 As the key point of contact for all training-related matters, you will identify development opportunities through quality evaluations, root cause analysis and performance insights. You will deliver training on new systems, products and process updates, while supporting continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and customer outcomes. In addition, you will take ownership of training administration, compliance documentation and supervision processes, helping to maintain high standards across the team.
 
 This is an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic and motivated professional who enjoys developing others, fostering a culture of continuous learning and working collaboratively to support the success of both colleagues and the wider business.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply:    
 · APA Qualification – APA qualified with a commitment to ongoing professional development.
 · Training & Coaching Expertise – Previous experience delivering training, coaching or mentoring programmes within customer service, sales, claims or similar environments.
 · F acilitation Skills – Ability to effectively demonstrate concepts, engage learners and support colleagues in developing new skills and knowledge.
 · Communication Skills – Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences.
 · Healthcare Knowledge – Experience within the healthcare sector is highly desirable and would be a distinct advantage.
 · Administrative Excellence – Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate training records and documentation.
 · Microsoft Office Proficiency – Competent in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
 · Insurance Industry Knowledge – Understanding of the insurance sector is highly desirable, particularly within customer service or claims environments.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 Remuneration & More 
 Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications.
 Pension Scheme.
 Holiday allowance.
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme.
 Opportunities for training and development.
 
 Health & Support 
 Employee Assistance Programme.
 Life Cover.
 Permanent Health Insurance (PHI).
 Bike to Work Scheme.
 
 Other Benefits 
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4).
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4).
 Professional and personal development opportunities.
 Support for professional memberships and examinations where applicable.
 This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry   
 At Sedgwick, not only will you be working behind the scenes for some of the UK's most trusted insurance brands helping to resolve millions of claims every year, you'll also be an architect of tomorrow's insurance landscape with Sedgwick University. Our proprietary offering is the most comprehensive training and development program in the industry with more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue your formal education – all available to you starting from your very first day.  
 You'll join a community passionate about making a difference, where every role contributes to a larger mission; protecting people and businesses. This isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of insurance.  
 
 Next steps for you:   
 Think we'd be a great match? Apply now – we want to hear from you.   
 If you’re unsure whether you have all the skills needed then do apply – we are looking for all backgrounds from seasoned professionals to those returning to the workforce, and everyone in-between.   
 Not only that, we are proud to have a zero tolerance policy towards discrimination of any kind regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital/ family status, race, religion, sex or sexual orientation.   
 After the closing date we will review all applications and may select some applicants for an interview (which may be virtual, or in-person). 
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function ( CF7 ) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them.

title: Skilled Slaughterman
description:
Kepak Group, one of Europe's leading food producers, is seeking a motivated individual to join our Slaughter Hall team at our Bodmin site as a skilled Slaughterman. This role is situated within the food production industry, which plays a vital role in supplying high-quality food products to consumers across the globe. As a skilled Slaughterman at our Bodmin site, you will contribute to the company's proud heritage of meat craft, trusted quality, and excellent service.
 
 With twelve manufacturing plants located in Ireland and the UK, Kepak is committed to sustainability and animal welfare, ensuring that the production process is both environmentally friendly and ethically responsible. The company is deeply rooted in nature and its communities, actively engaging in practices that promote positive impacts on the environment and society as a whole. Furthermore, Kepak is driven by innovation and seeks to deliver inspirational nutrition through its diverse range of products.
 
 You will be working in slaughtering performing precision functions involving the preparation of meat. Work may include specialized slaughtering tasks, cutting standard or premium cuts of meat for marketing. The slaughter and preparation of animals for human consumption.
 
 You will start work at 06:30 in the morning and work until production is finished, Monday to Friday with weekends off. This role offers a full time contract based on 45 hrs per week any hours worked over the 45 will be paid at time & quarter of your hourly rate. You will have 2 x 30 min breaks per day.
 Your own transport is required due to our location and the times of Public transport links to Bodmin 
 
 Responsibilities Use knives and other equipment to prepare and process meat products according to production specifications.
 Ensure that meat products are cut and trimmed to the highest standards of quality and safety.
 Keep work area clean and follow all safety regulations and procedures.
 Meet production goals and work as a team to ensure timely completion of tasks.
 Properly store and handle meat products to prevent waste and spoilage.
 Perform quality inspections on meat products to ensure they meet established standards.
 Continuously learn and improve knowledge of knife skills and meat processing techniques.
 The ability to work at height (Training Given)
 
 Qualifications 
 Current Slaughter Licence would be preferred 
 Food Hygiene certificate
 Good understanding of animal welfare
 Must be able to demonstrate exceptional knife skills
 Requirements 
 Previous experience in a similar role within the food production industry is essential.
 Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
 Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically under pressure.
 Understanding of and commitment to following health and safety regulations.
 Physical stamina and ability to lift heavy objects as required.
 Effective communication and teamwork skills to interact with colleagues and supervisors.
 Attributes, Skills and Experience Requirements Commitment to Company Values; Passion for food, Ambition, Responsibility and Teamwork 
 Passion for Food at forefront of day-to-day performance 
 Ambition to develop self to achieve personal and business goals 
 Responsibility for positive contribution to business 
 Teamwork across all levels, departments and teams, willing to go the extra mile 
 Good Numeracy skills 
 Consistent approach and strong work ethic 
 Able to work under own initiative and as part of a team
 Adaptable to change and production demand
 Benefits 
 31 days annual leave per year  (after probation).
 Annual Holiday Purchase Scheme - Need a little more time off? Purchase additional annual leave.
 Company Pension Scheme - Helping you plan for the future with access to our company pension scheme.
 Death in Service Benefit - Eligible salaried employees are covered by our Death in Service benefit, providing financial support and peace of mind for your loved ones.
 Refer a Friend Scheme - Earn up to £500 for successfully referring a friend or family member to join Kepak.
 Free On-Site Parking - Our site has dedicated staff parking, available free of charge for all colleagues.
 Subsidised On-Site Canteen - Enjoy a variety of freshly prepared hot meals and food options at reduced prices in our on-site canteen.
 Cycle to Work Scheme - Save money on a new bike and cycling equipment through our salary sacrifice scheme.
 Electric Vehicle Scheme - Access an electric vehicle through our salary sacrifice scheme.
 Long Service Awards - We recognise, acknowledge and celebrate the loyalty, dedication and valuable contributions of our long-serving colleagues.
 Discounted Gym Memberships - Support your health and wellbeing with access to discounted gym memberships.
 Training and Development - We are committed to helping you grow your career through structured onboarding, regular online and in-person training, and clear opportunities for career progression.
 Mentoring and Leadership Development Programmes - Whether you're looking to build new skills or take the next step in your career, our mentoring and leadership development programmes are designed to help you reach your full potential.
 GroceryAid Employee Assistance Programme - Free and confidential emotional, practical and financial support for all Kepak colleagues, including access to counselling, mental health support, legal guidance and a 24/7 confidential helpline.
 Financial Advice & Will Writing -  Access free mortgage advice and a complimentary will writing service as part of your employee benefits package.

title: SAP EWM Specialist, Hybrid
description: Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging. Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging. We offer a competitive starting salary of €55,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. . Why you'll enjoy this new opportunity? At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters by helping organisations transform and thrive in a complex world. Joining our SAP Consulting practice as an SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) Specialist means becoming a vital part of a global, collaborative team delivering innovative supply chain solutions to leading clients across multiple industries. This role offers the challenge and opportunity to lead full lifecycle SAP EWM implementations, influence operational excellence, and develop your consulting and technical expertise in a fast-evolving digital landscape, with leadership opportunities and the satisfaction of driving measurable business improvements. Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position: Extensive, progressive experience in SAP EWM consulting with a proven track record of delivering complex implementations across industries such as manufacturing, retail, FMCG, or pharmaceuticals. Deep expertise in warehouse management processes including inbound/outbound logistics, inventory management, slotting, labour management, and automation technologies. SAP EWM certification is preferred; additional certifications in SAP TM, SAP WM, or SAP S/4HANA Logistics are highly advantageous. Strong client relationship management skills, combining technical knowledge with business acumen to align stakeholders and deliver successful outcomes. What type of work will I be doing? Leading project phases including requirements gathering, solution design, system configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Facilitating workshops, training sessions, and knowledge transfer with client teams to ensure smooth adoption of SAP EWM. Collaborating with internal and client stakeholders across supply chain, IT, production, and finance functions to ensure seamless integration. Supporting business development activities such as proposal writing and client presentations. Mentoring junior consultants and contributing to team growth. Acting as a trusted advisor by analysing client warehouse and logistics processes and designing tailored SAP EWM solutions. Ensuring timely delivery, quality, and alignment of solutions with client business objectives. Who is the Hiring Manager? The hiring manager, David McNamee, is a seasoned SAP Consulting leader with extensive expertise in supply chain and warehouse management solutions. He values collaborative leadership, open communication, and continuous learning. His management style encourages pragmatic problem solving, supports professional growth, and fosters a culture where diverse perspectives are respected and leveraged to deliver exceptional client outcomes. Where is this role based? This role is based in Dublin or Cork, with a flexible working model supporting hybrid arrangements combining office presence and remote work. You will also have opportunities to work on client sites as projects require. For more details, please visit our Deloitte Works webpage. If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process. What we offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options. Deloitte is the number one professional services firm in the world, and the leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, sustainability, tax, and related services. We have offices across Ireland in Dublin, Belfast, Cork, Limerick and Galway. Deloitte is proud of the enhanced flexibility that we offer our people through our hybrid working strategy, Deloitte Works. It means we trust our people with the flexibility and control to make the right choices in where, when, and how they work. Deloitte is looking for people that have a leadership mindset, are curious, enjoy solving challenges and are eager to grow their careers.

title: Global Finance
description:
We have experienced a very high interest for becoming a graduate at Novo Nordisk starting 1 September 2026. The application period ended 7 December 2026. We are reading applications now and first interviews for selected candidates will take place from 16-23 January 2026. Read more about the  application process.
The Global Finance Graduate Programme is designed to develop the next generation of finance leaders. With three rotations in various finance functions across our global value chain. The programme will provide you with the opportunity to bring your finance and business understanding into play to make a difference to patients and society and bring you on to an accelerated learning curve.
Start your career 1 September 2027. Apply here from November 2026. Until then  follow Novo Nordisk on LinkedIn  to get a better feeling of who we are. We welcome applications from all over the world.
Please note that we also offer our  International Operations Graduate Programme .
The full-time position as a Global Finance Graduate provides you with the opportunity to experience three exciting jobs in just two years . You will work in various finance functions across our global value chain from R&D to sales - ensuring a strong financial toolbox, including knowledge of digital tools, and a holistic understanding of Novo Nordisk and the pharmaceutical industry.
An example of a Global Finance graduate’s journey could look like this:
1. R&D Finance, HQ: Finance partnering supporting the management of investments in our future product pipeline
2. Novo Nordisk, Inc., US: Forecasting sales and analysing the market dynamics in the biggest market
3. Strategic Finance, HQ: Supporting senior management with key strategic projects and financial modelling in connection to our business development activities
Working at Novo Nordisk provides the opportunity to make a significant difference to patients and society while also delivering exciting results from a business perspective.
Throughout the programme you will gain hands-on experience with transforming data into business insights, communicating recommendations and creating measurable business impact. You will work with senior managers and build an international network of colleagues, establishing yourself as one of tomorrow’s key finance leaders at Novo Nordisk.
As you embark on your life-changing career in Novo Nordisk, we will provide you with:
Accelerated personal and professional development through one-on-one sparring with a senior mentor assigned to you from day one and an extensive, custom-built training programme
International experience by working abroad for eight months in one of our many affiliates or regional offices (e.g. USA, Colombia, Malaysia, a European capital or one of many other options)
A unique graduate community spanning across programmes filled with social activities and inspiring colleagues to spare with and learn from.
A competitive entry level salary.
For the positions starting 1 September 2027, we are looking for candidates with:
A Master’s degree from 2026 or 2027 in a relevant subject, for example Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or Management Accounting with strong academic achievements
Relevant work experience or extracurricular activities
No more than 1 year of full-time work experience between or after completing a Master’s degree
International experience from working, studying or volunteering
An international mind-set with an ability to adapt quickly to change and to relocate internationally as part of the programme
Professional fluency in English
You are welcome to apply for more than one track. However, we recommend you to carefully consider which tracks you will apply for and your motivation for doing so. You will have to make an individual application for each programme track and we encourage you to only apply for the tracks that you would be truly excited to join.
Be yourself and share why Novo Nordisk is the company you want to work for. What motivates you and why do you think being a graduate could be amazing. We would like to know who YOU are.
No, our corporate language is English, so speaking Danish is definitely not a requirement. There may be local language requirements for some International Operations (IO) tracks.

title: Software Engineer (Generative AI and Innovation)
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Excited by the pace of AI and the chance to build something meaningful? Join our growing Innovation team in Dublin and help create next-generation applications using the latest tools, technologies, and ideas. AI is a huge part of what we do — but we’re an innovation team first, applying whatever emerging technology best solves the problem, from LLMs to data, integration, and automation. 
 
 You’ll work alongside experienced and curious colleagues in a collaborative environment that encourages exploration, learning, and shared problem-solving. With strong support from senior leaders and visibility across the business, the team is well placed to develop, test, and scale new solutions. Your work will be visible, valued, and connected to key priorities from day one.   
 
 This is a hybrid position with a requirement of 3 days in the office. 

 
 THE ROLE & YOUR MISSION   
 

 This is an opportunity to grow as an engineer while building, testing, and scaling solutions that make a real difference. As a mid-level member of the team, you’ll take ownership of features and components end to end, turning ideas into practical applications that address real business and client needs — with AI and LLMs the biggest part of the toolkit, alongside data, integration, and automation. Alongside hands-on engineering, you’ll help shape our innovation hub by contributing to hackathons, engaging with the broader tech community, and supporting a culture centered on experimentation, learning, collaboration, and results.   
 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO   
 

 Own medium-scale features and components end to end, from prototyping through to production-ready solutions, with senior guidance available when you need it   

 
 Contribute to design discussions, bringing sound technical reasoning and viable suggestions to the table   

 
 Build practical applications — AI-powered and otherwise — that address real business problems and deliver measurable value   

 
 Work closely with colleagues across our Dublin and international Innovation teams, while taking initiative and contributing your own ideas   

 
 Work in an Agile environment where you can experiment, learn quickly, and see the impact of your work   

 
 Stay hands-on with the latest AI tools, models, and techniques, with ongoing opportunities to learn, test, and evolve   

 
 Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and follow good practice in prompt engineering, experimentation, and solution design   

 
 Create reusable components, tools, and patterns that help the wider team work more effectively and consistently   

 
 Share what you learn, support technical quality, and help junior colleagues grow through code reviews and pairing   

 

 WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT   
 
 This is a chance to accelerate your career in a team that’s growing quickly and working with purpose. You’ll own meaningful work, explore the latest technologies, and develop your craft while helping shape how we build. With strong leadership support, visibility across the business, and access to the resources of a global organization, you’ll have the platform to make a genuine impact while continuing to grow. And you’ll do it from Dublin, one of Europe’s most dynamic and well-connected tech hubs.   

 
 What you need to have: 
 
 Solid software engineering experience (typically 2–5 years), with a track record of delivering features independently   

 
 Experience contributing to production-grade applications   

 
 Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, including a framework such as React, Vue, or Angular   

 

 Backend experience with Node.js, NestJS, or similar technologies   

 
 Experience using Python to build AI-powered workflows, integrations, or applications   

 
 Good understanding of APIs and integrating AI into real-world products and business processes   

 
 Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, tool use, and structured outputs   

 
 Familiarity with RAG, retrieval pipelines, and embeddings   

 
 Exposure to modern agent patterns and multi-step, tool-connected workflows   

 
 Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes, and an interest in how AI applications are deployed and scaled   

 
 Good communication skills, a practical and thoughtful approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work across engineering and business teams   

 

 What makes you stand out:   
 

 Experience taking features from early experimentation through to production use   

 
 Curiosity about emerging standards in the agent ecosystem, including Model Context Protocol (MCP)   

 
 Exposure to vector databases and semantic search   

 
 An eye for the quality, reliability, latency, and cost-efficiency of AI systems   

 
 Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, and guardrails for reliable and responsible AI   

 
 A willingness to support others and contribute to engineering best practices   

 

 We know that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. If you’re excited about the role and believe you could thrive in it, we encourage you to apply.   
 
 Why join our team: 
 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. 
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities. 
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. 
 
 #MMCIC
 
 

 
 
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

 This role will be based in one of our Cork sites.
 
 Throughout the placement, you will be an integral part of Stryker’s 2027 Cooperative cohort.

 Tasks and responsibilities may include: 
 Support the planning and execution of leadership meetings and key site events.

 Assist in coordinating customer engagement programmes and internal/external site visits.

 Partner with teams such as the CI team to organise logistics for visits (scheduling, travel, catering, agendas).

 Help develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budget trackers.

 Support event logistics including invitations, registrations, and on-the-day coordination.

 Contribute to communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

 Assist in gathering and analysing event feedback to improve future experiences.

 Support the rollout of tools, templates, and processes for consistent event delivery.

 Research industry trends and best practices in customer experience and event management.

 
 What you will need: 
 Enrolled in a relevant Irish or Northern Irish university course or other related courses for the duration of the placement.

 Microsoft Office Suite e.g Word, Excel, Powerpoint. 

 
 What we can offer:

 Flexible working hours.

 Sports & Social  clubs and DE&I  Employee Resource Groups  and the opportunity to  connect with other co-ops .

title: Enterprise Operations Engineer II
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Enterprise Operations Engineer II 
The Mission Control and Operations Application Support Team is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who can help us monitor for and solve problems, help build our CI/CD pipeline and lead in automation and best practices. 
- Are you a born problem solver who loves to figure out how something works? 
- Are you a CI/CD geek who loves all things automation?
- Do you have a low tolerance for manual work and look to automate everything you can?
 
Mission Control and Operations is leading the DevOps transformation at Mastercard through our tooling and by being an advocate for change & standards throughout the development, quality, release, and product organizations. We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize needs and to build relationships is a must.
 
 
Responsibilities
 
For all team members:
· Monitor and Respond to production level alerts across multiple applications.
· Take a holistic approach to problem solving, by connecting the dots during a production event thru the various technology stack that makes up the platform, to optimize mean time to recover
· Work with a global team spread across tech hubs in multiple geographies and time zones
· Share knowledge and mentor junior resources
· Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement.
· Analyze ITSM activities of the platform and provide feedback loop to development teams on operational gaps or resiliency concerns
· Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
· Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
· Support the application CI/CD pipeline for promoting software into higher environments through validation and operational gating, and lead Mastercard in DevOps automation and best practices. 
· Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.
· Support deployments of code into multiple lower environments. Supporting current processes needed with an emphasis on automating everything as soon as possible.
 
Qualifications
 
· BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent practical experience.
· Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
· Experience with algorithms, data structures, scripting, pipeline management, and software design.
· Experience supporting web based applications, including SOAP and REST APIs, Tomcat, and Apache.
· Ability to write moderately complex SQL queries highly desirable.
· Ability to help debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks. 
· We support many different stakeholders. Experience in dealing with difficult situations and making decisions with a sense of urgency is needed.
· Experience in one or more of the following is preferred: C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Perl or Ruby.
· Interest in designing, analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.
· We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize needs and to build relationships is a must. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines.  Abbott in Ireland

 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny

Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems . 
 
 The Purpose of the Talent Development & Learning Specialist is to: 
 Develop and execute Learning & Development strategies, programmes, and systems that build organisational capability, enhance employee performance, and support current and future business objectives. Partner with leaders to identify development needs and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Partner with business and functional leaders to assess current and future capability requirements, conduct learning needs analyses, and develop learning strategies that support business growth and performance.

 Build strong relationships across site, divisional, and corporate functions to leverage enterprise learning solutions and best practices.

 Develop and maintain multi-year Learning & Development roadmaps that support organisational capability building and High-Performance Organisation (HPO) objectives.

 Support talent development initiatives that support succession planning, leadership capability, and workforce development.

 Develop career pathway resources and provide coaching and guidance to managers and employees on learning and development opportunities.

 Serve as site lead for further education initiatives and external audits from a Learning & Development perspective.

 Manage learning systems, curricula, training records, and learning documentation, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.

 Manage relationships with external learning providers, educational institutions, and strategic partners to support education outreach objectives.

 Develop communication and engagement strategies that increase awareness, accessibility, and adoption of Learning & Development programmes.

 Measure learning effectiveness, analyse training data, manage the L&D budget, and use insights to continuously improve learning outcomes and business impact.

 Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative learning practices to ensure programmes remain relevant and effective.

 
 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE 
 A third‑level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Management, or equivalent experience.
 Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Learning and Development role or equivalent; experience within the manufacturing industry is an advantage.
 Experience developing and implementing Learning & Development strategies aligned to organisational objectives.
 Experience conducting training needs analyses and translating business requirements into effective learning and capability-building solutions.
 Experience partnering with managers and senior leaders to identify capability gaps, talent development priorities, and succession planning needs.
 Experience using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning analytics to support decision-making, compliance, and continuous improvement.
 Exceptional interpersonal, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
 Strong project management with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results independently.
 Experience managing government training grants is desirable.

 Summary

You will work closely with a team of engineers and product managers to ideate, build, operate, and scale customer-facing features across the full development lifecycle. You will get the opportunity to work with modern technologies including a wide array of Amazon Web Services (AWS), Jenkins, New Relic, Sumo Logic, and proprietary Genesys software.
   
 About Our Team 
 Our team is primarily focused on maintaining and expanding the capabilities of:
 
 Customer Segmentation – groups customers by shared attributes and behaviours to provide context and enrichment for agentic orchestration
 
 
 Predictive Engagement – proactively engages with web or mobile app visitors to provide assistance when needed in their customer journ ey 
 
   
 Minimum Requirements 
 - 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering.
 - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
 - Advanced proficiency with Java and Spring Boot for backend systems.
 - Advanced proficiency with multi-layered testing approaches: unit, integration, and user-acceptance testing.
 - Experience with NoSQL database design, access patterns, and data modelling for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
 - Experience with common resiliency patterns in distributed microservice architectures: circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting, and retries.
 - Experience with event-driven architectural patterns and REST APIs.
 - Experience with AWS cloud-based technologies for deploying and managing software systems.
 - Experience working with CI/CD processes and technologies.
 - Experience designing and owning services end-to-end, from technical design through to production observability.
 - Experience with performance optimisation and troubleshooting production systems at scale.
 - Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.
 - Proactive, self-driven learner with strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, able to adopt new technologies and navigate ambiguity in an agile environment.
 - Demonstrated awareness of modern AI technologies and their implications (safety, privacy, reliability), with role-appropriate skills developed through training and applied practice.
 - Proven leadership experience with a track record of delivering complex software projects from concept through to production.
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work effectively with product, design, QA, and other teams to drive shared outcomes.
 - Confident communicator with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 - Drives initiatives to completion with minimal oversight
   
 Desirable Skills 
 - Experience with Amazon Web Services (or similar): EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, CloudFormation.
 - Experience with supporting technologies (or similar): Jenkins, Terraform, New Relic, OpenTelemetry, Sumo Logic, Kafka, Avro, Resilience4j, Swagger/OpenAPI.
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code ownership: designing modules, managing state, and handling multi-environment deployments.
 - Experience with other programming languages used in supporting services: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Groovy.
 - Experience using AI tooling as a co-pilot for developing production-ready code.
 - Contribution to on-call rotations and incident response.
   
 Our Benefits: 
 At Genesys, we’re committed to supporting your well-being, growth, and work–life balance. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
 Flexible work options  – Choose what works for you with hybrid schedules, work-from-home flexibility, and the option to collaborate onsite in our state-of-the-art Galway office.

 Career development & growth  – Access continuous learning opportunities, mentoring, and clear paths for advancement.

 Competitive pension scheme  – Invest in your future with an excellent employer-supported pension plan.

 Annual bonus program  – Be rewarded for your impact and contributions.

 Comprehensive health coverage  – Including private   health insurance, access to   company dental plan,   and wellness supports. 

 Financial protection  – Enjoy Income Protection and Life Assurance, along with  access to dedicated financial planning resources t o help you make confident, informed decisions about your future.

 Family-friendly policies  – Generous paid maternity and paternity

 
 Working at Genesys 
 AI at enterprise scale  – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year. 
 A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work. 
 Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support. 
 Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families. 
 Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys. 
 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. 

 What Happens After You Apply 
 After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: 
 Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team. 
 A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.  
 Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team. 
 We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases. 
 After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps. 
 Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process. 

 Stay Connected 
 Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available. 
 Get notified about relevant opportunities . 

 Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together. 
 Employee Referral 
 If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral. 

 About Genesys: 
 Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit  www.genesys.ai.

We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Trainee Product Technologist
description:
Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way.
 Quality at Primark 

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.
 What You’ll Ge t :
 People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle:
 27 days of leave, pension.
 Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.  
 

 What You’ll Do as a Trainee Product Technologist 
 We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:
 Support product development activities by building knowledge of fit, sealing routes, GPSR requirements, garment construction, grading, sizing, and risk assessment processes.
 Assist with fit sessions, product reviews, testing approvals, and compliance activities, developing an understanding of product testing standards, claims, and quality requirements.
 Build knowledge of fibres, fabrics, materials, sustainability initiatives, manufacturing processes, and factory operations to support informed product decisions.
 Develop strong supplier communication and relationship management skills while gaining experience with Primark quality systems and operational processes.
 Support departmental objectives through effective workload management, administrative support, KPI delivery, standardisation projects, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Communicate effectively with Buying teams, suppliers, and key stakeholders, gathering relevant information, solving problems, supporting quality-focused decision-making, and representing Quality Assurance in department meetings.
 

 What You’ll Bring   
 Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:
 Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared goals, proactively supporting team success and fostering positive working relationships.
 Demonstrate a growth mindset by seeking learning opportunities, embracing feedback, and continuously developing technical and professional capabilities.
 Show self-awareness and accountability, understanding personal strengths and development areas while taking ownership of individual performance.
 Manage workload effectively through strong organisation, prioritisation, and time-management skills, ensuring deadlines are met and stakeholders are kept informed.
 Adapt positively to changing business priorities and operational needs, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and a proactive, results-driven approach.
 

 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.
 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.
 So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.
 You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.
 If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist. 
 All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss. 
 #LI-Hybrid

Greece is rapidly expanding its BPO, tech, and tourism sectors, creating abundant opportunities for international professionals ready to relocate.
Speaking languages like German, Dutch, or Nordic tongues significantly increases your earning potential and career mobility in the local job market.
Workers in Greece benefit from a highly supportive 14-salary compensation system and comprehensive relocation packages designed to make moving seamless.
Are you a foreigner looking to live and work in Greece?
This guide explores the booming market for jobs in Greece for foreigners 2026. We will walk you through the top industries actively hiring, the specific language skills companies need most, and the fantastic relocation perks available. You will discover exactly what you need to build a sustainable and rewarding life under the beautiful Mediterranean sun.
High-Demand Jobs Greece Offers Right Now
The job market in Greece provides a wide variety of roles for professionals at all stages of their careers. Whether you are an entry-level candidate or an experienced manager, you will find positions that match your skills.
Customer Service and CX Support
The essence of customer service excellence lies in connection; it is the bridge built between understanding a customer's needs and delivering satisfying solutions. You will act as the frontline ambassador for top global brands, helping clients solve problems via phone, chat, and email. These roles offer excellent foundational training and clear pathways into team leadership.
Technical Support and IT
If you have a knack for problem-solving and an interest in technology, technical support roles provide an incredible entry point into the tech industry. Tech companies rely on knowledgeable professionals to help users navigate software issues and hardware glitches. Greece's tech sector is maturing rapidly, meaning these support roles often lead to advanced IT, networking, or cybersecurity positions.
Looking for work abroad in 2026? Explore customer service and multilingual career opportunities in Greece with TTEC Athens.
Sales and Business Development
International sales roles are perfect for confident communicators who enjoy building relationships and driving business growth. Companies look for ambitious individuals to manage accounts, generate leads, and close deals across European markets. These positions typically feature strong commission structures, rewarding your hard work directly.
Tourism and Hospitality
Tourism remains a cornerstone of the Greek economy. Hotels, travel agencies, and tour operators constantly seek international talent to provide exceptional service to global visitors. If you love creating memorable experiences for others, this sector offers dynamic, fast-paced roles that let you showcase the beauty of Greece to the world.
Your job search and application process in Greece as a foreigner will likely be very similar to your job search elsewhere. You can apply online through career sites and job portals. Additionally, you'll be required to process your work visa and permits. Global companies, like TTEC Athens , will provide guidance and assistance throughout your journey, so don't be afraid to ask.
The Power of Languages in Multilingual Jobs Greece
Being able to speak two or more languages is an incredible asset for businesses looking to expand their customer base and reach new markets. While English is the standard corporate language, specific European languages command a premium.
If you speak German or Dutch, your skills are incredibly valuable. Companies serving the vast DACH and Benelux regions constantly recruit talent to support these robust markets. Nordic languages—such as Swedish, Norwegian, and Danish—are equally prized. Because there are fewer native speakers of these languages available locally, companies compete fiercely to hire and retain this talent.
Pursuing multilingual jobs Greece allows you to leverage your native tongue to secure better pay, faster promotions, and greater job security. Your cultural intelligence helps global brands connect authentically with their customers, making you an indispensable part of the team.

Understanding your earning potential is a crucial step in planning your move. Greece offers a compensation structure that is both unique and highly beneficial for workers.
The 14-Salary System
When evaluating international careers Greece, you must factor in the 14-salary system . By law, private-sector employees receive their standard 12 monthly salaries, plus additional payments to support them during major holidays. You receive a full extra salary in December, half a salary before Easter, and half a salary before your summer vacation. This structure provides a fantastic financial cushion, making it easier to budget for travel and leisure.

Board Level Test Engineer; Santa Clara, CA
Job Description:-
Key Responsibilities
•     Perform first-level hardware triage and troubleshooting for server platforms.
•     Design and implement diagnostic tools and scripts for early hardware validation and fault isolation.
•     Identify and resolve setup issues and test failures using structured troubleshooting methodologies.
•     Develop and maintain test automation using Shell and Python scripting.
•     Work with motherboards and GPU platforms in lab environments.
•     Work with systems connected by various networking protcols, including Ethernet, NVLink and Infiniband
•     Operate in Windows and Linux operating systems for test and debug tasks.
•     Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support diagnostics, validation, and smooth product transitions in the NPI cycle.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
•     BS Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
•     Strong scripting skills in Python and  Shell.
•     Familiarity with Windows and Linux OS environments.
•     Working knowledge of hardware protocols: Ethernet, Infiniband, PCIe, USB, HDMI, I2C, SPI.
•     Experience with CPUs and GPUs.
•     Proficient in using test equipment for diagnostics and validation.
•     Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
•     Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Mandatory Skills: VLSI Board Design .
Experience: 3-5 Years .

Postęp może wydarzyć się tylko wtedy, gdy ludzie zjednoczą się i podejmą działania. Jesteśmy absolutnie zaangażowani w budowanie kultury, w której nasi pracownicy mogą to robić.
Mamy dla Ciebie świetną propozycję, aby dołączyć do naszego zespołu jako Junior Accountant,  na stałe, w wymiarze  pełnego etatu.  Stanowisko dostępne jest w jednej z naszych lokalizacji w  Polsce: Warszawa, Lublin, Wrocław, Poznań lub Kraków ,  w modelu hybrydowym  i daje możliwość przyczynienia się do rozwoju naszego działu  Księgowości.
Zakres obowiązków:
Prowadzenie ksiąg powierzonych Klientów ze wsparciem przełożonego
Dekretowanie i księgowanie dokumentów księgowych
Rozliczanie podatków VAT i CIT oraz sporządzanie odpowiednich deklaracji podatkowych
Udział w przygotowywaniu elementów sprawozdań finansowych
Przygotowywanie raportów i miesięcznych bilansów
Przygotowywanie i dokonywanie płatności
Bieżąca komunikacja z Klientami
Profil:
Conajmniej roczne doświadczenie zawodowe na podobnym stanowisku
Praktyczna znajomość zagadnień z zakresu przepisów podatkowych oraz ustawy o rachunkowości
Chęć dalszego rozwoju w obszarze pełnej księgowości
Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego
Wykształcenie kierunkowe
Umiejętność budowania relacji z klientem zewnętrznym i wewnętrznym
Umiejętność organizacji pracy własnej
Co oferujemy:
Zdrowie pracowników jest dla nas ważne – otrzymasz możliwość dofinansowania do prywatnej opieki medycznej dla Ciebie i Twoich bliskich.
Dbamy o zdrowy tryb życia i aktywność sportową – otrzymasz możliwość dofinansowania do karty Multisport.
Jeżeli tak jak my cenisz sobie work-life balance, to zapewne ucieszy Cię, że umożliwiamy elastyczne godziny pracy i tryb pracy hybrydowej.
Ważne jest dla Ciebie bezpieczeństwo? Otrzymasz możliwość wykupienia dodatkowego ubezpieczenia na życie.
Ponieważ chcemy wspierać Twój rozwój, umożliwimy Ci dołączenie na bezpłatne lekcje z języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego.
Gwarantujemy stabilność zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę z firmą działającą globalnie, o ugruntowanej pozycji na rynku.
Ponieważ najważniejszy jest dla nas Twój rozwój zawodowy, zapewnimy szkolenia wewnętrzne, a także dofinansowanie do szkoleń zewnętrznych lub studiów podyplomowych, a także jasną ścieżka kariery Vistra.
Mając na uwadze Twoją wygodę oraz oszczędność czasu, nasze nowoczesne biuro jest zlokalizowane w centrum miasta.
Jesteśmy świadomi ekologicznie: adoptujemy pszczoły, zachęcamy pracowników do przyjeżdżania rowerem (mamy rowerowy parking!), a nasz budynek jest eco-friendly.

title: Graduate Rotation Programme 2026 - Supply Chain
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Join Viatris' 2026 Graduate Development Programme – Shape the Future of Pharma 
 
 
 Are you ready to kick-start your career in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Viatris is now accepting applications for its 2026 Graduate Development Programme, aimed at developing the next generation of leaders. 
 
 About the Programme: 
 
 Launching in September 2025, the Viatris Graduate Development Programme is designed to equip high-performing graduates with the skills, knowledge, and experience to thrive in a dynamic global healthcare environment. 
 
 Throughout this two-year programme, you will have the opportunity to rotate across three well-structured departments at one of our cutting-edge pharmaceutical sites in Dublin, Cork, Galway, or our Global office in Dublin. Our locations include the manufacturing sites in Damastown (Dublin 15), Baldoyle (Dublin 13), Inverin (Galway), Little Island (Cork) and the corporate office in Northern Cross (Dublin 17). 
 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 During the 2-year program, participants will participate in 3 structured rotations across various site departments such as (Production, Automation, Engineering, EHS, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and OpEx, etc.). 

 Gain exposure to day-to-day operations in a pharmaceutical organisation while being assigned to specific impactful projects. 

 Receive continuous mentorship and training from senior colleagues who will guide your growth and development. 

 Expand your technical abilities and key business skills in a progressive, innovative environment. 

 Graduates will participate in careers fairs, TY & STEM Ireland events. 

 
 What You Will Gain: 
 In-depth knowledge of Viatris business and operations. 

 Practical experience working with cutting-edge pharmaceutical technology. 

 A tailored, comprehensive onboarding program that sets you up for success. 

 A clear pathway for career progression within a leading global pharmaceutical company. 

 Who We Are Looking For: 
 Recent graduates or upcoming graduates with an Honours degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math), 3rd level qualification. A grade of 2.1 or higher is a requirement for the programme. 

 Demonstrated success in previous work experience, placement, or extracurricular activities. 

 Interest in pursuing a career in the pharmaceutical industry; Production, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain etc. 

 High achievers who thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. 

 Strong communicators with a passion for making a difference in healthcare. 

 Ambitious individuals eager to take on challenges and make an impact. 

 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
 
 Join our team! 
 
 Viatris is more than just a place to work. We are a new kind of healthcare company, one where you can make a difference in the world. If you inspired by our commitment to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, explore our global opportunities and find your team today. Visit Viatris.com/careers.
 
 Why Viatris? 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. You will also have the opportunity to access excellent career progression opportunities and work-life balance initiatives.
 
 Diversity & Inclusion at Viatris 
 At Viatris, diversity and inclusion are essential to our mission. The diversity we foster in all aspects of our business can be one of our greatest strengths in redefining healthcare not as it is, but as it should be. If you would like to know more about what diversity, equity and inclusion means to us, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion 
 
 
 
 Sustainability at Viatris 
 Corporate social responsibility is fundamental to the Viatris mission. We work to advance responsible and sustainable operations and leverage our collective expertise to empower people to live healthier at every stage of life, recognizing that our actions affect the stakeholders and communities we serve. To learn more about our efforts, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility 
 
 A t Viatris, we offer   competitive   salar ies , benefits   and   an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.   
 
 Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
