Job Description:
Sales Executive - New Business Development Hunter, Capital Markets
Wipro’s Capital Markets division delivers cutting-edge IT services and innovative solutions tailored for a diverse range of global clients operating within Investment Management and Asset Servicing, Global Markets, Wealth Management, Data Management, Post-trade Services, and Risk and Compliance sectors. Our team champions digital transformation initiatives that enhance both employee and client experiences, while managing critical elements crucial to our clients’ business success.
We invite motivated professionals to apply for the role of New Business Development Sales Executive , primarily focusing on cultivating and acquiring new business within the Capital Markets sector. Based in the New York City / New Jersey metropolitan area , this role emphasizes targeted client acquisition and expanding Wipro’s footprint by securing new logos and generating substantial long-term revenue contributions, with an ambitious annual target ranging from $10M to $15M.
Key Responsibilities Include:
Develop and implement comprehensive go-to-market strategies to identify, engage, and secure new Capital Markets clients with a clear focus on relationship building and opportunity creation.
Identify, establish, and nurture connections with key decision makers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and strategic partner within client organizations.
Lead client workshops, boot camps, and strategic sessions to effectively demonstrate Wipro’s tailored solutions and value propositions aligned with client needs and industry trends.
Leverage existing alliances and external partnerships, including cloud, digital, and emerging technologies, to co-create and pitch joint solutions expanding Wipro’s service offerings.
Manage and forecast account resources accurately by tracking confirmed opportunities and maintaining a robust sales pipeline to ensure consistent business growth.
Required Qualifications and Attributes:
A seasoned Senior Business Development Executive (Hunter), with a proven ability to secure new clients and accelerate growth within the Capital Markets domain, demonstrating strong domain expertise and business acumen.
Extensive experience selling diverse IT services across multiple client service areas including Cloud, Data Analytics, Infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, and other advanced technology solutions.
Consistent achievement of sales targets in complex, consultative selling environments underpinned by IT solution selling methodologies.
Strong analytical skills to monitor market trends, client behaviors, and competitive landscape, incorporating insights into flexible and effective business development strategies.
Strong pipeline development and forecast accuracy skills to manage sales cycles effectively.
Collaborative mindset to work seamlessly with alliance partners and internal product teams to develop cohesive client solutions.
Insightful understanding of market dynamics, competitor offerings, and regulatory environments impacting Capital Markets.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage stakeholders at all levels of the client organization.
Discover More About Wipro : Wipro Limited stands among the foremost global technology, consulting, and business process services enterprises. We harness the strengths of cognitive computing, hyper-automation, robotics, cloud computing, analytics, and emerging technologies to empower clients on their digital transformation journeys, delivering measurable business success.
Rooted in principles of sustainability and corporate responsibility, Wipro employs over 200,000 dedicated professionals across six continents, fostering an environment of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning. Our mission is to co-create sustainable futures by connecting ideas and technologies that shape the business landscapes of tomorrow.

title: Administrator - Retail Dept.
description:
Kepak is a global food company serving international retailers and food service household names with prime cuts of meat, on-trend food concepts and ready-for-market convenience foods.  
 Kepak St. Merryn in Merthyr Tydfil  has combined beef and lamb processing and packing facilities. We offer beef and lamb products ranging from retail ready cuts for butchers’ counters to branded packaged meat, all as part of our service; raised on open pastures, sourced from local farmers and hand-selected by our master butchers, we produce beef and lamb products with integrity and unmatched quality assurance.  
 We are excited to be recruiting for an Administrator to work within our Retail Department on a full time, permanent contract. The hours are 6.00am to 2.00pm - 3 on/3 off - on £13.96 per hour. 
 Role Purpose: 
 To provide efficient and accurate administrative support to the Retail department, ensuring timely reporting, data integrity and effective record management. The Retail Admin will support operational performance by maintaining production information, monitoring key performance indicators, coordinating documentation and facilitating communication between departments to ensure the smooth running of retail operations.
 Requirements 
 Maintain accurate production, labour, yield and attendance records on a daily basis. 
 Input, update and validate data across business systems and spreadsheets. 
 Produce daily, weekly and monthly operational reports and KPI summaries. 
 Ensure all production paperwork is completed accurately, filed correctly and retained in accordance with company procedures.
 Support stock reconciliation processes and investigate discrepancies as required. 
 Assist management with labour reporting, absence tracking and performance data. 
 Create and maintain departmental trackers, logs and administrative records. 
 Liaise with Production, Planning, Technical, Engineering, HR and Finance teams to ensure information is communicated accurately and efficiently. 
 Support audit preparation by ensuring required documentation is readily available and up to date. 
 Monitor departmental consumables and raise purchase requisitions when required. 
 Always maintain confidentiality of business and employee information. 
 Challenge inaccuracies and follow up outstanding information to ensure data integrity. 
 Support continuous improvement initiatives through accurate reporting and analysis. 
 Provide administrative cover and support to other departments when required. 
 Comply with all Health & Safety, Food Safety, Quality and Environmental procedures.
 Skills & Experience: 
 Strong administration and record-keeping skills
 Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team
 Experience of using various systems and databases
 Proactive, adaptable and willing to learn
 Benefits 
 31 days annual leave per year  (after probation).
 Annual Holiday Purchase Scheme  - Need a little more time off? Purchase additional annual leave.
 Company Pension Scheme  - Helping you plan for the future with access to our company pension scheme.
 Death in Service Benefit  - Eligible salaried employees are covered by our Death in Service benefit, providing financial support and peace of mind for your loved ones.
 Refer a Friend Scheme  - Earn up to £500 for successfully referring a friend or family member to join Kepak.
 Free On-Site Parking  - Our site has dedicated staff parking, available free of charge for all colleagues.
 Subsidised On-Site Canteen  - Enjoy a variety of freshly prepared hot meals and food options at reduced prices in our on-site canteen.
 Cycle to Work Scheme  - Save money on a new bike and cycling equipment through our salary sacrifice scheme.
 Electric Vehicle Scheme  - Access an electric vehicle through our salary sacrifice scheme.
 Long Service Awards  - We recognise, acknowledge and celebrate the loyalty, dedication and valuable contributions of our long-serving colleagues.
 Discounted Gym Memberships  - Support your health and wellbeing with access to discounted gym memberships.
 Training and Development  - We are committed to helping you grow your career through structured onboarding, regular online and in-person training, and clear opportunities for career progression.
 Mentoring and Leadership Development Programmes  - Whether you're looking to build new skills or take the next step in your career, our mentoring and leadership development programmes are designed to help you reach your full potential.
 GroceryAid Employee Assistance Programme  - Free and confidential emotional, practical and financial support for all Kepak colleagues, including access to counselling, mental health support, legal guidance and a 24/7 confidential helpline.
 Financial Advice & Will Writing - Access free mortgage advice and a complimentary will writing service as part of your employee benefits package.

title: Careers at Monument
description:
Careers at Monument
Meet our People
Our Benefits
Our Locations
Open Vacancies
LEARN, BUILD & GROW WITH US!
At Monument Re Group, our teams across all our locations work collaboratively, which has resulted in our continued growth in recent years.  We create an environment where our employees can learn , build, and grow  the knowledge, skills, and talents we bring together.
Do you share our values?
Our vision is to work together and grow with the right people who live and breathe our values to commit and own, trust, collaborate, learn and have flexibility.
Commit & Own
We take personal accountability and are prepared to go the extra mile.
Trust
We show trust and respect for our colleagues.
Flexible
We are adaptable and focus on key priorities (existing and new).
Collaborate
We practice and foster collaboration and teamwork.
Learn
We are future oriented and look for ways of innovating and improving.
Meet Our People
Ross Stevenson
“I’ve worked within the change function. The role is highly varied, challenging, and rewarding. It requires a balance of self-initiative and collaboration; the latter of which is with the Management Team of Monument Assurance Luxembourg and the wider Monument Re Group. You are given a platform for engagement with key internal and external stakeholders, which in turn helps execute the operating model of the Monument Re Group and ensures that change is delivered methodically with appropriate ‘guardrails for growth’ in place.
The staff, and in particular the culture, are integral to the change delivery, as we collectively share the same core values to achieve our goals for future growth”.
Matt Quine, Compliance Technician – MILAC
“I found the joining process much easier than anticipated. Everyone was so warm and welcoming. I settled in quickly and within a couple of weeks, it felt like a role I had been in for years. The company cares about its employees and is willing to invest in staff who want to work hard and better themselves.”
Shaun Wainwright, Project Manager – MILAC
“Working for Monument has been a great experience which all started from the onboarding process, engaged, energized and welcoming are just a few of the experiences of my journey into the company. During my time here, I’ve been encouraged to make decisions and to share my experiences to support building a flexible working structure within the project management office. Ownership is one of the core values at Monument which drives the team forward for success, it’s been a truly encouraging start to my time here.”
Hendy Trieu, Client Administration Analyst – United Kingdom
“My time at Monument Re has been delightful – the workplace is a flexible, accommodating and friendly environment. Everyone is welcoming, including Management and HR who make an effort to communicate and it always feels like I’m working within a team. The company is full of knowledgeable individuals who are always willing to help. All of this has made my transition into the reinsurance sector very easy. I also appreciate that there are development opportunities to shape my own pathway. I have been studying for a professional qualification as well as taking online courses to further my career”
Benefits For Our Whole Team
Below are the benefits we offer to our Group. A wider benefits package is available in each location and differs from country to country.
Competitive annual leave options are on offer in each location.
Generous reward packages with competitive pay.
To help you invest in your future, we offer Employer Pension Plans.
We support you with a flexible hybrid work model.

From concept to object, in every details
As a mechanical design engineer at Expleo, you will design and develop mechanical components or systems, providing detailed 3D digital mock-ups and 2D drawings for a wide array of industries, including aerospace, automotive, rail, and defence.
Working alongside cross-functional teams in stress analysis, systems installation, and manufacturing, you’ll bring creative solutions from concept to completion, contributing to products that range from car plastic trims to aircraft structure’s critical parts and assemblies.
Does it sound like we’re talking about you?
You’re in the right place.
Search open positions

Commercial aircraft’s critical parts in composite
Largest European carmakers’ chassis, BIW and equipment s
Rolling stock’s cabin architecture and equipment
Sport car exterior and interior (from sketch to product)
Next gen space launcher’s thermal shield
Nuclear submarine’s architecture and hull
At Expleo, I value the opportunity to work globally and connect with teams across different engineering fields. From the UK to the US, it’s inspiring to collaborate on challenging projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible.
James
Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at Expleo
A day in the life of an Expleo mechanical design engineer
Morning
Setting up for the day, checking emails and reviewing project updates; aligning with team members on any urgent issues.
Mid-morning
Diving into CAD modelling to refine designs, adjusting specifications as needed based on team and client feedback.
Noon
Working with cross-functional teams to ensure design feasibility, aligning with stress engineers, systems installation engineers and production engineers.
After lunch
Analysing feedback from the factory, suppliers and customer support, to modify the design or the material of the part.
Afternoon
Reviewing the part with internal stakeholders, to release the final design to the production team.
End of day
Assessing progress, setting priorities, and preparing goals for the next day.

Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., CATIA, SolidWorks)
Knowledge of technical drawing basics & standards

Familiarity with material properties and stress analysis principles
Knowledge of various manufacturing processes

Strong communication and collaboration abilities
Attention to detail and a proactive approach
Problem-solving mindset and adaptability
Curiosity

Project management essentials and team coordination

Read other stories from our veterans
What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.

title: Quality And Reliability Engineer
description:
Job Details: 
 
 Job Description:  The Role and Impact 
As a Customer Quality and Reliability Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring customer satisfaction by driving technical quality support across the product lifecycle. From customer design qualification to production ramp and field returns, you will collaborate with customers to resolve technical challenges, analyze quality trends, and provide impactful support. Your work will directly influence Intel's product quality goals, ensuring robust platforms and accelerating customer success.

 Business group 
You will join Intel's Customer Quality and Reliability organization, a team dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences through technical collaboration and quality assurance. This group focuses on aligning Intel's product development with customer needs, addressing technical challenges, and driving systematic improvements to enhance reliability, manufacturability, and satisfaction. By supporting Intel's broader mission of innovation and excellence, this team empowers customers globally to achieve their business goals.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Collaborate with customers to identify and resolve technical quality issues, ensuring timely solutions to maintain business continuity.

 Analyze customer quality trends and transform insights into systematic improvement actions to enhance platform robustness.

 Drive quality support during customer design qualification, production ramp, and field returns, providing impactful technical guidance.

 Align design for manufacturability (DFX/DFM) requirements and address customer production challenges for accelerated ramp success.

 Communicate customer quality voice through expert listening to influence Intel's quality systems and future product goals.

 Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts to ensure rapid resolution of customer technical issues.

 
 
 Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in engineering, materials science, (e.g., Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Electrical/Mechanical/Chemical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering, Nanotechnology, Mathematics, or related field), with 0-1 years of hands-on experience in the domain, demonstrated through internships, academic projects, coursework or hands-on training OR Master's degree in a relevant field with no prior professional experience.

 Proficiency in data analysis and quality engineering fundamentals, with the ability to draw actionable insights from customer feedback.

 Knowledge of manufacturability and reliability principles, including DFX/DFM practices.

 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach challenges methodically and deliver practical solutions.

 Effective communication and collaboration skills, enabling seamless interaction with customers and cross-functional teams.

 Familiarity with customer engagement and support processes in a technical environment.

 
We are looking for motivated individuals who are ready to make a difference by ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction and driving Intel's quality standards to new heights. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of technology innovation while building a fulfilling and impactful career.

As a senior Test Specialist, you'll lead end-to-end testing activities on high-profile projects, shaping test strategies, driving quality outcomes, and ensuring solutions meet the demanding standards of our customers. You'll also mentor fellow testers, influence best practice across the team, and help deliver mission-critical services that support BT's commitments to the UK Defence sector.
What you’ll be doing
Lead end-to-end testing activities across complex Defence projects, developing test strategies and ensuring solutions are validated against customer and contractual requirements.
Create and maintain high-quality test artefacts, including Test Strategy, Test Plans, Test Cases, Defect Reports, Progress Reports, and Completion Reports using IBM ELM.
Execute testing across BT, customer, and supplier environments, identifying, analysing, and managing defects to support successful service delivery.
Manage multiple project deliveries simultaneously while championing testing best practices, governance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Act as a senior member of the Defence Test team, mentoring junior testers, resolving complex challenges, and supporting the delivery of mission-critical services.
Essential Skills / Experience
Test Management & Delivery – Excellent understanding of defence industry and defence contracts, as well as testing principles and methodologies, with experience creating and managing test artefacts including Test Strategies, Test Plans, Test Cases, Defect Reports, and Test Completion Reports.
Technical Analysis & Validation – Ability to interpret network and solution design documentation, derive effective test cases, use test techniques to reduce risks, execute risk-based testing, and validate complex technical solutions.
Stakeholder Engagement – Experience working with project teams, architects, customers, and technical stakeholders, with excellent written and verbal communication skills to influence outcomes and report findings clearly.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Mentoring & Continuous Improvement – Experience coaching junior testers and driving improvements to testing processes, tools, and quality practices.
Emerging Technologies Knowledge – Interest in and exposure to new technologies such as cloud services, AI, automation, or sovereign cloud environments.
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
•    10% on target annual bonus
•    Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
•    Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
•    Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
•    Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
•    Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
•    Holiday purchase scheme
You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready.
This role offers a 3 together, 2 wherever working model. This means you are required to be at your contractual location 3 days a week with 2 flexible days per week.
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good.  Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country.   Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: AML Analyst (Dentons Business Services EMEA)
description:
Introduction Dentons Business Services EMEA is the operational backbone of Dentons, supporting the world's largest law firm in delivering exceptional service to clients across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. As a crucial component of Dentons' global network, our EMEA business services team plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration. 
 At Dentons Business Services EMEA, we are committed to excellence in supporting legal professionals with cutting-edge solutions. Our dynamic and diverse team collaborates seamlessly to provide a wide range of services, including finance, IT, human resources, marketing, and more. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
 Role The purpose of this role is to support the AML Operations Manager and the Global Head of AML and Sanctions Compliance in implementing the Firm-wide Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and sanctions programme and undertake Client Due Diligence (CDD) checks on clients. 
 The role will involve assessing clients and their matters to ensure compliance with applicable AML legislation and to advise the Firm on financial crime and other risk issues.  
 
 Accountabilities and Responsibilities Undertaking and handling all types of Client Due diligence (CDD) 
 Review and assess the risks of all new clients and matters from AML, sanctions and reputational risks perspective;
 Undertaking client and matter risk assessments
 Undertaking sanctions screening updates;
 Assisting with the ongoing monitoring of clients and matters  
 Advising on sanctions, professional ethical obligations, matter and billing structure, engagement terms and inter-office working arrangements
 Providing a 'concierge' service to partners by liaising with clients directly on AML and sanctions issues, either in person, on the phone or in writing.
 Managing all stages of the matter opening process and escalate any issues as necessary
 Assists with the firm's internal audit processes;
 Dealing with basic data protection queries relevant to AML
 Assisting with AML and Sanctions training to the Firm
 Reviewing and updating Dentons' internal compliance policies and procedures
 Assisting with projects and ad hoc assignments as required
 
 The above list is not exhaustive as the team and the firm continue to evolve and develop with the changing domestic and international legal landscapes and as we identify new ways of improving our service to the firm.
 More important than any particular skill, we are looking for dynamic and flexible team players with highly developed critical thinking who can assess legal and commercial risks presented to the firm and advise on appropriate mitigation strategies.
 - As this role supports UK region please note that it requires operating within UK time-zone therefore working hours are from 10 am – 6 pm 
 - This role operates in Hybrid working model requiring DBSE Warsaw office presence 1-2 times a week
 Requirements 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Relevant University Degree
 1-2 years legal or compliance experience working in a law firm or a professional services environment. Other experience which demonstrates the necessary critical thinking and risk assessment will be considered.
 Highly effective research skills using all relevant information sources, including IT resources and ability to use them to their full potential
 A good knowledge of relevant compliance rules and regulations, including (but not limited to) client care, conflicts of interest, confidentiality, anti-bribery and corruption, money laundering, sanctions.
 Able to assemble research and produce clear, accurate findings
 Can analyse issues and draw/express conclusions succinctly
 Able to use internal precedents and draft emails in plain English
 PC literate with a good working knowledge of MS Office, e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
 Able to keep all general administration up-to-date and under control
 Experience using new business intake systems e.g Intapp OPEN
 
 Personal skills / attributes 
 Versatile, resourceful and creative thinker who is ready to get involved in whatever task is facing the team
 Proficient written and verbal communication skills
 Can effectively and clearly explain problems and issues to partners and clients and actively contribute to their resolution
 Strong problem solving and analytical skills; can clearly explain and present problems and issues to others
 Able to demonstrate strong customer facing skills
 Able to make incisive decisions and operate efficiently in challenging situations
 Able to effectively manage and prioritise tasks where appropriate
 Able to analyse and recognise the need for improvement to systems and controls and suggest options for improvements to the AML Operations Manager.
 Take an efficient and organised approach to dealing with administration.
 Able to be an ambassador for Dentons, being professional in outlook and attitude
 Benefits 
 
 Private medical healthcare provided by Medicover 
 MultiSport card 
 Benefit Cafeteria system  
 Option to join a private insurance plan 
 An additional day off for your birthday 
 Tailored learning & development opportunities 
 Hybrid work model with a modern office in Warsaw city center

What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.
How do you connect with other members of the Armed Forces Community at Expleo?
I participate in careers  transition workshops

Strong applications help employers understand who you are, what you can do and why you are a good fit for an opportunity. Whether you are applying for a part-time job, internship, placement, graduate programme or postgraduate study, taking time to tailor your application can significantly improve your chances of success.
Our resources can help you create effective CVs, write tailored cover letters, complete application forms successfully and use AI responsibly throughout the application process.
CVs
Your CV is often the first impression an employer has of you. It should clearly showcase your education, experience, skills and achievements while demonstrating your suitability for the role.
A strong CV should:
Be tailored to the specific opportunity
Highlight relevant skills, experience and achievements
Use evidence and examples to support claims
Be clear, concise and easy to read
Be updated regularly as you gain new experience
Be optimised for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
Cover Letters
A cover letter gives you the opportunity to explain why you are interested in a role, why you want to work for a particular organisation and why you would be a strong candidate.
A good cover letter complements your CV by providing context, explaining your motivation and highlighting the experiences most relevant to the position.
Effective cover letters should:
Be tailored to the employer and role
Demonstrate knowledge of the organisation
Highlight relevant skills and experiences
Show genuine motivation and interest
Be concise, focused and professional
Application Forms
Many employers use application forms instead of, or along with CVs, particularly for graduate programmes, internships, public sector roles and large organisations. Application forms often require detailed evidence of your skills, experience and achievements through competency-based questions.
Completing an application form successfully requires careful preparation, strong examples and an understanding of what employers are looking for.
Our application form resources can help you:
Analyse job descriptions and person specifications
Identify the skills employers are assessing
Structure answers using the STAR (Sitaution, Task, Action, Result) or CARR (Context, Action, Result, Reflection) technique
Provide strong evidence and examples
Demonstrate transferable skills effectively
Prepare for online recruitment processes such as psychometric testing and Assessment Centre,   visit our dedicated section on these topics .
Using AI Responsibly in Job Applications
Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a useful tool when preparing applications, but employers expect applications to accurately reflect your own skills, experiences and achievements.
AI should support your application process rather than replace your own thinking and input.
You may find AI useful for:
Brainstorming ideas and examples
Identifying transferable skills
Improving structure and clarity -   never let AI write your job application!
Checking spelling and grammar
Researching employers and industries
When using AI:
Ensure all content is accurate and reflects your own experience
Review and edit AI-generated suggestions carefully and verify any information it gives you
Use your own voice and communication style
Be prepared to discuss everything included in your application
Avoid sharing personal, confidential or sensitive information with public AI tools

title: Motor Claims FNOL Agent
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Motor Claims FNOL Agent 
 
 Job Location: Dublin – Hybrid. Remote working considered.
 Job Type: Permanent Remuneration : Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications  
 Join our team as a Motor Claims FNOL Agent, supporting customers from first notification through to claim registration and triage while delivering an outstanding claims experience. 
 As a Motor Claims FNOL Agent, you will be the first point of contact for customers reporting motor claims, ensuring every notification is handled efficiently, accurately and with a strong focus on customer service. Working within a fast-paced claims environment, you will gather and assess claim information, register claims and ensure they are allocated appropriately for further handling.
 You will play a key role in the triage and assessment of motor claims, capturing accurate information, asking probing questions where required and ensuring high-quality data is recorded from the outset. Your ability to identify customer needs and promote relevant support services will help enhance the overall claims experience.
 
 The role involves liaising with a range of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, brokers, third-party representatives, internal technical experts and aligned service providers. You will ensure that appropriate documentation is issued promptly, instructions are provided to suppliers and all claim records are maintained to the highest standard.
 
 Success in this role requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to remain organised and focused while working under pressure. You will enjoy working as part of a collaborative team and will be supported in your ongoing development through mentoring, training and career progression opportunities.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply: 
 Claims or Insurance Experience - Previous experience within insurance, broking, claims handling or a customer-focused environment is advantageous but not essential.

 Insurance Qualifications - APA qualification, or working towards APA, is desirable. Candidates without qualifications who demonstrate a strong aptitude and willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

 Motor Claims Knowledge - Understanding of motor claims processes, policy structures and claims classifications would be beneficial.

 Communication Skills - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with customers, brokers and colleagues.

 Customer Focus - Committed to delivering excellent customer service and creating positive customer outcomes.

 Organisation & Attention to Detail - Highly organised with strong administrative skills and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.

 Problem Solving & Decision Making - Able to assess information, identify appropriate next steps and make informed decisions within agreed processes.

 Technology Skills - Confident using databases and IT systems, with strong data entry and record management capabilities.

 Teamwork & Collaboration - A proactive team player who works effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across the business.

 Adaptability & Resilience - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing competing priorities and maintaining a positive approach under pressure.

 
 What we'll give you for this role: Bike to Work Scheme
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4)
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4)
 EAP – Employee Assistance Programme 
 Life Cover
 PHI – Permanent Health Insurance
 Exams & Professional Membership Fees
 Professional and personal development opportunities
 
 This isn't just a position, it's an opportunity to build a rewarding career in claims. 
 At Sedgwick, you'll help people and businesses recover when the unexpected happens, working alongside some of the most trusted names in insurance. From day one, you'll have access to learning and development opportunities, including support towards professional qualifications and ongoing career development. You'll join a collaborative team that values innovation, customer service and continuous improvement, where every role contributes to our purpose of caring for people and helping businesses recover.
 
 Next steps 
 Think we'd be a great match? We'd love to hear from you - apply today. 
 
 If you're unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences, including those returning to work or looking for a new career opportunity.
 Sedgwick is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and does not tolerate discrimination of any kind. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.
 Following the closing date, applications will be reviewed and shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, either virtually or in person.
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function (CF5) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them.

title: TFSM IR EHS Environmental Engineer
description:
Job Details: 
 
 Job Description:  In this position, you will be part of a site environmental team and will be responsible for the development, co-ordination, continuous improvement and management of site environmental programmes, such as hazardous and non-hazardous waste, waste water, air emissions, noise, refrigerants, groundwater and management systems etc. 
   
 Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to: 
 Playing a key role in ensuring compliance with the site's Industrial Emissions Licence and ISO14001 standard. This includes review of compliance results/trends, environmental management system elements including awareness/training, documentation, environmental management programme projects etc., incident investigation and root cause analysis. 

 Understand how all environmental programmes work by supporting all Environmental Engineers at the site with a view to becoming a primary owner for environmental media programmes, with additional responsibility as secondary owner for other programmes. 

 Analyze EHS data, identify trends, and help define key focus areas for continuous improvement. 

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Safety, Industrial Hygiene, and Environmental Engineering. 

 
 
 
 Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications 
 You must possess a third level qualification (NFQ level 8) in Environmental Science/Environmental Engineering or a NFQ level 8 in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry. 

 8+ years relevant work experience

 Ideally semiconductor experience. 

 Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage stakeholders on environmental topics. 

 Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to clearly and effectively communicate information. 

 Detailed knowledge and understanding of environmental legislation and practice - experience dealing with the EPA. Wastewater management experience advantageous. 

 Proficiency in data management/Excel. 

 Ability to present and explain environmental data to both technical and non-technical forums. 

 Ability to work effectively within a team environment with minimal supervision. 

 Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong sense of initiative. 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

 Practical experience with EHS management systems.

title: Asset Management - Airfield Operative
description:
Airfield Operatives work in the Airside Management Department. The role reports directly to the Airfield Facilities Manager is a shift role with a requirement to work, Days/Nights/Weekdays/Weekends (12hr shift patterns).

 Airfield Operatives carry out both planned and reactive maintenance on a diverse range of airfield & landside infrastructural assets including; runways, taxiways, aprons pavement, airfield paint markings, footpaths, roads, grasslands, drainage infrastructure, security fence, boundary gates at Ireland’s busiest airport to ensure safe and efficient operations at all times.

 In addition to the above, the Airfield Operative Team provides support during the winter season and is an integral part of the Dublin Airport Winter Operations team responsible for ensuring the safe and timely clearance of contamination to pavements during winter operations.

 The team is also the Dublin Airport aircraft recovery response team and has aided in the recovery of a number of disabled aircraft at Dublin Airport over the last 10 year as well as at both Cork and Shannon Airports.

 All operatives are FAS safe pass workers and have significantly high level of accredited training in many areas such as Airfield driving (including airfield escorting), ATC Telephony, Manual handling, Operating of Snow and Ice Machinery, Operating Heavy Goods Vehicles, Operating Grass cutting equipment, Use of abrasive wheels, Use of power tools, Traffic Management Training, Airfield pavement maintenance rig training, Hot works training, Chemical handling, Underground service detection, Telescopic driving and more.

 This role is a physical role requiring persons to be fit to carry out physical work activities in a highly regulated and safety critical environment.

Job Description:
Role Purpose
The purpose of this role is to analyze attack patterns, develop incident response plans, ensure audit readiness, and implement disaster recovery measures, to ensure adherence to cyber security regulatory frameworks.
Areas of responsibility
Monitoring and Incident Detection-Analyse attack trends and correlate logs across systems to identify advance threats. Enhance monitoring processes and implement improvements for faster detection, to ensure compliance with security frameworks and regulatory standards.
Incident Handling and Analysis-Perform root cause analysis, create incident response plans and implement disaster recovery measures to minimize business disruption
Threat Assessment and Analytics-Undertake forensic analysis using advanced analytics tools and implement mitigation measures to align with compliance requirements.
Stakeholder Coordination and Audit Assistance-"Liaise with cross functional teams, external vendors and auditors to ensure compliance with security frameworks.

Training and Awareness-Assist in creating and delivering cybersecurity awareness sessions, including guidance on phishing and malicious emails.

Assess and improve the security posture of data platforms, including cloud-based analytics, data warehouses, and business intelligence solutions.
Identify, prioritise, and remediate security risks, vulnerabilities, excessive permissions, and configuration weaknesses.
Configure security policies, monitoring, alerting, and compliance controls within the SSPM platform.
Integrate SSPM capabilities with existing security tooling, including SIEM, IAM, ITSM, and incident management platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Architecture, and Security Operations teams to implement security best practices.
Perform security reviews and risk assessments of SaaS applications and data services.
Develop security standards, operating procedures, and governance frameworks for SaaS and data platform security.
Monitor compliance with regulatory and internal security requirements.
Produce dashboards, metrics, and reports for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
Support security investigations and incident response activities involving data platforms and SaaS environments.
Drive continuous improvement in data security posture and operational processes.
Key Deliverables:
Successful deployment and adoption of the SSPM platform.
Enhanced visibility across SaaS and data platform security risks.
Improved identity governance and access management controls.
Reduction in security misconfigurations and critical exposure risks.
Automated monitoring and reporting capabilities.
Alignment with security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Established governance processes for ongoing SaaS and data platform security management.

Location:
Dublin, IE
Company:
Canada Life Group Services
Description:
Full Time  Permanent position
Hybrid role based in our City Centre offices
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here  Benefits (life-careers.com)
Role Overview
As a Security Orchestration, Automation and Response Engineer at Central Technology Services within Canada Life Group, you will be responsible for create, configure, run and maintain automation playbooks, review alerts coming from cloud security tooling, perform enrichment and escalate suspicious or complex cases to senior analysts.
This role involves utilizing various technologies and tools, as well as engaging with stakeholders to secure and monitor the cloud and on prem infrastructure. This role will also be optimising and customising cloud security technologies.
This role requires a strong foundation in cloud computing technologies, automation, and a passion for optimizing and scaling on prem and cloud platforms. This role requires a blend of technical expertise and a strong ability to deliver through automation.
The role often involves working closely with SOC analysts, incident responders, cloud engineers and assisting platform and development team members of the different business for monitoring and implementing automated responses.
It also requires communication and feedback to line management, change and service management and project management on progress. It is a busy role and requires excellent time management and prioritisation skills.
What you will help us to achieve
•    Support the deployment, configuration and day to day operation of the CNAPP (Cloud Native Application Protection Platform), helping to identify and track cloud security risks across IaaS, PaaS and container workloads.
•    Monitor CNAPP dashboards and alerts for misconfigurations, vulnerabilities and compliance issues.
•    Perform initial triage and enrichment of findings and escalate to senior team members where required.
•    Help reduce noise by tuning out false positives and aligning policies with agreed standards
•    Implement security best practices and compliance controls to protect cloud-based platforms from cyber threats and vulnerabilities.
•    Develop and maintain SOAR workflows to perform automated security tasks. Manage all elements of the SOAR platform including troubleshooting, maintenance and upgrades.
•    Help maintain integrations/connectors between SOAR and other tools
•    Create and execute automation playbooks
•    Keep documentation for integrations and workflows up to date
•    Collaborate with IT teams, system administrators, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and operation of security controls.
•    Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including business units, to monitor resolution of findings.
•    Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize cloud security controls and automation workflows.
•    Proactively engage with stakeholders to identify opportunities for cloud security optimization and improvement to meet business needs.
•    Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Share knowledge and best practices with team members through training sessions and workshops.
•    Develop and maintain PowerBI reports using Azure Data Factory.
More specific responsibilities will include
A typical day would include:
•    Automation Rules: Defining "if-this-then-that" logic to trigger actions based on query results (e.g., "If a critical vulnerability is found on an internet-facing host, automatically open a P1 ticket and notify the #security-ops Teams channel").
•    Monitor and operate security vulnerabilities and findings discover in the cloud, code and ensuring timely resolution of identified issues
•    Report on deliverable status timeline, technical issues and system operations
•    Collaborate with different teams to remediate misconfigurations and vulnerabilities
•    Support update of metrics to measure the monitoring program and related process.
•    Participate in meetings with stakeholders to discuss security aspects of cloud and automation project activities, requirements, and progress updates.
What you will need to be successful in the role
•    Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or related field, or equivalent work experience.
•    At least 3 years of progressive and relevant experience in hands-on cloud computing.
•    At least 1 year of experience in Azure cloud platforms, tools and technologies.

title: Specialist, Implementation
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Specialist, Implementation 
Customer Implementation Services (CIS) Europe is responsible for enabling Mastercard customers to successfully adopt and implement Mastercard products, services, and initiatives. We partner closely with customers, product teams, account management, technology, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver high-quality implementations that drive customer value and business growth.
As a Specialist, Implementation, you will play a critical role in leading and supporting complex customer implementations across Europe. You will serve as a trusted advisor to both customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, risks are proactively managed, and customer objectives are achieved.
This role requires strong project management capabilities, payments industry knowledge, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to navigate complex cross-functional environments. The successful candidate will contribute to implementation excellence, support process improvements, and help drive consistency and quality across CIS Europe.
________________________________________
Role & Responsibilities
Customer Implementation & Delivery
• Manage and support the implementation of Mastercard products, services, and strategic initiatives for customers across Europe.
• Lead customer onboarding and implementation activities from initiation through successful production readiness and launch.
• Develop and maintain project plans, implementation timelines, and governance structures to ensure successful delivery.
• Identify, manage, and mitigate implementation risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations throughout the project lifecycle.
• Ensure project milestones, customer commitments, and Mastercard delivery standards are met.
Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and key internal stakeholders, including Product, Technology, Customer Delivery, Operations, Account Management, and regional CIS teams.
• Act as a primary point of contact for implementation-related activities and customer engagements.
• Facilitate discussions across multiple teams to drive alignment, resolve challenges, and ensure timely decision-making.
• Communicate project status, risks, and outcomes effectively to both business and technical audiences.
Product & Implementation Expertise
• Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Mastercard products, services, implementation processes, and operational requirements.
• Provide implementation guidance and subject matter expertise to customers and internal teams.
• Support pilots, product launches, and strategic initiatives by helping define implementation approaches and customer onboarding requirements.
• Assess customer impacts resulting from product, platform, or operational changes and support implementation planning accordingly.
Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
• Contribute to the continuous enhancement of implementation methodologies, tools, processes, and best practices.
• Drive standardization and consistency across implementation activities within CIS Europe.
• Capture lessons learned and implementation insights to improve future delivery effectiveness.
• Support the development of operational readiness, implementation documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Knowledge Sharing & Team Development
• Support onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge transfer activities within CIS.
• Deliver implementation-related training and guidance to internal teams and customers as required.
• Promote a collaborative, customer-focused, and continuous improvement culture within the organization.
________________________________________
Qualifications & Experience
Required Experience
• Experience in project management, customer implementation, consulting, client delivery, payments, or related financial services environments.
• Experience managing customer-facing projects involving multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
• Understanding of payment processing, electronic payments, card industry operations, or financial technology solutions.
• Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously within a fast-paced environment.
• Experience working in cross-functional and matrix organizations.
Preferred Experience
• Knowledge of Mastercard products, services, and processing environments.
• Experience supporting large-scale implementations, strategic initiatives, or new product rollouts.
• Familiarity with digital payments, mobile payments, tokenization, real-time payments, or related emerging payment technologies.
• Experience working in regional or global organizations with geographically distributed teams.
________________________________________
Skills & Competencies
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence without direct authority across matrix organizations.
• Strong customer-focus with a consultative and solution-oriented mindset.
• Excellent negotiation, facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Communication
• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
• Strong presentation and executive communication capabilities.
Delivery & Problem Solving
• Strong project management, organizational, and planning skills.
• Ability to manage ambiguity and navigate complex business environments.
• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
• Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
Personal Attributes
• Self-motivated and proactive.
• Adaptable and resilient in changing environments.
• Collaborative team player with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Continuous learner with a passion for payments innovation and customer success. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 For our business, for clients, and for you

 Job Description: 
 About Innovative Medicine 
 Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
 Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
 
 Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Mercer is one of the fastest growing investment solutions entities globally, and our client base has grown substantially over recent years and we have an ambitious trajectory for future growth.

 Experience supporting strategic initiatives, transformation programs, or PMO delivery in a complex organization.
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to project coordination and reporting.
 Demonstrated ability to build trust and maintain effective stakeholder relationships.
 A proactive mindset with a drive to learn, improve processes, and contribute to meaningful change.

 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Acting as a trusted point of contact, you will coordinate onboarding activities, ensure data and system requirements are completed accurately and on time, and support clients through every stage of the process. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and detail-oriented professional who enjoys problem-solving, building strong relationships, and working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where they can make a direct impact on both client experience and business growth.

 Identify and directly resolve issues during onboarding, escalating where necessary.

 Work closely with internal teams (e.g. Product, Technology, Operations) to ensure successful implementation.

 Maintain and continuously improve onboarding documentation, processes, and checklists.

 Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout onboarding and subsequent launches.

 Guide clients through onboarding requirements and ensure timely provision of required data and documentation.

 Maintain ongoing relationships with clients to support additional fund launches and related projects over time.

 
 Experience & skills required: 
 Bachelors or Masters in commerce, MBA Finance, CA/CMA/CFA or similar.

 Relevant experience of Investment Operations / Risk Management.

 Good understanding of Fund Compliance, Regulatory Reporting or Investment Risk.

 Basic understanding of various asset classes – F&O, Fwds, OTCs, Swaps, Structured products.

 Desirable experience with Bloomberg and/or other market data platforms.

 Desirable previous exposure to Client Service roles.

 Strong Written and verbal communication skills.

 Dedication to work as team and deliver timely results.

 Candidates should be flexible to work in shifts if required.

 A positive and responsible work ethic.

 Fluent in English and any other additional languages is a plus.

 
 What you will get in return: 
 Hybrid working model.

 Opportunities for professional development.

 Opportunity to work with a diverse, agile and global team.

 Exposure to all aspects of the business and cross-jurisdiction.

 A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business + more.

 We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. title: Sr. Specialist, Product Experience Design, Crypto
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Sr. Specialist, Product Experience Design, Crypto 
Overview
The Crypto Solutions team within Mastercard's Financial Crimes organization is driving the next generation of risk, compliance, and security solutions that enable financial institutions to safely participate in the rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem. As traditional financial infrastructure converges with blockchain-based payment networks, the need for trusted, scalable, and intelligent risk management capabilities has never been greater.
We are seeking a Senior Specialist, Product Experience Design to help shape the future of Mastercard's Crypto Solutions portfolio. This role will be responsible for designing intuitive, customer-centric experiences that simplify complex risk, compliance, and security signals into actionable insights.
You will empathize with our customers to understand their needs and motivations, define user problems, design end-to-end journeys and experiment with these ideas to bring new designs – consistent with Mastercard's design standards – from concept through to development, working closely with Product, PMTs, and Engineers on a regular basis.

Role
• Design end-to-end user experiences for Crypto Solutions products, including onboarding, researching, monitoring, and reporting journeys.
• Apply best-practice UX methods to identify solutions to customer problems, experiment to validate them, and create final deliverables for Engineering partners.
• Work closely and regularly with Product Managers, PMTs, and Engineers to translate product strategy and customer needs into intuitive digital experiences.
• Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, and validate them through user research and usability testing.
• Design communications and decks to pitch new product ideas and concepts to stakeholders.
• Support hands-on product-feature design within initiatives, contributing to timely, quality deliverables that meet stated goals.
• Work as part of a functional team, partnering with senior-level peers to gain experience and grow design skillset over time.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should:
• Have hands-on experience in a user experience function, including a tactical skillset in designing and validating solutions that solve user problems.
• Have enterprise software, fintech, payments, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, or comparable industry experience; digital asset or blockchain exposure is a plus.
• Demonstrate the ability to execute tactical design outputs, with support from senior-level peers as needed.
• Develop new designs leveraging Copilot, Figma Make & other generative AI tools.
• Familiarity with design thinking principles
• A passion to be the empathetic advocate for the customer by turning complexity into simple solutions.
• Have proficiency in Figma for UX prototyping and design systems.
• Experience leveraging design systems
• Be proficient in PowerPoint for communicating design concepts and product ideas.
• Be comfortable collaborating across Product, PMT, Engineering, and Data Science in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to tailor your style depending on the audience
Self‑motivated, enthusiastic, and proactive, with a positive and energetic approach

You do not need to have your entire career mapped out to start making progress. Exploring careers is about learning more about yourself, researching opportunities, and building an understanding of what might suit you.
Whether you have a clear direction in mind or are still weighing up your options, taking time to explore different careers can help you make informed decisions about jobs, internships, further study and future career paths.
Start by considering:
What interests and motivates you?
What skills and strengths do you enjoy using?
What type of work environment would suit you?
What careers are linked to your course and qualifications?
What opportunities are growing in areas that interest you?
Career exploration is not just about researching jobs online. It can involve talking to professionals, attending employer events, gaining work experience, networking with graduates, and reflecting on what you want from your future career.
Career Exploration Resources
The following resources can help you research careers, industries, graduate opportunities and labour market trends:
Explore graduate careers, employer profiles, sector guides, internships and graduate opportunities on Gradireland.
Research career paths, job sectors and job profiles on Prospects.ac.uk/ .
Research organisations, follow employers and explore areas that interest you on Linkedin.
Use our free Profiling for Success tools to dicover your strenghts and develop your self awareness.
Take Your Research Further
As you explore career options, try to:
Read job descriptions and identify common skills, qualifications and requirements.
Talk to graduates and professionals working in areas that interest you.
Attend jobs and careers fairs, employer events and networking opportunities.
Gain experience through internships, placements, volunteering or part-time work.
Arrange informational interviews to learn more about specific roles and organisations.
Meet with a Career Coach to discuss your ideas and next steps.
Remember, few people find the perfect career path immediately. Career planning is an ongoing process of exploration, reflection and action. The more you explore, the more confident and informed your decisions will become.

title: Supply Chain Co-Op Placement 2027 - Cork
description:
Work Flexibility: Onsite 
 
 This role will be based in one of our Cork sites.
 
 Throughout the placement, you will be an integral part of Stryker’s 2027 Cooperative cohort.
 
 Tasks and responsibilities may include: 
 Together, with your Stryker team leader and college supervisor, identify a Supply Planning project along with project objectives, scope, success factors, milestones and evaluation.

 Supporting cross functional teams to develop best in class sourcing strategies for assigned suppliers and/or commodities in support of business objectives.

 Supporting the implementation of supplier and/or commodity strategy which will include spend/supply assessments, consolidation strategy, sourcing selection, financial and make v’s buy analyses.

 Represent the ‘voice of the supplier’ in the organization.                              

 Collaborate with key stakeholders on contract strategy for suppliers and create, negotiate, monitor and enforce when applicable.

 Develop strong relationships with key suppliers as well as other disciplines within the businesses.

 Participate in new product launches; lead supplier selection, requests for quotes and insurance that suppliers are clear on product launch deliverables; collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful launch.                                                

 Responsible for assuring cost standards are established for annual operating budgets.

 Ensures compliance with the Quality, Safety and 5S Systems. 

 
 What you will need: 
 Enrolled in an Irish or Northern Irish university course in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, BIS or other related courses for the duration of the placement.

 Honesty and integrity; must comply with the quality system, regulations, and company policies.

 Self-motivated, flexible, and hardworking - enjoys working in a dynamic, fast and results orientated environment.

 Reliable, dependable, and punctual. 

 Organised, focused, and capable of multi-tasking. 

 Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

 Good verbal and written communication skills with basic level of PC skills.

 Is a team player and capable of working as part of a multi-disciplined team. 

 Available for either 6, 9 or 12 months – exact duration and start date to be discussed with your Talent Acquisition Business Partner at Stryker.

 
 What we can offer: 
 Attractive salary & vacation entitlement. 

 Experience our inclusive, people-first culture . You will be paired with mentors and have access to leaders who support your growth, give constructive feedback, and help build confidence. 

 Flexible working hours.

 Sports & Social   clubs and DE&I   Employee Resource Groups   and the opportunity to   connect with other co-ops .

 The opportunity to contribute to real-world projects that make a difference in improving healthcare and patients’ lives . In Stryker, you will be given responsibilities that truly matter.

 
 Next steps:

 Should all requirements be met, and you are happy to proceed, in September, successful candidates will be invited to a final round business interview with the hiring team.

 Please note, individual recruitment timelines may vary – please keep in contact with your University Recruiting Business Partner and your university placement coordinator for specific timelines and updates.

 If you’d like to learn more about the compensation associated with this opportunity, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
  
   
Travel Percentage: 0%
