title: Environmental Health and Safety Officer
description:
Kepak is a leading food company with 14 manufacturing sites and over 4,500 employees across Ireland and the UK, with a turnover of €1.75 billion. 
 The Group operates across three divisions: Meat Division Ireland, Foods Division and Meat Division UK. Guided by our values - Responsibility, Ambition, Passion for Food, and Teamwork. We are committed to operating as a successful, sustainable, future-ready business that is a great place to work. We supply fresh and value-added meat based products to retail and foodservice through private label and our own brands, including Rustlers, Big Al's and John Stone. 
 
 
 We are looking for a proactive, driven, and passionate Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Officer to champion and strengthen our safety culture at our site in Clonee, Co. Meath
 
 In this key role, you will help shape a safe, healthy, and sustainable working environment by ensuring compliance with environmental, health and safety legislation, company policies, and industry best practices. Working closely with managers and employees across the business, you will play a vital role in driving continuous improvement initiatives, promoting employee wellbeing, and embedding a culture where safety is everyone's responsibility.
 This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious EHS professional who is eager to make a real impact, influence positive change, and contribute to the ongoing success and sustainability of our operations.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Health & Safety 
 Support the implementation and maintenance of the company's Health & Safety Management System.
 Conduct regular workplace inspections, audits, and risk assessments.
 Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, identifying root causes and corrective actions.
 Monitor compliance with health and safety legislation and company procedures.
 Assist in developing safe systems of work, policies, and procedures.
 Deliver safety inductions, toolbox talks, and employee training programmes.
 
 
 Environmental 
 Support compliance with environmental legislation, permits, and company standards.
 Monitor waste management, recycling programmes, and environmental controls.
 Assist in implementing environmental improvement initiatives and sustainability projects.
 Conduct environmental inspections and audits.
 Compliance & Continuous Improvement 
 Assist with internal and external audits.
 Track corrective and preventative actions to completion.
 Support emergency preparedness and response planning.
 Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in EHS performance.
 Prepare monthly EHS reports and KPI dashboards for management.
 Requirements 
 Essential 
 Qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Management, or a related discipline.
 Minimum 1 year experience in an EHS role within manufacturing, construction, engineering, logistics, or a similar environment.
 Strong knowledge of health, safety, and environmental legislation.
 Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
 Full driving licence.
 
 Desirable 
 NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent.
 IOSH Membership.
 Internal Auditor qualification.
 Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
 Knowledge of sustainability and environmental improvement programmes.
 Benefits 
 What can we offer you? 
 Company Pension 
 Paid Maternity Leave 
 Subsidized canteen. 
 Further Education support - You’ll have clear pathways for advancement, supported by continuous professional development and a range of learning opportunities
 Subsidized Canteen 
 Refer a Friend Scheme - Earn up to Get up to €500 for successfully referring a friend or family member to Kepak Group.
 Bike to Work Scheme - Purchase a bike and safety equipment through a salary sacrifice scheme which reduces your taxable income – meaning you pay less tax!
 Long Service Awards - We recognise, acknowledge and award the dedication and valuable contribution of long serving employees

title: Curricular internship - White Collar Crime / Compliance (Litigation Department)
description:
Are you ready to grow with the world’s largest law firm? Join Dentons Italy Team today.
 
For our White Collar Crime / Compliance Team (Litigation & Dispute Resolution Department) based in Milan, we are searching for a talented and highly motivated Law student for a 6-month curricular internship, starting from October 2026.
 The aim of the internship is to allow the student to understand the functioning and management of a law firm, and specifically of the Team that deals with criminal law, compliance and business & human rights.
  The student will have the opportunity to participate in working groups, supporting the Team in regulatory and jurisprudential research relevant to the practice, in drafting opinions and contributing to the carrying out of internal investigations.
  
 Internship duration:  6 months, starting from October 2026
 Requirements 
 The internship is aimed at 4th and 5th year students of the Faculty of Law, and a good knowledge of the English language is required (level B2-C1). Knowledge of the French language is also highly appreciated.
 
 About us 
Across over 80 countries, Dentons is a global law firm that helps clients grow, protect, operate and finance their business by providing uniquely global and deeply local legal solutions. Polycentric, purpose-driven and committed to inclusion, diversity, equity and sustainability, Dentons focuses on what matters most to its clients.  www.dentons.com 

 Diversity & Inclusion 
Essential to our success as a global law firm is our ability to attract and retain the best talent from a diverse range of backgrounds. We want a work environment where everyone can reach their potential and we have an inclusive culture, which respects individual differences.
We undertake and support a number of internal and external initiatives aimed at increasing diversity within the profession and we encourage all our partners and staff to get involved. We welcome you to learn more about diversity and inclusion at Dentons.

title: GNI146

Skip to main content
GNI146 - Construction Engineer - Leinster
Gas Networks Ireland operates and maintains Ireland’s €3 billion, 14,758km national gas network, supplying reliable energy to more than 720,000 homes and businesses. The network delivers more than 30% of the country’s total energy and 40% of its electricity generation.
We are dedicated to achieving net zero and advancing the energy transition through integrated planning and collaboration with the energy industry. To realise our vision and to be at the heart of Ireland’s energy future, we are committed to transforming our network to achieve net zero carbon emissions onboarding biomethane and green hydrogen.
We have a proud legacy, and our values guide how we work every day - drawing on our experience, doing what’s right for each other and our communities, and staying energised for the change ahead.
When you join Gas Networks Ireland, you become part of an organisation that invests in its people. We are committed to supporting your growth and wellbeing in a workplace where everyone can contribute and thrive.
If your application is successful, your starting salary will be determined within the pay range based on your skills and experience. The market reference point (midpoint) of the range typically represents the higher end of the initial offer and reflects a level at which an individual is considered fully proficient in the role. This structure also allows scope for ongoing salary progression as the employee continues to gain experience and develop in the position.
To apply, email your application, including your CV, to  recruit@gasnetworks.ie , quoting the job title and reference number in the subject line.
The Role
The Asset Delivery function within Gas Networks Ireland is responsible for the end to end planning, designing and delivery of GNI’s portfolio of asset development programmes. The Asset Delivery function brings together all the technical and project support capabilities needed to take high-level projects and programmes from the Portfolio Office and translate these through from detailed design and project planning, to construction delivery and handover to Asset Operations.
Reporting to the Senior Project Delivery Engineer (NSWC / DX Pipelines), the Construction Engineer (NSWC / DX Pipelines) will be responsible for overseeing the construction delivery elements of specific NSWC and DX pipeline projects issued to Asset Delivery by the Portfolio Office. Acting as the primary point of contact for escalations at Gate 3 relating to such work within his/her region.
The Construction Engineer will act as a point of consultation for internal stakeholders across the Connections Coordination, Design Delivery and Project Services teams; to assist with the successful development and delivery of projects.
The Construction Engineer within Asset Delivery is responsible for overseeing the onsite execution of works.
Duties and Responsibilities
Planning and overseeing distribution project work conducted on site as required.
Supervision of works on site and completion of site inspections sheets and audits as required to Distribution OPM.
Out of hours supervision on site on Construction On-Call rota of 1 in 6 weeks approximately, with time in lieu granted for out of hours worked.
Managing project and construction activities to ensure delivery on time, within scope and budget.
Taking accountability for project activities to ensure completion in line with GNI Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental requirements.
Ensure contractors comply with their requirements as PSCS requesting improvement, documenting, and escalating to Senior Engineer where required.
Promoting an improved HSQE culture within the team and with our business partners.
Perform role as site supervisor and/or originator for NRO activities where required.
Review project related contractor documentation as required to ensure compliance with legislation, standards, and specifications.
Liaise with design around construction issues as required, across the full life cycle of the project.
Liaison with the contractor to ensure that the Design Deviation Process is followed, and where a deviation is required ensuring works are not allowed proceed until the deviation is submitted and approved.
Examining the feasibility of projects in conjunction with the design department, as part of the EAC Guidelines.
Undertaking construction approval reviews at Gate 2 as required.
Address issues raised to deliver improvements in Contractor KPI’s.
Liaising with Local Authority representatives and other local utility personnel.
Acting as escalation point for the contractor, resolving any issues as they arise.
Liaising with internal departments including connections coordination team and external stakeholders to progress projects from conception to completion as required, in relation to construction related issues.
Escalating any reoccurring issues, risks or issues that cannot be resolved to the Senior Project Delivery Engineer.
Managing relationships with contractors at the project level, on a day-to-day basis and associated cost controls.
Approving contractor payments in compliance with EAC guidelines and contract documentation.
Ensuring that all relevant Asset Data documentation is returned to GNI prior to payment, E.g., as-laids, test certs etc.
Producing monthly reports on progress of construction projects with strong focus on costs.
Attending meetings to report on projects as required.
Ensuring NSWC contract is carried out in accordance with the rates and specifications.
Ensuring continuous improvement in all areas of project and construction management.
Audit works to ensure cross functional requirements are delivered with key focus on safety and quality.
Performing other duties as assigned from time to time.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
Relevant third level 8 degree in Engineering or equivalent.
Minimum 5 years work experience in the natural gas or similar industry.

title: A move to Azets adds up
description:
Skip to main content A move to Azets adds up
Join our diverse and talented global community – early careers or experienced professionals, our doors are open to you all. Search for current opportunities or reach out to find out more.
Browse opportunities
Welcome to Azets, the home of forward-thinking professionals who are driving change in the world of accountancy , business advisory and outsourcing services. Our purpose is our driving force – to improve the lives of our colleagues, our clients and our communities in a sustainable way.
At the heart of this is our belief in Talented Smart People – individuals who bring expertise, curiosity and collaborate on everything they do.
As an international business with a local feel, our people and values sit at the heart of every decision we take. We strive to create an environment where people are encouraged to be themselves. Working towards a common purpose and supporting each other, our aim is deliver a level of service built on achieving together.
With over 9000 experts across our global network, we are a people-powered business that thrives on collaboration, authenticity, and dynamic solutions. And we’re always looking out for individuals that can contribute to our modern, vibrant and successful culture.
What does a career at Azets look like?
We are more than just numbers. As a people-first business, our priority is making sure you feel supported. We value freedom and impact, work-life harmony, inclusive collaboration, and continuous development. Here are some reasons our colleagues value being part of the Azets community.
Career Development
You’ll appreciate the opportunities for training and development, and the chance to work on a variety of projects. We will offer you clear career progression with clear steps and expectations for each role.
Work-life Harmony
At Azets, we believe in work-life harmony, not just balance. With flexible working options and policies designed to prioritize your personal and family needs, we make sure you can thrive both professionally and personally. Whether it’s working from home or adjusting hours to fit your lifestyle, we’ve got you covered. Want to know more about how we support our people? Check out our latest ESG Impact Report to see the difference we’re making!
Variety of Work
Our wide range of services lets you explore different areas, learning new skills along the way. Some colleagues even move across different functions, opening exciting new career paths and expanding their expertise. Plus, our diverse team brings a mix of talents, perspectives, and ideas, so you’re always learning from others and growing both professionally and personally.
Inclusive & Supportive Culture
We are friendly and welcoming from the start, with both junior and senior employees supporting you throughout your journey at Azets. We foster a culture where everyone belongs, with a strong focus on the Hear&Act principle: listen first. By staying true to our values, we ensure your experience at Azets is positive, rewarding, and supportive at every stage of your career.
Personal Growth
We support each other in building new skills, expanding knowledge, and gaining valuable experience.
Organisational Growth
By developing our talent, we ensure the success of our business and create future opportunities.
Engagement & Retention
We invest in clear career progression and development opportunities, making Azets a great place to build a long-term career.
Strive and thrive in a diverse and talented community

title: Sales Development Coordinator (6-Month FTC)
description:
Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.

Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity? 

Our Sales Development organization is a key driver of Fin’s growth, acting as both a talent pipeline and a revenue engine. We identify and engage prospects globally, guiding them through the early stages of the sales process - and laying the foundation for future careers across our Go-to-Market teams.

At Fin, we’re customer-obsessed and driven to transform online customer service through a human + AI approach. We believe in balancing working hard with working smart - using data, strategy, and creativity to drive results and continuously improve.

We’re looking for a Sales Development Coordinator to join our Enterprise Sales team. This is a hands-on, learning-focused role designed for someone looking to build strong foundations in sales development, customer engagement, and account research.

You’ll play a key role in nurturing low-intent prospects, improving the quality of our account and contact data, and enabling Account Executives and Business Development Representatives to engage more effectively with high-potential prospects.

This role is intended as a stepping stone into Sales. Successful candidates may progress into a full-time Sales Development Representative role based on performance, readiness, and business needs. You will receive coaching and enablement to prepare for progression into an SDR position.

What will I be doing? 

As a Sales Development Coordinator, you’ll work closely with the Enterprise Sales teams across several core areas:

  • Follow up on inbound leads and engage with early-stage prospects, helping qualify interest and route opportunities appropriately
  • Conduct account and prospect research to support outbound efforts
  • Build organisation maps for key personas, including roles across Customer Support, Product, AI, and Digital Transformation
  • Prepare call briefs and account summaries to help AEs and BDRs engage effectively ahead of meetings

What skills do I need? 

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Technology, or a related field or early in your career with less than 2 years of professional experience
  • Comfortable engaging with prospects via email and phone
  • Fluency in English, with French or German preferred (Dublin only)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable using tools such as LinkedIn and Google Workspace
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to manage tasks independently with light guidance
  • Curious about technology, AI, sales, and customer experience
  • High attention to detail and strong follow-through
  • Motivated to build a long-term career in sales

Prior sales experience is not required, this role is designed for someone early in their career or transitioning into sales.

At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements.

Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers.

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

title: Catering Assistant
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Catering Assistant 
 
 Job Location: Dublin
 Job Type: Fixed term contract, Part-Time (20 hours per week)
 Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications 
 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Catering Assistant / Kitchen Porter in Dublin. 
 We’re looking for a reliable, hands‑on Catering Assistant who will also cover Kitchen Porter duties to help our staff canteen run smoothly, safely and to a high standard. You’ll support food preparation and service, maintain excellent hygiene, and keep the back‑of‑house clean, organised, and compliant with Irish/EU food safety law.
 
 What you'll be doing: Food preparation & service support:  Assist with basic food preparation (e.g., washing, peeling, chopping), serving, replenishing counters, and safe hot/cold holding during service.

 Dishwashing/pot washing:  Collect, wash, sanitise and store crockery, cutlery, utensils, pots and pans. Ensure constant availability during service.

 Cleaning & hygiene:  Sweep/mop floors; clean/sanitise prep areas, sinks, equipment, fridges/freezers; complete daily/weekly deep cleans to schedule.

 Deliveries & storage:  Receive, check, date‑label and store deliveries; maintain first-in-first out (FIFO) stock rotation and correct temperature controls.

 Allergen controls:  Follow the canteen’s allergen procedures and ensure accurate written allergen information is available at point of presentation/sale for all non‑prepacked items.

 Waste & recycling:  Segregate, remove, and store waste safely; maintain clean bin yards and back‑of‑house areas.

 Records & checks:  Complete HACCP-related checks and logs (temps, cleaning, deliveries, corrective actions) as directed.

 Teamwork & safety:  Use chemicals safely as trained; escalate maintenance issues; support broader catering tasks as needed.

 
 The essential skills you will have when you apply: 
 HACCP / Food Safety Training:   Minimum: FSAI-aligned Food Safety training appropriate to duties (e.g., Level 1 within the first month; Level 2 if preparing/handling high‑risk foods).

 Practical kitchen experience  in a canteen, café, hospitality, healthcare or similar back‑of‑house environment.

 Allergen awareness  and ability to follow written allergen procedures for non‑prepacked food.

 Strong hygiene standards , attention to detail, and ability to work safely to SOPs/HACCP checks.

 Physical capability  to stand for shifts, lift/move items, and handle a fast-paced service.

 Desirable:  Manual Handling certificate; Basic First Aid; experience with temperature monitoring systems.   

 
 We operate a documented Food Safety Management System based on HACCP and maintain written allergen information for all non‑prepacked foods served. Successful candidates must complete induction training and participate in routine HACCP checks/records.
 
 What we'll give you for this role: 
 Development Training & refreshers: Ongoing FSAI-aligned food safety/HACCP refreshers (and allergen updates)
 Progression: Opportunities to develop into catering/chef roles.
 
 Remuneration & More Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications.
 Pension Scheme.
 Holiday allowance.
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme.
 Opportunities for training and development.
 Ongoing HACCP, food safety and allergen awareness refreshers.
 
 Health & Support Employee Assistance Programme.
 Life Cover.
 Permanent Health Insurance (PHI).
 Bike to Work Scheme.
 
 Other Benefits Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4).
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4).
 Professional and personal development opportunities.
 Support for professional memberships and examinations where applicable.
 
 
 This isn't just a position; it's an opportunity to be part of a team that keeps our colleagues supported every day.

title: NAV Analyst
description:
NAV Analyst  
 Location : Dublin, Ireland
 Schedule : 37.5 hours per week (permanent)
 Work Arrangement : Hybrid (3 days on-site in Dublin)
 Salary range : The salary range for this specific role will be €40,000 – €50,000 gross per year. (The final salary will be determined based on relevant skills, experience, and role scope, in line with our objective and gender-neutral compensation framework.)
   
 JOB SUMMARY 

CSC provides regulatory-compliant solutions to EU and non-EU investment managers as an authorised Alternative Investment Fund Manager (AIFM) regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). As a NAV Analyst in our Dublin-based Capital and Financial Management team, you’ll support valuation oversight, NAV governance, and financial management across Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs). You will work closely with internal stakeholders, fund administrators, and third parties to help ensure accurate reporting, robust controls, and compliance with AIFMD and related requirements. This role is well-suited to someone who enjoys detail, ownership, and learning across valuation, financial oversight, and operational processes.

 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 Support the Designated Person (DP) for Capital & Financial Management with oversight activities and governance deliverables
 Review and oversee NAV reporting received from the Fund Administrator, escalating exceptions and tracking resolution
 Perform portfolio and NAV variance analysis, including reasonableness checks and monitoring of AIF performance and exposures
 Assist with financial forecasting, budgeting inputs, and management reporting for the AIFM and relevant committees
 Assist with the AIFM invoicing process, including accuracy checks and timely issuance to clients
 Support the design, implementation, and periodic review of valuation policies and procedures for each AIF
 Prepare materials and reporting for key committees (Capital & Finance, Valuation) and the AIFM Board
 Support onboarding of new funds.
 Monitor regulatory capital metrics and support internal reporting in line with CBI expectations and applicable regulations
 Support year-end processes, including review of AIF financial statements and audit coordination with internal and external parties
 Ad-hoc projects within the AIFM team

 

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 3-5 years of experience within a Fund Management Company, AIFM, Fund Administrator, or similar financial services environment
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience)
 Working knowledge of NAV processes, valuation concepts, and fund financial reporting fundamentals including journal entries
 Strong Excel skills and comfort working with financial data, reconciliations, and variance analysis
 High attention to detail with the ability to manage deadlines and maintain accurate records
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working across internal teams and external providers

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 
 Familiarity with AIFMD and AIFM operating models (experience supporting a DP function is an advantage)
 Exposure to alternative investments and common fund structures (e.g., private equity, private credit, real assets)
 Experience reviewing fund financial statements and supporting audit processes
 Experience conducting oversight/due diligence of third-party valuation agents or service providers
 Knowledge of regulatory capital concepts and/or reporting frameworks relevant to an Irish regulated entity

 We are seeking a talented individual to join our Ireland Consulting Team at Mercer. This role will be based in Lisbon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
 
 As a consulting analyst, you will work as part of a team supporting consultants in all aspects of pensions consulting and governance work on both corporate and trustee clients.
 You will work directly with Ireland-based consultants and manage the delivery of services to our clients.
 
 
 We will count on you to: 
 Support your client team on project management, day-to-day client contact, problem resolution, and supervision of analysts’ work
 Undertake actuarial modelling, spreadsheet modelling and calculations, including valuations, individual calculations, regular updates, actuarial factors and accounting work.
 Supporting in the preparation of Trustee meetings packs;
 Draft and update all the relevant governance documents required under IORP II;
 Collect information to provide to Key Function holders (Internal Audit and/or Risk Manager);
 Prepare and link with the different stakeholders to prepare the governance compliance checklist;
 Liaise with other Mercer business areas to deliver a streamlined service to clients.
 Be involved in ad-hoc project work as required, for example, risk management exercises, ETV projects, redundancy projects, etc.
 Act as a key point of contact for technical and scheme-specific queries received from clients, third parties and other Mercer businesses.
 Support the business in some non-billable task such as billing process, general analysis, etc. 
 
 
 What you need to have: 
 Bachelors or Master’s in Actuarial, Mathematics, Economics, Management, Finance or similar.
 Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
 Excellent planning and organisational skills in order to prioritise and effectively manage a wide variety of ongoing tasks, in order to meet the multiple deadlines;
 Proven team player with a flexible attitude towards work;
 Ability to multitask, prioritise workloads and sometimes work to tight deadlines;
 Proven ability to deliver excellent client service and satisfaction;
 Strong problem solving skills & ability to clearly articulate complex issues.
 Advanced Microsoft Office skills (in particular a strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, and Word);
 Good attention to detail is critical;
 
 
 What makes you stand out: 
 Previous experience in consulting and or actuarial matters
 Strong relationship building skills with ability to work closely with internal teams, customers & sales team;
 Proactive and goal oriented.
 
 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.
 
 
Mercer is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Mercer, visit mercer.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Custody Technology Analyst – Digital Assets
description:
Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution shaping innovative applications using distributed ledger technologies? Then bring your skills in technical analysis, design best practices, problem-solving, and communication to Citi’s Custody Technology team.
 
 We are seeking a delivery-focused  Custody Technology Analyst  with a strong understanding of distributed ledger technology (DLT), cryptocurrencies, and digital assets, paired with a solid foundation in the custody domain. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional financial infrastructure and the future of decentralized finance, working across design, engineering, implementation, and quality assurance.
 
 Company & Hub Overview 
 Shape your career with Citi in Dublin. By joining Citi, you will become part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. 
 
 Citi has had a presence in Ireland since 1965 as one of the first foreign banks to open an office in the country. Today, Dublin serves as the Headquarters of Citibank Europe Plc, offering a vibrant, multicultural hub where talented professionals collaborate to solve complex global challenges. 
    
 Team/Role Overview 
 Our Custody Technology team is at the forefront of the industry's shift toward asset tokenization and digital market infrastructure. This is a highly collaborative, forward-thinking squad tasked with designing and integrating digital asset solutions into Citi’s world-class custody platform.
 
 As a Custody Technology Analyst, you will collaborate daily with global product managers, blockchain engineers, enterprise architects, and operations specialists. You will work on cutting-edge initiatives that define how institutional clients securely hold, settle, and service digital assets. This role offers the unique challenge of working with emerging, fast-evolving technologies while maintaining the rigorous security, scalability, and resilience of a Tier-1 global bank.
 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Technical & Functional Analysis:  Conduct deep technical analysis of business and functional requirements, translating them into robust, developer-ready specifications and system designs.
 Systems Integration:  Analyze, map, and communicate the downstream impacts of integrating new digital asset and blockchain systems with Citi's existing global technology stack.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner with global stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations to design and deliver a cohesive target architecture and operating model.
 Proactive Delivery & Risk Management:  Drive project tasks independently, proactively identifying potential bottlenecks or delivery risks, and communicating them early to ensure timely project execution.
 System Evolution:  Design and implement modifications within existing global custody applications to seamlessly support digital asset use cases, tokenization, and smart contract execution.
 Architecture & Design Contribution:  Contribute actively to system architecture discussions, advocating for modern, clean, secure, and highly scalable design patterns.
 
 What we’ll need from you 
 Technical Foundation: Proven experience in a technical role such as Software Engineering, Technical Systems Analysis, or Solutions Architecture.
 Digital Asset Domain Knowledge: A strong conceptual and practical understanding of blockchain, DLT networks, smart contracts, tokenization, and digital custody.
 Modern Architecture Design: Hands-on experience working with modern, high-throughput microservices, event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, pub/sub), and RESTful APIs.
 Enterprise Resilience: Experience designing, developing, or supporting mission-critical, highly resilient, and fault-tolerant enterprise systems.
 Financial Services: Background in financial services, with preferred exposure to securities services, custody, clearing, or settlement systems.
 Global Team Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in virtual, diverse, and cross-functional global teams.
 Strong Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of articulating complex technical concepts to non-technical business partners.
 
 What we can offer you 
 This is a role that will offer you the opportunity to build an in-depth knowledge of digital assets and their applications in a highly regulated environment. Every day there will be new business and technical challenges that will help you develop new skills while we build solutions to shape the future of digital finance.
 
 By joining Citi Dublin, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed) and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits that support you (and your family) to be well, live well and save well. Discover more here. 
 
 Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day.  We want the best talent around the world to be energised to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive. 
 
 Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

This 3-day event will feature a range of live presentations including: Creating a Winning CV, Ace that Virtual Interview and Rock Your Network with LinkedIn. For further information contact Jill Barrett
PLEASE NOTE - This fair will not take place on the Career Fair Plus platform.
Information for Students
Our Virtual Careers Fairs offer you the opportunity to connect with employers from a wide range of sectors.
While we do recommend you definitely attend the fair most closely linked to your area of study remember that organisations have many different departments such as Law, Marketing, HR & Recruitment, IT, Finance, Operations and Logistics so it is sensible to talk to a few different companies as many opportunities are open to graduates of all disciplines and you could find the ideal opportunity where you least expect it!
Before the Fairs:
CV & Virtual Fair Preparation Tip Clinics  – We understand that Virtual Fairs can seem a little overwhelming, so we are here to help you get ready! We will be hosting some CV Preparation Clinics and Networking Tips Clinics  from 23 rd September onwards. Please keep an eye on your TU Dublin email and our Events Calendar for further updates.
How to access the Fairs:
From Oct 5 th - Download the app, Explore Employers and schedule appointments for the day of the Fair!
The Employer Exhibitor List will be available on the Career Fair Plus app on 5 th October 2020
The app will allow you to:
Explore all of our fairs to see all opportunities being promoted.
View exhibitor profiles in advance, find out more about them and view their websites
Filter and search for opportunities by degree subject, sector or business area
Book short 1-2-1 appointments to talk to employer recruiters (usually 10 mins). To book an appointment you will need to create a profile on the app – remember to read the Privacy Policy before signing up.
Some employers will also be running ‘drop in’ rooms on the day of the fair and you will see a button on their profile to access their ‘drop in’ room on the day of the fair.
There is also a laptop/desktop website version of the app and we would recommend that you use this on the day of the fairs for your 1-2-1 appointments. Visit https://app.careerfairplus.com/ and search for Fairs>Technological University Dublin to login.
To download the App:
Go to the App store or Google Play
Search ‘Career Fair Plus’ and select the Careers Fair Plus logo; it’s a free download
The first time you download the app you will need to select Technological University Dublin to find our fairs.
Click on that to download and install
When you sign up the information you include in your profile such as your name, college course and your CV is shared with the employer/exhibitor you have booked an appointment with and on the administrative site with the Career Development Centre & Career Fair Plus to run the event. Your information is not shared with any third parties. It is important to read the Privacy Policy before signing up. Remember to delete your profile after the fairs.
See the Careers Fair Plus demo below:
Student FAQ's
Can students attend a fair without a log-in or without signing up?
You can view some fair data without logging in, such as the participating employers, but must create a profile/login to schedule appointments with employers. You are advised to book appointments in advance – you will not be able to book an appointment after 10am on the day of each fair.
Can employers search for candidates in the platform, or invite them to book appointments?
No, employers can only see the candidates that have scheduled an appointment with them. There will be some appointments free on the day, but it is a good idea to review the app prior to the fairs and schedule your appointments in advance.
I am a little nervous and don’t know what I would say to an employer!
We will be hosting some lunchtime CV Preparation Clinics and Networking Tips Clinics  from 23 rd September onwards. Please keep an eye on your TU Dublin and our Events Calendar for further updates. We will also be on hand on the day of each Fair to help you.
There wasn’t any employer for my specific degree area
The roles on offer may not be restricted to the industry sector the company works in – remember there are lots of different departments in most organisations so an IT company may be seeking to hire a finance graduate and a Financial Services organisation may want to hire a software programmer!
Also, some employers do not recruit via Careers Fairs, but we encourage these organisations to advertise their positions via our Jobscene jobs portal.

title: SME Payments Consultant
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

SME Payments Consultant

What does a successful Inside Sales Executive do?

A successful Inside Sales Executive at AIBMS, now part of Fiserv, uncovers growth opportunities, builds trusted client relationships, and helps businesses adopt modern payments solutions that align with how they live and work. You manage the sales process from first outreach through handoff with organization, pace, and a clear focus on client value. You bring energy, curiosity, and a partner-first mindset to help clients succeed. Working as one team, we create opportunities that help businesses move faster and serve their customers better.

What you will do:

  • Drive new sales opportunities by researching target segments and building a qualified pipeline

  • Contact prospects through phone, email, and social channels to generate interest and secure meetings

  • Qualify prospective clients by assessing payment set-up, business needs, and fit for Fiserv solutions

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, including meetings, notes, follow-ups, and pipeline stages

  • Coordinate demonstrations, meetings, and internal resources to help move opportunities towards closure

  • Prepare clear, client-focused proposals and gather required pricing and product information

  • Guide clients through early onboarding activities and support a smooth handoff to implementation teams

  • Share client insights and contribute to team initiatives that improve sales effectiveness

What you will need to have:

  • Demonstrated consultative sales capability with experience managing a CRM-led pipeline

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with confidence in calls, virtual conversations, and meetings

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple opportunities effectively

  • Strong aptitude for payments, integrations, and product features with the ability to explain concepts simply

  • Proactive, target-focused approach with strong follow-through and a solutions-oriented mindset

What would be great to have:

  • Experience in sales, business development, or another client-facing role

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar sales tools

  • Knowledge of payments, FinTech, or financial services concepts

  • Understanding of basic compliance requirements, including PCI and KYC, and their impact on onboarding

  • Confidence delivering short product walkthroughs or demonstrations to business audiences

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv.  Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 

Note to agencies:

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

Warning about fake job posts:

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

About the role
The 3rd Line Security Specialist will provide lead technical support and great customer experience on complex security issues and projects – being connected and clear with customer representatives or vendors and directing other support staff where appropriate, during an exciting time within the business.
Working into Bespoke Operations, onsite in an air gapped secure customer facility alongside other BT personnel and 3rd party engineers, you will be committed to reducing KPIs and SLAs to below customer expectations, ensuring that the customer and it’s service comes first.
The successful candidate will need to be eligible to gain and hold Government Security Clearance to SC UK Eyes Only Level.  You may also be required to go through Government Security Clearance to DV Level in the future.
What you’ll be doing
•    Be a Subject Matter Expert for a wide range of technologies & security products.
•    Detect, respond and resolve complex security incidents, problems and changes within the operational environment.
•    Provide 3rd line support, responsible for the high priority incident while resolving within the agreed SLA.
•    Be the technology SME for specialised products and services.
•    Be the operational SPOC for our design or customer contract teams.
•    Providing RCA’s and contributing to PIR’s as and when required.
Essential Skills / Experience
•    Proven operational experience across Network Engineering and Security Operations Specialist roles, with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work directly onsite with customers to support complex network solutions.
•    Proven experience across Cisco Firewalls, Checkpoint Firewalls/IPS, F5 Load Balancing, Cisco WSA / ESA / ISE, Ivanti Pulse VPN, Switches and Routers, supported by industry recognised certifications or relevant experience.
•    Ability to lead and manage major or complex security & network incidents, coordinating teleconferences and liaising with designers and wider teams to troubleshoot, fault-find and drive resolution.
Desirable Skills / Experience
•    Exposure to ServiceNow reporting and dashboarding.
•    Experience of Fortinet Firewalls and NetScout.
•    Excellent experience of managing multiple incidents as a lead, making the right decision to resolve within agreed SLAs.
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
•    10% on target annual bonus
•    Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
•    Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
•    Equalised maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
•    Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
•    Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
•    Holiday purchase scheme
•    You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready
Working Pattern
•    Fully on-site role with no home working.
•    You will form an integral part of our 24x7 team providing security in-life technical support, that will including shift working – 2 days 2 nights 4 off – 7-7.

Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

title: Development Executive - Cyber Specialty Team
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Job Description For Posting

 The Cyber Risk landscape continues to evolve at an accelerated rate, with continued exploitation of 0-day & Edge Devices, as well the use of deepfakes for misinformation and cyber extortion, driven by more sophisticated AI technology. It is widely recognised by Risk Managers as representing one of the most significant threats to the viability and continuity of business operations across the globe.
 
 Marsh’s global Cyber Practice is the World’s Most Trusted and Innovative Cyber Risk Advisor. Servicing clients in 130+ countries, illustrating global reach and local expertise, we pride ourselves on simplifying the complexity of Cyber. Through the application of unique Digital Tooling that is unrivalled within the marketplace, our global proprietary wordings, regional facilities, incident management support, and our global team of Cyber specialists, we provide our Clients with a holistic Cyber service proposition, helping them to Understand, Measure, Manage and Respond to Cyber Risk.  
 
 In a direct response to the increased demand and complexity of Cyber Risk, Marsh Ireland are seeking the appointment of an ambitious, motivated and results-driven Business Development Executive to join our Cyber team.  
 The individual concerned will join an existing team of motivated and enthusiastic technical Cyber specialists that are dedicated in providing Clients with Cyber Risk Service Solutions. Working closely with this team the successful candidate will benefit from comprehensive on the job training and education on Marsh Cyber solutions and services.
 
 This key role will involve maintaining responsibility and accountability for the creation and identification of new business opportunities, building and maintaining existing and prospective client relationships and working in collaboration with colleagues across the wider Marsh business to deliver our Cyber Value Proposition to new and existing clients and to drive new business revenue growth within the Cyber/Specialty practice.
 
 This represents an exciting opportunity for the right candidate with previous insurance experience ( must be CIP qualified ), ideally from a broking background, but not necessarily having significant existing Cyber and/or Financial Lines experience, and who possesses the required growth mindset, to transition themselves into a Trusted Risk and Innovated Cyber Advisor.
 With support from the wider business and the existing Team, the individual will develop strong expertise on Cyber risk, technical Cyber product knowledge and in addition will gain an in-depth understanding of and ability to articulate the Marsh Cyber Ireland Value Proposition.
 
 The role will be based in one of our ROI offices situated in Dublin or Cork or Galway and offers a hybrid working model, with 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. It will require a commitment to travel to colleague, client and prospect meetings.
 The successful candidate will be exclusively focused and dedicated to New & Expanded Cyber/Tech and FINPRO Product and Solution Sales. They will be tasked to support and implement an ambitious growth strategy and to achieve short, medium and long term growth targets.
 
 Main Activities 
 This is a sales function and the individual will be expected to develop and execute a growth strategy and development plan, aligned to our country, region and global value proposition.
 
 What can you expect: 
 To be part of an organisation with a leading global brand, a brilliant and expert team and a positive, vibrant and inclusive culture.
 You will gain the opportunity to excel and further your next career steps through intensive on the job training, interesting & challenging work, further professional development opportunities and supportive leaders.
 A key component of the role will be the Intense Technical Cyber and FINPRO training that will provide unique industry expertise.
 
 We will rely on you to:  
 Gain in-depth knowledge and understanding of Marsh’s CyberTech value proposition and develop technical working knowledge of CyberTech & FINPRO products.

 Actively seek and develop relationships with prospects and client contacts. While maintaining control and oversight of Cyber active client target/prospect list.

 Develop market profile, attend Industry Trade events/shows, compose marketing materials and insights for wider circulation on social media and Company marketing distribution.

 Draft and deliver new business presentations and support colleagues in the creation and development of expanded new business opportunities

 Identify potential growth areas, whitespace opportunities and newly developed cover solutions.

 Review Client Risk Assessments and identify potential opportunities for the provision of additional Marsh Advisory/Consulting and Incident Management services aswell as oversee, manage and coordinate the wider Cyber Advisory and Claims Incident Management services.

 Work with other business stakeholders to create increased Cross-selling opportunities. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve targets and objectives.

 Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities while collaborating with marketing, product, and operations teams to align business development strategies.

 Monitor and report on sales performance metrics and suggest improvements.

 Attend industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote the company and generate leads alongside staying up-to-date with industry developments and best practices.

 
 What you will need to have: 
 CIP qualification

 3 - 5 years minimum general insurance experience

 Full drivers licence and access to own car/private transportation

 Eager to learn and to enhance knowledge and technical skills

 Self-motivated and energised  

 Ability to communicate at all levels with clients & colleagues

 Team player and work with other business stakeholders

 
 What makes you stand out: 
 ACII qualification  

 Proven track record of Sales delivery is desired but not essential

 Professional certifications in sales or business development are advantageous

 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders.

 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact for colleagues, clients, and communities.

 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

 

 
 
Marsh Risk is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Marsh Risk, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Associate Underwriter - 12 month FTC
description:
Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.
 
 Job Category 

Underwriting 
 Target Openings 

1 
 What Is the Opportunity? 

Business Insurance helps companies in the UK and Ireland identify, prepare for and mitigate risks by offering a broad array of industry-specific, combined property and casualty insurance solutions to customers. This includes SME solutions traded directly, Commercial Accounts traded via brokers, and Corporate Solutions to FTSE 350 Risk Managed companies. 

We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Underwriter to join our team in Dublin on a 12-month fixed-term contract. You'll be responsible for managing new business and renewals from submission through to bind, while building and maintaining relationships with brokers to deliver the right insurance solutions for customers. We're looking for someone with a background in any insurance underwriting who is detail-oriented, a confident decision-maker, and a strong communicator. 

Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion. What Will You Do? With support, manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned portfolio comprised of routine accounts across most of our products.

 With support, underwrite and negotiate routine risks to minimise risk and maximise profitability, including Mid Term Adjustments (MTAs).

 Develop your portfolio management, ensuring key performance indicators are consistently achieved and you actively target new business and retention.

 Take corrective action in collaboration with your Manager / Team based on identified risk characteristics.

 Identify and capture opportunities to write additional lines of business using knowledge of products, risk characteristics and appetite.

 Proactively utilise various technology platforms to quote and bind risk efficiently.

 Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to identify cross-selling opportunities.

 Foster and maintain relationships with brokers by phone, email or other communication channels to market and sell Travelers products to write and retain accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to meetings.

 Execute submission, quotes and renewals with guidance from your manager and working in partnership with the sales team.

 Perform other duties as assigned.

 What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have? 
 Leaving Certificate or similar qualification.
 Knowledge: Some knowledge of products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
 Analytical/Critical thinking: Critical thinking skills with the ability to underwrite, market products, identify financial challenges, and analyse available information to make decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
 Communication/Influence: Communication skills with the ability to negotiate with agents and brokers.
 Inclusion: Ability to work with people from different backgrounds, experiences, cultures, races, etc. and views those differences as assets to be leveraged to accomplish business goals and objectives.
 Industry / Competitor Analysis: Review competitor press releases, and industry trade press for helpful insights.
 Project Management: Participate in projects that involves the implementation of non-complex, routine business and regulatory changes relating to the enhancement, maintenance or introduction of new products.
 
 What is a Must Have? 
 Some prior related insurance experience.
 
 Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 
 
If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.
 
Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.
 
 To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/ .

title: Apprentice Maintenance Fitter
description:
Kepak Group is a professional, and dynamic business that has grown into one of Europe's leading food processing companies. We are a family-owned, future-facing company.
 Our ambition is to continue to grow through the success of our people. Career development, training, health, safety, and wellness of our Kepak team are at the heart of the company’s culture.
 Kepak Athleague are currently recruiting for an Apprentice Fitter to join the maintenance team in a busy beef & lamb abattoir plant.
 Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the successful candidate will work as part of a team responsible for all aspects of machine and equipment maintenance, specialising in the repair of industrial equipment.
 What to expect in the job?
 Assist with repair of industrial production equipment such as machines, conveyors, packaging machines, gearboxes, bearings and hydraulics.
 Assist the Lead Maintenance Technician with the implementation of preventative maintenance programmes for all machines in assigned area.
 Assist with the continuous monitoring of all machinery and equipment within the plant.
 Assist in real time repair of machines and equipment to get them back up & running within optimum time frame.
 Document all aspects of maintenance work carried out and keep management informed of potential issues.
 Adhere to company safety policies at all times.
 Requirements 
 Requirements
 Must have a keen interest in learning about machines & conveyors, packaging machines, gearbox repairs, air automation, hydraulics and welding.
 Must have a keen interest in learning the Trade of a Fitter within a manufacturing/industrial setting
 We run a maintenance CMMS system, knowledge on the use of computers would be an advantage, training provided. 
 Must be flexible, open to new ideas and work practices
 Good communication skills, enthusiastic, hardworking and energetic.
 Able to deal with pressurised situations and remain calm and focused.
 Flexibility to meet peak work demands as required
 Basic electrical knowledge an advantage, but not essential
 Benefits 
 Training
 Subsidised canteen
 Access to Pension Scheme
 Free staff car parking
 Onsite health and wellness services
 Bike to work scheme
 Formal recognition initiatives and team awards in place
 A dedicated learning & development team

What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.

European Technology sits within Canada Life Group and encompasses the technology community across all European entities, including Irish Life Group, Canada Life UK, Canada Life Europe and Central Technology Services – Europe. European Technology supports the delivery of business strategy through strong collaboration, effective governance and modern, resilient technology platforms across Europe.
European Technology is entering a new phase of transformation, with an expanded mandate covering technology strategy, transformation delivery, sourcing and partnerships, data and information governance, and enterprise-wide change enablement. To support this agenda, we are recruiting an Executive Assistant to support the support to the CITO function.
The primary focus of the Executive Assistant is to provide high-quality administrative and organisational support to the CITO function. The role plays a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of executive schedules, meetings and operational activities, enabling leaders to manage their priorities effectively. description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Sales 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Tableau Account Executive to join our team in our Dublin office, focusing on the SMB segment across the CEE region. As a Tableau Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through strategic sales initiatives and fostering strong relationships with clients.

 Responsibilities: 
 Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to meet and exceed revenue targets within the ESMB segment across the CEE region

 Identify and prospect new business opportunities while maintaining and growing existing accounts.

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including partners, solution engineers, and other Salesforce teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

 Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to potential clients, showcasing the value proposition of Tableau's solutions.

 Negotiate contracts and close deals, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and Tableau.

 Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments to effectively position Tableau's offerings.

 
 Required Experience: 
 Prior sales experience in a quota-carrying role, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets. Experience in SaaS sales is preferred but not mandatory.

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and credibility with clients at all levels.

 Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving abilities and a results-driven mindset.

 Self-motivated and proactive with a passion for driving business growth and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

 Fluency in English is required, Russian langauge a plus

 
 What’s In It For You (Benefits & Growth) Personal Wellbeing: Private health insurance, life insurance, a retirement savings plan, and a monthly wellness allowance.

 Flexibility: Flexible time off and leave policies, plus comprehensive parental support programs.

 Career Development: Access to world-class AI and sales training, mentorship, and a clear path for promotion within the global Salesforce ecosystem.

 Giving Back: 7 paid volunteer days per year and donation matching for the causes you care about.

 Perks: Employee discounts, inclusive resource groups, and a culture that celebrates Equality.

 
 Equality & Inclusion Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and ensure reasonable accommodations are provided throughout the recruitment process where required. *LI-Y
 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
